prs.title: feat(core): add local notes compaction with a strategy selector
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an opt-in local notes compaction strategy. Users can select **Summary** or **Notes and History** under **Chat Compression Strategy** in `/settings`, or set `model.chatCompression.strategy` to `summary` or `notes` in `settings.json`. Summary remains the default; changing the selection requires restarting Qwen Code.

Eligible main sessions gain `session_notes`, `session_history`, `get_context_remaining`, and `new_context`. The model can persist a bounded working checkpoint, start a smaller context from that checkpoint and the latest consumed user request, and recover omitted evidence from the active branch of its local session log. Successful notes rollovers make no summarization request. Notes revisions live in the existing JSONL transcript, with a generated Markdown projection for inspection; checkpoint persistence must succeed before active history changes. Resume, fork, rewind, archive, and deletion handle the matching notes state.

Missing, stale, or unusable notes fall back to summary for automatic and ordinary manual compression. An explicit `new_context` requires a fresh revision and reports an error if it cannot commit. `/compress <instructions>` continues to summarize, and `/compress-fast` keeps its existing behavior. The notes tool bundle respects recording availability and tool policy and is excluded from subagents, teammates, and nested code-mode calls. Ink and OpenTUI display a notes-specific transition notice.

## Why it's needed

Repeated full-history summaries can lose constraints, decisions, and tool evidence that a long task needs later. A local working checkpoint plus bounded history retrieval gives the model a way to carry forward its current state and recover details on demand. Storage and retrieval use the existing session log and require no additional memory backend. Selected notes and retrieved history still go to the configured model provider as normal inference input. Real-model quality, total token cost, and latency remain to be measured before considering a default change.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start the local build with no strategy configured and confirm summary behavior. Open `/settings`, search for `compression`, switch to **Notes and History**, and confirm the saved value is `model.chatCompression.strategy: "notes"` and the restart notice appears. Restart and check that the four notes tools are available. Repeat with `summary`, including activation through `settings.json`.
2. In an isolated recorded session, have the model write notes and request a new context in separate tool-only responses using the returned revision. Repeat three times. Each new context should retain the checkpoint and current user constraints, with no summarizer request. Deliberately omit an earlier identifier from the notes, then recover it through history search/read. Resume the session and check that its latest notes revision and old history reference still work.
3. Check that missing/stale revisions, oversized notes, and notes/reset calls mixed with ordinary text or tools cannot install a new context. Disabling recording or denying a required notes tool should disable the complete bundle. After switching to a smaller model window, existing bounded notes should remain readable, while an oversized checkpoint must be shortened before it can authorize a reset.
4. Compare compression commands: `/compress` with fresh notes should use notes; missing/stale notes should fall back to summary; `/compress <instructions>` should forward those instructions to the summarizer even with fresh notes; `/compress-fast` should retain its current tool-output clearing behavior. Check that the next model request uses the committed context and that notes transitions show the notes-specific notice.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Actual tmux captures of `/settings`, with the search set to `compression`:

**Before — global `qwen` `0.23.3-nightly.20260913.faa395885e`:**

```text
No settings match your search.
```

**After — local bundle `0.24.1`:**

```text
Chat Compression Strategy                                                   Notes and History*
Choose summary compression or local notes with history recovery. Restart Qwen Code to apply.
To see changes, Qwen Code must be restarted. Press r to exit and apply changes now.
```

The fresh-notes `/compress` case displayed `Started a new context from local notes` in the actual TUI. The complete deterministic headless/tmux run passed settings persistence, tool availability, history recovery/resume, six rejection cases, and all six manual-compression cases. After the final fixes, the rebuilt handoff rerun again committed **three distinct notes windows in 15 main requests with zero summarizer requests**; resume took three requests and restored the same notes revision and historical reference.

`npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run bundle` passed. Relevant core, ACP, settings/schema/i18n, and Ink/OpenTUI regression tests passed. The final focused rerun passed 23 core tests and 54 event-adapter tests; the commit hook also passed formatting and ESLint. A separate comment contains the E2E matrix and coverage limits.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, Node.js `v26.8.2`; local bundled CLI `0.24.1`; isolated temporary settings and runtime directories; deterministic localhost OpenAI-compatible provider; headless CLI and real tmux interaction. The user's normal settings and sessions were not modified by the tests.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: This changes core recording, compaction, and replay paths. Correctness depends on fresh notes, successful checkpoint persistence, and branch-correct recovery; note completeness still depends on the model. The Markdown file is a generated view, so editing it directly does not update canonical notes.
- Not validated / out of scope: Real-model task quality, token/cost/latency comparisons, full ACP/Web Shell E2E, other provider wire protocols, process-crash/disk/lease fault injection, and Windows/Linux execution. The deterministic E2E suite does not cover automatic/hard-overflow triggers, nested code mode, or fork/rewind/archive lifecycle operations; focused regression tests cover relevant runtime paths, without claiming end-to-end coverage. Cross-session memory, multi-file notes, and a notes editor are out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: No settings migration is required. `summary` remains the default, existing transcripts remain supported, and enabling or disabling `notes` requires a restart. Ordinary compression can use summary fallback; an explicit `new_context` never silently summarizes.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized, including decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria, and follow-up validation.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12257

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的内容

增加可选的本地 notes 压缩策略。用户可以在 `/settings` 的 **上下文压缩方式** 中选择 **摘要** 或 **笔记与历史**，也可以在 `settings.json` 中把 `model.chatCompression.strategy` 设为 `summary` 或 `notes`。默认仍为摘要；修改选项后需要重启 Qwen Code。

符合条件的主会话获得 `session_notes`、`session_history`、`get_context_remaining` 和 `new_context` 四个工具。模型可以保存有大小限制的工作笔记，从笔记和最近已消费的用户请求启动更小的上下文，再从本地 session log 的有效分支找回遗漏证据。成功的 notes 换窗口不发起摘要请求。笔记版本保存在现有 JSONL transcript 中，并生成方便查看的 Markdown 文件；只有恢复 checkpoint 持久化成功后才替换当前历史。恢复、分叉、回退、归档和删除操作会处理对应的笔记状态。

自动压缩和普通手动压缩在笔记缺失、过期或不可用时回退到摘要。显式调用 `new_context` 必须提供新鲜的笔记版本，无法提交时返回错误。`/compress <instructions>` 继续生成摘要，`/compress-fast` 保持现有行为。笔记工具组遵循录制可用性及工具策略，并对 subagent、teammate 和嵌套 code-mode 调用关闭。Ink 和 OpenTUI 会显示专门的 notes 换窗口提示。

## 为什么需要

反复生成全历史摘要可能丢失长任务后续需要的约束、决策和工具证据。本地工作笔记加上有界历史检索，使模型能够保留当前工作状态并按需找回细节。存储和检索复用现有 session log，不需要新增 memory 后端。选中的笔记和检索出的历史仍会作为正常推理输入发送给配置的模型 provider。在考虑修改默认策略前，仍需评估真实模型的任务质量、总 token 成本和延迟。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 使用本地构建启动，不配置策略时确认仍使用摘要。打开 `/settings`，搜索 `compression`，切换到 **Notes and History**，确认保存的值为 `model.chatCompression.strategy: "notes"` 并显示重启提示。重启后检查四个笔记工具可用。再切回 `summary`，并验证通过 `settings.json` 启用的行为一致。
2. 在隔离且开启录制的会话中，让模型先写笔记，再用返回的 revision 请求新上下文；两次调用分别放在独立且只含该工具的回复中。重复三次。每个新上下文都应保留 checkpoint 和当前用户约束，且不发起摘要请求。故意不把某个早期标识符写入笔记，再通过历史搜索和读取找回。恢复会话后，检查最新笔记版本和旧历史引用仍可用。
3. 检查缺失或过期的 revision、超限笔记，以及混入普通文本或其他工具的笔记/换窗口调用，都不能安装新上下文。关闭录制或拒绝任一必需工具后，整个笔记工具组应被关闭。切换到窗口更小的模型后，已有且满足固定大小上限的笔记仍应可读，但超过当前模型预算的 checkpoint 必须缩短后才能用于换窗口。
4. 对比压缩命令：笔记新鲜时 `/compress` 应使用笔记；笔记缺失或过期时应回退到摘要；即使有新鲜笔记，`/compress <instructions>` 也应把指定要求转交摘要模型；`/compress-fast` 应保留现有清理工具输出的行为。检查下一次模型请求使用已提交的上下文，且 notes 换窗口显示对应提示。

### 证据（前后对比）

以下为真实 tmux 捕获的 `/settings` 画面节选，搜索词为 `compression`：

**修改前：全局 `qwen` `0.23.3-nightly.20260913.faa395885e`：**

```text
No settings match your search.
```

**修改后：本地 bundle `0.24.1`：**

```text
Chat Compression Strategy                                                   Notes and History*
Choose summary compression or local notes with history recovery. Restart Qwen Code to apply.
To see changes, Qwen Code must be restarted. Press r to exit and apply changes now.
```

使用新鲜笔记执行 `/compress` 时，真实 TUI 显示 `Started a new context from local notes`。完整的确定性 headless/tmux 测试通过了设置持久化、工具可用性、历史找回与会话恢复、六项拒绝场景以及全部六项手动压缩场景。最终修复后重新构建并复测交接，再次在 **15 次主模型请求中提交了三个不同的 notes 窗口，摘要请求为零**；恢复过程使用三次请求，恢复了相同的笔记版本和历史引用。

`npm run build`、`npm run typecheck` 和 `npm run bundle` 均通过。相关 core、ACP、设置/schema/国际化、Ink/OpenTUI 回归测试均通过。最后的针对性复测通过了 23 个 core 测试和 54 个 event-adapter 测试；提交钩子的格式和 ESLint 检查也通过。另附评论列出 E2E 场景矩阵和覆盖范围。

### 测试平台

| 平台 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

macOS arm64、Node.js `v26.8.2`、本地 CLI bundle `0.24.1`；使用隔离的临时设置和 runtime 目录、确定性的 localhost OpenAI 兼容模型服务、headless CLI 和真实 tmux 交互。测试未修改用户日常使用的设置和会话。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：涉及 core 的录制、压缩和回放路径。正确性依赖笔记新鲜度、checkpoint 成功持久化以及有效分支恢复；笔记内容是否完整仍依赖模型。Markdown 文件只是生成视图，直接编辑不会更新权威笔记。
- 未验证或不在范围内：真实模型任务质量、token/成本/延迟对比、完整 ACP/Web Shell E2E、其他 provider 的通信协议、进程崩溃/磁盘/写入租约故障注入，以及 Windows/Linux 运行。确定性 E2E 未覆盖自动/硬溢出触发、嵌套 code mode 或分叉/回退/归档生命周期操作；针对性回归测试覆盖了相关运行时路径，但不代表完成了这些场景的端到端验证。跨会话记忆、多文件笔记和笔记编辑器不在本次范围内。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无需迁移设置。默认仍为 `summary`，继续支持已有 transcript；开启或关闭 `notes` 需要重启。普通压缩可以回退到摘要；显式 `new_context` 绝不会悄悄改用摘要。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.zh-CN.md)。两个版本完整同步，包括决策、约束、验收标准和后续验证。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #12257

prs.title: fix(ci): preserve Maven suite results across cache write-back failures
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR hardens the SDK Java Maven cache path after the suite/write-back lock split. Failed MySQL integration suites can still publish downloaded artifacts while preserving the original suite status, cache setup failures preserve the already-known suite result, and the final error annotation identifies the failed Maven stage. Cache seeds report copy failures, tolerate an unavailable cache or failed best-effort prune, and detach mutable resolver metadata before Maven runs — including single-link resolver state inherited from a previous job, since RUNNER_TEMP persists across jobs on the self-hosted pool. Write-back excludes the same metadata and partial-download files.

## Why it's needed

The lock relocation associated with #15262 already landed on main through #15128 and #15254. This branch is the remaining hardening delta: a failed suite should not throw away reusable downloads, a best-effort cache operation should not replace the suite result, and mutable resolver state should not be published as an immutable shared artifact. The test repair in 11c0f4b2fb12c also includes the deferred-status reporter in extracted shell snippets so those tests can exercise their intended paths.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Fail either Maven stage in the self-hosted MySQL integration lane. Reusable downloaded artifacts should reach write-back, later suites should not run, and the step should retain the failed stage's status and annotation.
- Run a green and a failed suite with an unusable cache or missing job-local repository. The cache fault should produce a warning and preserve the suite result.
- Seed a warm cache containing resolver markers and version metadata. Mutable hardlinks should be detached before Maven runs; write-back should publish artifacts while excluding resolver markers, metadata and partial-download files.
- Exercise a cold cache and a seed prune failure. Both should still reach Maven; an actual copy failure should remain visible in the log.
- Plant a plain single-link `resolver-status.properties` / `x.jar.lastUpdated` directly in `${RUNNER_TEMP}/m2-repo` before the seed body runs. The seed prune must delete both while the host-cache peers stay intact. Restoring `-links +1` to the seed prunes must red the `clears inherited single-link resolver state from the job-local repository` witness.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Head `26960a72d1` merges main `a5fec03684` into `89d3898f4d`; the PR delta is unchanged (the same seven files, 1116 insertions / 198 deletions), and the merged workflow's `.size-baseline` entry is re-recorded to 162545. Earlier measurements below are labeled with the commit they were taken at; the four required suites were re-run after this merge. Prior heads: `a0d162dbcc` (main `90eb13e4c6`), `d0f6312b82` (main `91a6274075`), `7618d49a` (main `fe30b5daaa`).

| Check | Result | Measured at |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| sdk-java-workflow + sdk-java-lock + workflow-size + main-ci-failure-issue-workflow | 505 passed \| 47 skipped (552), re-run after the latest merge | 26960a72d1, local macOS (a0d162dbcc: 502/47) |
| Wider set: six other sdk-java.yml parsers + qwen-triage-workflow | 241 passed \| 0 skipped; 191 passed \| 10 skipped (triage's pre-existing 5 s subprocess timeouts on a tmux-less Mac pass with `--testTimeout=30000`; no test modified) | 26960a72d1, local macOS (a0d162dbcc ten-suite set: 743/47 + 191/10) |
| Maintainer Linux verification: 34 replay cells + author guard suite + 18-row mutation matrix | 61/61 assertions; guard suite 142/142 on Linux; 18/18 mutations killed, no survivors — verdict **merge-ready** (report in the PR thread) | 7618d49a, Linux node:22-bookworm non-root, 2026-10-31 |
| SDK Java (fast) / ubuntu-latest / Java 21 — real self-hosted pool lane | pass, 30m25s | 7618d49a CI |
| SDK Java (full) tier on the real pool — Runtime Broker and Managed Agent MySQL (1h13m), Hosted process fault (1h54m), EventTransport broker / multi-node, Java 11/17/21, Real daemon E2E, Flyway | all pass | 7618d49a CI |
| Six other suites parsing sdk-java.yml (spotbugs-gate, hosted-process-ci, managed-agent-gate-workflow, managed-agent-server-e2e, event-transport-multi-node-ci, event-transport-broker-ci) | 236 passed \| 0 skipped | c7746613ec, local macOS; PR delta unchanged since |
| Mutation: restore `-links +1` at the four seed prunes | Witness red, vitest exit 1 (`inherited single-link marker survived the seed prune: expected true to be false`); fix restored, green. Re-killed on Linux as row m5b at 7618d49a | c7746613ec local macOS; 7618d49a Linux |

CI re-runs at the merged head | 7618d49a CI; d0f6312b82 pending |

The 47 macOS skips are the file's Linux-only behavioral pins; the maintainer's Linux round executes them (142/142), so the macOS counts alone do not certify the changed behavior — the Linux verification does. The new inherited-state witness is cross-platform and ran on both systems. Prior Linux A/B and real-pool reports remain historical evidence at their recorded heads.

### Tested on

Round of 2026-10-31 (local takeover after the AutoFix loop reached its round cap): merged main `812a8c7ccb`, resolving the write-back conflicts semantically — main's nine-coordinate prune list (from the #15871 Maven-module split) plus this PR's seven-name `! -name` exclusions, with the matching test pins moved along — and fixed R13-1 by dropping `-links +1` from all four seed prunes so inherited single-link resolver state is cleared again; the write-backs' `-links 1` delta filter is unchanged. Both design-doc languages are synchronized and `.size-baseline` is re-recorded to the exact byte count. Unlike the previous static-only closeout, this round ran the suites and the mutation locally (evidence table above). The merge-order decision R2-6 asked for is recorded: this PR is the chosen landing PR of the family; #15275, #15284 and #15233 are closed, #15254 merged, and #15286 remains the separately owned follow-up.

Later on 2026-10-31: the maintainer merged current main (`7618d49a`, PR files untouched) and published an independent Linux verification at that head — verdict **merge-ready**, 61/61 assertions, 18/18 mutations killed. One non-blocking Suggestion from that report is deferred and recorded here per the repository's post-five-round convergence rule: when the `managed-agent-server` checkout is missing, the deferred-failure annotation names the previous successful Maven stage instead of the checkout (both lanes). The report carries a measured minimal fix (set `mvn_stage` before the `cd`; the test pin counting `mvn_stage` occurrences must move with it). It is follow-up work, not a merge blocker; the deferral is recorded so nothing is silently dropped.

2026-11-01: merged main `91a6274075` (`d0f6312b82`) to clear the base conflict, keeping main's Hosted-admission change (#16010) alongside this PR's hardening; delta unchanged, baseline re-recorded (155529), required suites re-run green. At `7618d49a` CI was fully green (including the full SDK Java tier on the real pool) and the PR held two maintainer approvals (wenshao, yiliang114); CI re-runs at the merged head, and stale-approval dismissal rules may require the two approvals to be refreshed. No review thread is unresolved.

2026-11-02: the maintainer merged main once more (`702da7a21a`, merging `60f5c1ed95`); the PR delta is unchanged apart from main-side comment edits inside `sdk-java.yml`, which now measures 156105 bytes while `.size-baseline` still records 155529 — a 576-byte record nit the CI size check tolerates, to be re-recorded with the next content change. All checks at this head are green, including the re-run `review-pr` whose round-15 review posted zero findings. The two approvals from `7618d49a` were dismissed on push by the stale-approval rule; the PR is MERGEABLE and now waits on two fresh maintainer approvals at `702da7a21a`. The round-15 deferred items stay recorded follow-ups: the baseline record, the MySQL `cd`-deferral/stage-label pins, the classifier fixture's lock-wait line, and the MySQL write-back comment wording.

2026-11-03: merged main `90eb13e4c6` (`a0d162dbcc`) to clear the new base conflict, keeping main's optional-runtime-backend Maven modules (#16141) alongside this PR's hardening; delta unchanged, `.size-baseline` re-recorded to 159271 (which also clears the 576-byte nit above), and the four required suites re-run green (502 passed | 47 skipped) plus the wider ten-suite set (743 passed | 47 skipped). CI re-runs at the merged head; the two approvals must be refreshed at `a0d162dbcc` since every push dismisses the previous ones.

2026-11-04: merged main `a5fec03684` (`26960a72d1`) to clear the new base conflict, keeping main's disk-exhaustion guards (#16068) alongside this PR's hardening; delta unchanged, `.size-baseline` re-recorded to 162545, four required suites re-run green (505 passed | 47 skipped) plus six other parsers (241 passed | 0 skipped) and triage (191 passed | 10 skipped). The two web-shell smoke failures before the merge were the SSE-handshake race on a busy pool host and were re-run; the push briefly hit a GitHub-side Internal Server Error during the day's minor outage and succeeded after a short wait (the watch's worktree now pushes over HTTPS with `gh auth git-credential`, GitHub SSH having refused connections since this morning). CI re-runs at the merged head; two fresh approvals needed at `26960a72d1`.

## Risk & Scope

The host cache remains best-effort. Failure to seed can increase network resolution. An unexpected bare-flock failure remains fatal. Real Maven resolver behavior and contention on the self-hosted pool require CI evidence beyond shell fixtures. The seed prune now also deletes inherited single-link markers in the job-local repository; deleting a job-local hardlink never removes the host peer.

#15286 contains distinct follow-up work: existing-destination seed nesting, removal of old in-house artifacts from the host cache, self-hosted Checkstyle repository selection, and reference-release cache isolation. Those changes remain separately owned. Shared-helper and test-fixture extraction are deferred rather than widening this repair.

Related to #15262; the original lock relocation is already on main.

`c7746613ec` clears inherited resolver state in the Maven cache seed prune (R13-1): the four seed prunes drop `-links +1`, the `deAlias` pin moves with them, and a cross-platform regression witness plants nlink-1 markers before the seed body — mutation-verified red (exit 1) with `-links +1` restored and green with the fix. prs.title: fix(ci): keep sdk-java resolver bookkeeping and in-house jars out of the host cache (#15281)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The job-local Maven repository that the sdk-java suites resolve from no longer shares mutable inodes with the host cache:

- Every seed site drops `maven-metadata-local.xml` together with the other resolver bookkeeping names (`_remote.repositories`, `resolver-status.properties`, `*.lastUpdated`, `*.tmp`), so the unlocked Maven runs cannot rewrite a host-cache file through a seeded hardlink.
- The locked write-back removes every in-house fixed-release coordinate from the host cache (the `qwen-managed-agent-*` modules are purged by glob, tracking #15871's module split), prunes them at any depth rather than only at the repository root, publishes only job-produced files (the same five names stay job-local), and downgrades a failed cache-directory creation to a warning instead of reddening a green suite.
- The self-hosted Managed Agent Checkstyle leg resolves the SDK from the job-local repository the suite installed it into.
- The release builder's seed copies into the job-local repository instead of nesting a second `repository/` inside it, and drops the same bookkeeping names.
- The workflow meta-tests pin the five exclusions at every seed and both prunes, the write-back's children and their fd 9 closure, the host-side removal, the warning path, and the Checkstyle repository.

## Why it's needed

Moving Maven above the per-host lock is only safe while the job-local repository has no inode in common with the host cache. Maven's resolver rewrites its bookkeeping files in place, and the suites `install` fixed-release in-house artifacts: seeded as hardlinks, they let an unlocked run mutate state that every sibling job on the host reads.

Correction to the earlier description: the lock-scope change itself ("only the write-back takes the lock") landed through #15128 and #15254 and is already on main. #15274 remains open with overlapping cache and deferred-status changes. This PR is the cache-isolation half that makes that scope safe, and it is judged on that, not on the lock wait from #15281.

Reconciliation on 2026-10-31: merged main `812a8c7ccb` and reconciled with #15871's split of the Managed Agent server into nine Maven modules. The seed drops, the write-back prunes and the host-cache purge now cover the full in-house coordinate set; the purge globs `qwen-managed-agent-*` so a future module rename cannot leave a stale host copy behind. All four unique behaviors are retained: the host-cache purge, the seed nesting fix, the self-hosted Checkstyle repository, and the reference-release seed isolation. When #15274 lands, this branch reconciles against its delivered code again.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Open the `SDK Java (fast) / ubuntu-latest / Java 21` job of a PR that touches a managed-agent path. The self-hosted step should show the `cp -aln` seed and all three Maven invocations before any `Waiting for the sdk-java host lock` line; the lock wait should appear only at the cache write-back, and the write-back should remove the in-house coordinates before copying. Grep the job-local repository for `maven-metadata-local.xml` after the suite: it should hold only job-produced files.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: a seeded `maven-metadata-local.xml` and a seeded `qwencode-sdk` jar were the same inode as the host cache, so the unlocked `mvn install` changed the host file (same inode, SHA and mtime both moved). After: the host file is byte- and mtime-identical while the job-local copy is still written, the write-back publishes zero bookkeeping files and never the in-house coordinates, and the host cache loses the pre-PR in-house trees. N/A for UI.

### Tested on

|     OS     |                       Status                        |
| :--------: | :-------------------------------------------------: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ meta-tests (367 passed, 11 Linux-only skipped), shell probes, Prettier |
| 🪟 Windows |                   ⚠️ not tested                    |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ CI is authoritative for the Linux-only behavioral legs; earlier heads ran the full meta-tests there |

### Environment (optional)

Meta-tests at head `28eedc0e1a` (macOS): `scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js`, `scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js`, `scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js` — 367 passed, 11 skipped (the Linux-only behavioral legs run in CI). Local shell probes confirmed the nine-coordinate any-depth prune, the five-name exclusion and the glob host purge. No JDK 21 / Maven locally, so the real Java suite is left to CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a cold host pays the seed cost once, and the write-back is best-effort and capped at 300 seconds, matching the MariaDB lane. The write-back also deletes pre-existing in-house copies from the host cache — intended, because they are the stale fixed-release jars the in-house prune exists to stop publishing.
- Not validated / out of scope: the real ECS pool and its ticketed lock queue; the full JDK 21 Maven suite; the MySQL / MariaDB integration lanes; the hosted legs.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design documents: [English](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Related to #15281 (the lock-scope change landed through #15128 and #15254; this PR closes the cache-isolation gap that the smaller lock scope depends on).

prs.title: refactor(web-shell): share session view reset state
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR consolidates the shared transcript-view reset used by session changes and `/clear`. It also makes the component contract explicit: when a consumer keeps the same transcript component mounted across a session-key change, a reading pause from the previous session is cleared. A reconnect within the same session continues to preserve that pause.

## Why it's needed

The two reset paths maintained overlapping state independently. Sharing their common reset keeps those paths consistent and covers the component's mount-stable session-switch contract. The shipped routes already remount the transcript or render an empty transcript when switching sessions, so this is component-level hardening, not a demonstrated user-visible fix on those routes.

The main-CI failure tracked in #15038 is an unhandled rejection in the hosted workspace tool-turn tests. This Web Shell change does not fix that failure and must not close its tracker.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Keep one transcript component mounted, pause following, and change its session key while supplying the next session's non-empty transcript. Following should resume, both with and without a replay transition.
- Reconnect within the same session after pausing. The reading position should remain paused.
- Clear the transcript within the same session. The existing clear/reset behavior should remain intact.
- Treat the session-switch DOM cases as component-contract coverage; the shipped routes' remount/empty-first behavior is not a before/after reproduction of this change.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Earlier review reports establish that the added DOM cases fail without the session-switch pause reset and pass with it. The same reports establish that shipped-route-shaped cases already pass on the base. Those historical results support the component contract only; they are not new validation of the current head.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | No local checks run in this closeout |
| Windows | No local checks run in this closeout |
| Linux | Earlier DOM evidence is recorded in the PR discussion; the previous head's smoke check failed and checks for this closeout are pending |

## Risk & Scope

- The shared reset clears reading-pause, pagination-snapshot and expansion state. Each caller retains its additional resets; the settled-stale latch is cleared by `/clear`, not by the render-phase session switch.
- This PR changes no shipped route's mounting or empty-transcript behavior and does not repair the hosted workspace tool-turn failure.
- No local tests, build, lint or typecheck were run during this closeout, as requested. The previous smoke failure is reported separately and checks for the new head are pending; no passing browser result is claimed.
- No public API or migration change.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15038; this PR does not resolve it.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

合并会话切换与 `/clear` 共用的视图重置逻辑，并明确组件契约：调用方若在切换 session key 时保留同一个消息列表实例，上一会话的阅读暂停状态会被清除。同一会话重连仍保留阅读暂停。

## 为什么需要

两条路径原先分别维护重叠的重置状态。共用重置逻辑可以保持行为一致，并补全不重建组件时的会话切换契约。当前已发布页面在切换会话时会重建消息列表，或先渲染空记录，因此本 PR 是组件层加固，不是已证实的现有页面可见缺陷修复。

#15038 跟踪的是 hosted workspace tool-turn 测试中的未处理拒绝。该 Web Shell 改动不能修复此 CI 故障，也不应自动关闭它。

## Reviewer 测试计划

- 保持消息列表实例不变，暂停跟随后，改变 session key 并传入下一会话的非空记录。有回放与无回放两种情况下都应恢复跟随。
- 同一会话暂停后重连，应继续保持阅读位置。
- 在同一会话清空记录，原有清空和重置行为应保持。
- 新增 DOM 用例验证组件契约；已发布页面重建组件或先清空记录的路径不能作为本改动的前后对照复现。

## 已有证据与验证边界

此前评审记录表明，移除会话切换时的暂停重置会使新增 DOM 用例失败，保留时通过；按已发布页面形态编写的对照用例在 base 上原本就通过。这些历史结果只支撑组件契约，不代表本轮重新验证了当前 head。

本轮按用户要求未运行本地测试、构建、lint 或 typecheck。上一 head 的 Web Shell smoke 失败另行记录，新 head 的检查尚未完成；未声称浏览器验证通过。macOS 与 Windows 本轮均未验证，Linux 既有 DOM 证据见 PR 讨论。

## 风险与范围

公共重置处理阅读暂停、分页快照和展开状态；调用方保留各自额外的重置。settled-stale 状态只在 `/clear` 路径清除，不在渲染期会话切换路径清除。本 PR 不改变页面挂载方式，也不修复 hosted workspace tool-turn 故障。无公共 API 或迁移变更。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #15038；本 PR 不解决该 issue。

</details>


### Latest repair

The latest repair also cancels old-session follow/animation callbacks and strengthens continued-follow assertions. It carries the two smoke selector corrections already landed in #15860. These new cases were not run locally; current-head CI remains pending.

transcript stranded above the latest content even though the reader never
paused it. Drop the pause in the existing session-scoped reset.

prs.title: fix(core): treat `git remote show` without -n as non-read-only (auto-mode egress bypass, #14359)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

`git remote show` is classified read-only, so in `auto` mode it is auto-approved on the read-only fast path and never reaches the permission classifier. But `git remote show` queries the remote over the network (`git-upload-pack`, i.e. `GET <url>/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack`) unless `-n` is given, and it accepts a raw URL argument — so it is a network side effect, not a local lookup.

This PR makes `git remote show` read-only only when `-n` (do not query remotes) is present; otherwise it is classified `unknown` and routed to the classifier / approval. `git remote show -n …` and `git remote get-url` (which never connects) keep their read-only classification.

Fixes #14359.

## Why deny-by-default (not a URL heuristic)

The original report suggested keying on whether the argument is "URL-shaped". Triage and maintainer review both flagged that an under-detecting heuristic (git accepts `scheme://…`, scp-like `user@host:path`, and local paths) would silently re-open the hole on any form it misses — the failure mode a security boundary most wants to avoid. Deny-by-default needs no URL parser and has no under-detection gap; the cost is that `git remote show origin` now goes to review (in `auto` that is a classifier call that normally allows it; in `default` it is one prompt).

## Both evaluators are fixed

There are two independent git read-only allowlists with the same gap, and the regex checker is the fallback used when the WASM parser is unavailable, so a fix confined to one path leaves the other open:

- `evaluateGitSafety` — `packages/core/src/utils/shellAstParser.ts` (AST path)
- `evaluateGitRemoteArgs` — `packages/core/src/utils/shellReadOnlyChecker.ts` (regex fallback, reached via `parserInitFailed` / `catch`)

Both scan the arguments for `-n` only up to the first `--` or `--end-of-options` (git ends option parsing at either one; R6-1), so a `-n` that lands after a terminator — where git treats it as a positional remote name and still queries — correctly stays non-read-only.

The AST path reads each argument's raw text (only one matching pair of outer quotes is stripped), but bash removes quotes and backslashes before git runs, so `\--`, `''--`, `--""` or `$'--'` reach git as the `--` terminator without looking like one there. A `git remote show` with any argument that still holds a quote or backslash is therefore routed to review as well. The regex path already sees bash's words for quotes and backslashes (shell-quote removes them), so those spellings needed no change there. Bracket globs are the exception (triage `/review` R4-1): shell-quote leaves `[--][--]` as plain text, but bash expands it to a real `--` when the cwd holds a file named `--`. So on the regex path, a `git remote show` with any argument containing `[` is also not read-only. Every `[` is refused, not only shapes that reduce to `--`, because bracket expressions such as `[]-]` and `[[:punct:]]` also match `-` (R5-3). The AST path already returns `unknown` for glob tokens.

## Test plan

- New cases in `shellAstParser.test.ts` and `shellReadOnlyChecker.test.ts`:
  - non-read-only: `git remote show`, `git remote show origin`, `git remote show <url>` (incl. scp-like), and the terminator forms `git remote show origin -- -n` / `git remote show -- -n <url>`;
  - read-only (preserved): `git remote show -n …`, the post-positional `git remote show <remote> -n`, and `git remote get-url origin`.
  - The two terminator / post-positional spellings were added after review (triage `/review` R1-1/R1-2 and doudouOUC) to pin premises the guard depends on; both engines already return the correct verdict, so the cases pass on pristine source and go red only under a dropped-terminator / leading-options-only narrowing.
  - quoted / escaped terminators (added after triage `/review` R2-1): `\--`, `\-\-`, `""--`, `--""`, `''--`, `'-'-` and `$'--'`, each followed by `-n`, are non-read-only in the AST suite. All nine were red before the guard (9 failed / 805 passed) and are green with it; `git remote show -n "origin"` pins that a fully quoted remote name stays read-only. After triage `/review` R4-2, all seven are also in the cross-checker `sharedCases`, so the regex and AST answers must agree on each. `$'--'` is rejected on the regex path only by the NUL guard, and its row is now the git-remote case that goes red if that guard is relaxed.
  - bracket-glob terminators (added after triage `/review` R4-1): `git remote show origin [--][--] -n` and `git remote show origin [-]- -n` (in `sharedCases`), plus `git remote show <url> [-]- -n` (regex suite), are non-read-only. The four new assertions were red before the bracket check (4 failed / 819 passed) and are green with it. Mutation check: dropping the bracket check reddens exactly those four, and dropping the NUL guard reddens the `$'--'` row.
  - after triage `/review` round 5: `* -n`, `?? -n` and `{--,x} -n` (refused on the regex path by the argument guard), plus `[]-]- -n` and `[[:punct:]]- -n`, are pinned in `sharedCases` and the regex suite (R5-1, R5-3). Some forms are recorded as per-side `[divergence]` tests (R5-2): the quoted-terminator forms such as `-n ''--`, where the regex checker says read-only and the AST checker fails closed, and the quoted IPv6 URL `-n 'ssh://[::1]/repo'`, where it is the other way round. All of them pass on the current code. Mutation check: each of these turns some of them red: dropping the guard's brace clause, dropping `git` from its root list, a bracket veto narrowed to shapes that reduce to `--`, dropping the AST quote veto, or making the regex side refuse any `--`.
  - after triage `/review` round 6 (R6-1): `git remote show <url> --end-of-options -n` and `git remote show --end-of-options <url> -n` are non-read-only in both suites, `git remote show origin --end-of-options -n` is in `sharedCases`, and `git remote show -n --end-of-options origin` stays read-only. Measured with git 2.55 against a loopback listener: both `--end-of-options` forms query the remote, and the `-n`-first form does not. Mutation check: reverting either engine's terminator change reddens that engine's 2 rows plus the `sharedCases` row; an over-block that refuses any `--end-of-options` reddens the 2 read-only rows. The two affected suites are 848/848 after this change.
- `npx vitest run src/utils src/permissions src/followup src/core src/memory src/tools src/services` (every consumer of the read-only verdict) → 21874 passed / 32 skipped. The three failures are unrelated to this change: `src/memory/recall-scan-latency.test.ts` is a timing test that passes 3/3 when run alone, and the two `bun-pty.node-bun.test.ts` cases fail the same way on a checkout without this change (local Bun 1.3.14). The two affected suites are 839/839 after the R5 changes.
- prettier, eslint, and `tsc --noEmit` on `packages/core` are clean.

| command | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `git remote show origin` | read-only (auto-run in auto) | unknown (review) |
| `git remote show` (no name) | read-only | unknown (review) — see Risk & scope |
| `git remote show https://host/x` | read-only | unknown (review) |
| `git remote show origin -- -n` | read-only | unknown (review) |
| `git remote show origin \-- -n` | read-only | unknown (review) |
| `git remote show -n origin` | read-only | read-only |
| `git remote show origin -n` | read-only | read-only |
| `git remote get-url origin` | read-only | read-only |
| `git remote -v` | read-only | read-only |

## Risk & scope

Moving `git remote show` (without `-n`) off the read-only fast path changes behavior in a few consumers of the read-only verdict. Most go from silent to prompted, which is the intent; two are worth calling out so they are accepted on purpose:

- **`auto` mode:** `git remote show` without `-n` now goes to review (classifier / approval) instead of auto-running. `git remote -v`, `git remote show -n`, and `git remote get-url` are unaffected.
- **Plan mode:** the command is treated as `unknown`, i.e. a warning plus approval — not a hard block — so Plan-mode investigation is not regressed.
- **Memory-scoped agents** (`packages/core/src/memory/memory-scoped-agent-config.ts`) map the verdict as `isReadOnly ? 'allow' : 'deny'`, with no approval surface. So a memory-scoped agent's `git remote show origin` goes from silently allowed to a hard **deny** rather than a prompt. This is intended: that context already denies `git fetch`, and the whole point of the fix is that this command has a network side effect — but it is a second behavior change beyond the `auto`-mode one, called out here so it is a conscious decision.
- **Bare `git remote show` (no remote name)** does not actually connect — it prints the configured remotes, like `-n`. It is nonetheless kept non-read-only: deny-by-default deliberately classifies on the presence of `-n` rather than on argument shape, so we do not special-case the nameless form. The cost is one extra prompt (or, in the subsystems above, a deny) on a harmless command; the benefit is no shape-matching logic that a future form could slip past.
- **Quotes or backslashes inside an argument** (e.g. `git remote show -n o'rigin'`) also send `git remote show` to review, even with `-n`. Normal spellings, including a fully quoted remote name such as `"origin"`, are unaffected. On the regex fallback, an argument containing `[` does the same; the AST path already treated it as a glob. That includes a quoted bracket such as `git remote show -n 'ssh://[::1]/repo'`, which the AST path keeps read-only. Git refuses `[` in remote names, so a configured remote never hits this.
- No change to allow/deny rule handling; no public API change.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14359

---

## 中文

### 这个 PR 做了什么

`git remote show` 被判为只读,因此在 `auto` 模式下走只读快速通道自动放行,不经过权限分类器。但除非带 `-n`,`git remote show` 会通过 `git-upload-pack` 联网查询远端(即 `GET <url>/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack`),且接受任意 URL 作为参数——这是网络副作用,而非本地查询。

本 PR 仅当带 `-n`(不查询远端)时才把 `git remote show` 判为只读,否则判为 `unknown`,交由分类器/审批。`git remote show -n …` 与不联网的 `git remote get-url` 保持只读。Fixes #14359。

### 为什么用默认拒绝(而非 URL 启发式)

原报告建议按“参数是否形似 URL”来判断。triage 与维护者复核都指出:识别不全的启发式(git 接受 `scheme://…`、scp 风格 `user@host:path`、本地路径)会在漏判的写法上悄悄重开缺口——这是安全边界最该避免的失败方式。默认拒绝无需 URL 解析、没有漏判缺口,代价是 `git remote show origin` 现在会走审批(`auto` 下是一次通常会放行的分类器调用;`default` 下是一次确认)。

### 两个评估器都已修复

存在两个独立且同样有此缺口的 git 只读白名单,且正则检查器是 WASM 解析器不可用时的回退路径,只改一处会留下另一处:`shellAstParser.ts` 的 `evaluateGitSafety`(AST 路径)、`shellReadOnlyChecker.ts` 的 `evaluateGitRemoteArgs`(经 `parserInitFailed`/`catch` 回退)。两处都只在第一个 `--` 或 `--end-of-options` 之前扫描 `-n`(git 遇到其中任一个都会停止解析选项;R6-1),因此落在终止符之后的 `-n`(git 会把它当作位置参数远端名、仍然联网)会正确地保持非只读。

AST 路径读的是每个参数的原始文本(只去掉一层成对的外层引号),而 bash 在运行 git 之前会去掉引号和反斜杠,所以 `\--`、`''--`、`--""`、`$'--'` 到了 git 那里都是 `--` 终止符,在原始文本里却不像。因此只要 `git remote show` 有参数仍含引号或反斜杠,也一律交给审批。对引号和反斜杠,正则路径看到的已经是 bash 处理后的词(shell-quote 会去掉它们),这些写法不用改。方括号 glob 是例外(triage `/review` R4-1):shell-quote 会把 `[--][--]` 原样留成普通文本,但当前目录里有名为 `--` 的文件时,bash 会把它展开成真正的 `--`。因此在正则路径上,只要 `git remote show` 有参数含 `[`,也判为非只读。这里拒绝所有含 `[` 的参数,而不只是能归一成 `--` 的形态,因为 `[]-]`、`[[:punct:]]` 这类方括号表达式同样匹配 `-`(R5-3)。AST 路径本来就对 glob 词元返回 `unknown`。

### 测试

两个测试文件新增用例:非只读——`git remote show`、`git remote show origin`、`git remote show <url>`(含 scp 形式),以及终止符形式 `git remote show origin -- -n` / `git remote show -- -n <url>`;只读(保持不变)——`git remote show -n …`、后置的 `git remote show <remote> -n`、`git remote get-url origin`。后两种(终止符 / 后置 `-n`)是按 review(triage `/review` R1-1/R1-2 与 doudouOUC)补的,用于钉住该判断所依赖的前提;两个引擎本就返回正确结果,所以在原始代码上即通过,只有在"丢掉终止符 / 只扫前置选项"的收紧下才会变红。按 triage `/review` R2-1 又补了加引号 / 反斜杠的终止符:`\--`、`\-\-`、`""--`、`--""`、`''--`、`'-'-`、`$'--'`(后面都跟 `-n`)在 AST 套件里判为非只读;这 9 条在加守卫前全红(9 失败 / 805 通过),加守卫后全绿;`git remote show -n "origin"` 钉住整体加引号的远端名仍是只读。按 triage `/review` R4-2,这 7 种写法现在都放进了跨实现的 `sharedCases`,要求正则与 AST 逐条结论一致;其中 `$'--'` 在正则路径上只靠 NUL 守卫拒掉,这一行就是放松该守卫时会变红的 git-remote 用例。按 triage `/review` R4-1 补了方括号 glob 终止符:`git remote show origin [--][--] -n`、`git remote show origin [-]- -n`(在 `sharedCases`)以及 `git remote show <url> [-]- -n`(正则套件)判为非只读;这 4 条新断言在加方括号判断前全红(4 失败 / 819 通过),加上后全绿。变异验证:去掉方括号判断,恰好这 4 条变红;去掉 NUL 守卫,`$'--'` 这一行变红。按 triage `/review` 第 5 轮:`* -n`、`?? -n`、`{--,x} -n`(正则路径上由参数守卫拒掉)以及 `[]-]- -n`、`[[:punct:]]- -n` 已钉进 `sharedCases` 和正则套件(R5-1、R5-3)。另有两类写法记成按侧断言的 `[divergence]` 测试(R5-2):一类是 `-n ''--` 等加引号的终止符写法,正则判只读、AST 失败关闭;另一类是加引号的 IPv6 URL `-n 'ssh://[::1]/repo'`,两边结论正好相反。这些用例在当前代码上都通过。变异验证:去掉守卫的花括号子句、从其根命令列表去掉 `git`、把方括号否决收窄到能归一成 `--` 的形态、去掉 AST 的引号否决、让正则一侧拒绝任何 `--`,每一种都会让其中一部分变红。`npx vitest run src/utils src/permissions src/followup src/core src/memory src/tools src/services`(覆盖所有读取只读判定的地方)21874 通过 / 32 跳过;3 个失败与本改动无关:`src/memory/recall-scan-latency.test.ts` 是计时测试,单独运行 3/3 通过;`bun-pty.node-bun.test.ts` 的两个用例在不含本改动的检出上同样失败(本地 Bun 1.3.14);R5 修改后两个相关套件为 839/839;prettier/eslint/tsc 均通过。按 triage `/review` 第 6 轮(R6-1):`git remote show <url> --end-of-options -n` 和 `git remote show --end-of-options <url> -n` 在两个套件里都判为非只读,`git remote show origin --end-of-options -n` 加进 `sharedCases`,`git remote show -n --end-of-options origin` 保持只读。用 git 2.55 加本机回环监听实测:两种 `--end-of-options` 写法都会联网,`-n` 在前的写法不会。变异验证:回退任一引擎的终止符处理,该引擎的 2 条用例和 `sharedCases` 那一行变红;改成一见 `--end-of-options` 就拒绝,2 条只读用例变红。R6 修改后两个相关套件为 848/848。

### 风险 / 范围

把 `git remote show`(无 `-n`)移出只读快速通道,会影响几个读取只读判定的消费者。多数从"静默"变为"弹审批",正是意图;其中两处值得点明,以便有意识地接受:

- **`auto` 模式**:无 `-n` 的 `git remote show` 改走审批(分类器/确认),不再自动执行;`git remote -v`、`git remote show -n`、`git remote get-url` 不受影响。
- **Plan 模式**:判为 `unknown`,即"警告 + 审批",而非硬阻断,所以不会回退 Plan 模式下的排查能力。
- **内存作用域 agent**(`packages/core/src/memory/memory-scoped-agent-config.ts`)按 `isReadOnly ? 'allow' : 'deny'` 映射,没有审批入口。所以内存作用域 agent 的 `git remote show origin` 会从静默放行变成硬**拒绝**,而不是弹提示。这是预期的:该上下文本来就拒绝 `git fetch`,而本修复的要点正是这条命令有网络副作用——但它是 `auto` 之外的第二处行为变化,在此点明,以便是有意识的决定。
- **裸 `git remote show`(无远端名)** 实际上并不联网——它只打印已配置的远端,与 `-n` 相同。但仍保持非只读:默认拒绝刻意按"是否带 `-n`"而非"参数形状"来判定,所以不对无名形式做特判。代价是对一条无害命令多一次审批(或在上述子系统里是一次拒绝),收益是不引入任何未来写法可能绕过的形状匹配逻辑。
- **参数中间含引号或反斜杠**(如 `git remote show -n o'rigin'`)时,即使带 `-n`,`git remote show` 也会走审批。正常写法(包括整体加引号的远端名如 `"origin"`)不受影响。在正则回退路径上,参数含 `[` 时同样如此;AST 路径本来就把它当作 glob。这也包括加引号的方括号,如 `git remote show -n 'ssh://[::1]/repo'`,AST 路径对它仍判只读。git 不允许远端名含 `[`,所以已配置的远端不会碰到这种情况。
- 不改 allow/deny 规则处理;无公共 API 变更。

prs.title: feat(skills): add file-backed archive installation kernel (1/4)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A Skill ZIP can be too large for the current installation request even when the archive itself is valid. This PR prepares the installer to consume a ZIP from disk, so the following PRs can add larger uploads without putting the entire compressed archive into a JSON body or an in-memory buffer.

This is the installation layer of the four-part split. **Merging this PR alone does not enable 20 MiB uploads in the browser:** the new HTTP entry points, SDK calls and UI arrive in #16422–#16424. The existing installation paths do pick up the ZIP-reader upgrade and the recovery-backup protection described below.

### What changes, and why each change is needed

| Change | What it does | Why it is needed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Prepare a private ZIP file | Accepts a stream or copies a regular ZIP file from the daemon's host into a temporary file owned by the installer. Counts actual bytes, computes SHA-256, optionally checks an expected digest, and detects ordinary changes to the source during copying. | Extraction needs stable input while waiting and running. The caller keeps ownership of the original ZIP; installer cleanup removes its own temporary copy. |
| Extract directly from disk | Opens the prepared ZIP on disk and writes entries incrementally into the existing staging area. Checks actual extracted bytes, entry count, paths, duplicate/conflicting entries and special files before publishing the installation. | Avoids loading the complete compressed ZIP into memory and gives the new input path explicit resource limits. A small compressed ZIP can still expand into a very large package. |
| Support cancellation while waiting or extracting | A waiting operation can stop promptly. Cancelling that waiter does not let the next caller jump past the operation currently holding the shared lock. Active extraction settles its file write before the operation releases ownership. | Otherwise a cancelled install could keep waiting unnecessarily, or a later install could start while the previous one is still writing. |
| Identify when replacement actually commits | Provides a final check immediately before replacement starts and a notification after the new installation is committed, before best-effort backup cleanup. Once replacement is admitted, a late cancellation signal does not interrupt it halfway through. | The next PR needs a reliable point at which to record installation success, even if the HTTP response is lost. This PR supplies those boundaries; receipt storage and lookup are added in #16422. |
| Preserve material needed for recovery | If replacing an existing Skill fails, the installer attempts to restore the previous installation. If restoration cannot be confirmed, it reports a recovery-required error with retained paths. A later install preserves abandoned backups; successful installs still remove the backup they created. | An abandoned backup may be the only recoverable copy. Previously, a later install's artifact cleanup could remove it. This protection applies to ZIP, folder and GitHub installs. |

The new acquisition/extraction path uses the following limits. Existing sources retain their existing limits.

| Limit | Existing base64 ZIP | New file acquisition/extraction path |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Compressed ZIP | 7,864,071 bytes, constrained by the 10 MiB JSON request | 50 MiB |
| Extracted content retained on disk | 64 MiB total; 32 MiB per file | 200 MiB total; ordinary resources may use the remaining total |
| Entries | 2,000 retained files | 4,096 ZIP records, counting directories and ignored metadata before filtering |
| Root Skill entry document | 32 MiB | 32 MiB |

The CLI ZIP reader is also upgraded from yauzl 2.10 to 3.4. The original implementation investigation reproduced a file-input stall on Node 26.7: a valid 70 MiB resource stopped partway through extraction with 2.10, while the same archive completed with 3.4. This is the reason for the dependency change. The existing base64 extraction path uses that dependency too, so its regression tests are included.

## Why it's needed

The existing browser upload encodes ZIP bytes as base64 inside JSON. Base64 adds roughly one third to the size: a **20 MiB ZIP becomes about 26.7 MiB of base64**, before JSON metadata, and exceeds the shared **10 MiB JSON limit**. The goal is to support that archive size while keeping the shared JSON limit unchanged.

There is a second limit after transport: a valid archive containing a 70 MiB resource still exceeds the existing 32 MiB per-file and 64 MiB total extraction limits. The new path therefore needs both disk-based input and its own extraction budget. Raising the JSON limit alone would leave the complete archive buffered and would not address those extraction limits.

The original #15862 combined installation, HTTP behavior, SDK transport and browser UX. This split lets reviewers assess filesystem changes, cancellation ordering and recovery first, before reviewing how they are exposed to clients.

| Order | PR | Responsibility |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **#16421 — this PR** | Prepare and extract the archive; provide cancellation, commit and recovery behavior |
| 2 | #16422 | Expose raw-upload/host-file APIs, advertise limits and store/query installation receipts |
| 3 | #16423 | Expose those operations through the TypeScript SDK |
| 4 | #16424 | Connect browser File uploads, result checking and older-daemon fallback |

Each successor targets the preceding branch. After a predecessor lands, synchronize and retarget the next PR to main, then run normal PR CI before merging. The normal CI branch filter currently covers the first PR's main base, not the three stacked bases.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Install an existing small base64 ZIP, folder and GitHub source. Their source validation and size limits should remain unchanged.
- Prepare a ZIP from a host file, then replace the original after copying completes. Extraction should use the private copy; cleanup must preserve the caller's original path. A detected mid-copy change or mismatched expected digest should fail before extraction.
- Exercise the new boundaries: 50 MiB compressed input is accepted and one more byte rejected; 200 MiB of retained extracted content is accepted and one more byte rejected; the 4,097th ZIP record is rejected. Duplicate/conflicting paths and links must not overwrite staged content.
- Keep installation A holding the lock, queue B, cancel B, then queue C. B should stop without running its work; C must wait until A finishes.
- Cancel during extraction. The candidate should not become the installed Skill, and cleanup must wait for active writes to settle. Cancel after replacement has been admitted: the replacement should finish and report its committed outcome.
- Replace an existing Skill and inject a failure before completion. The old installation should be restored when possible. If restoring it also fails, the error must identify retained recovery material, and a later install must preserve that backup.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for browser screenshots at this layer; the public upload flow is delivered later.

At exact head `d94a429f3961cafd60495870c66015ca4be550de`, root build, root typecheck, formatting and targeted ESLint passed. **296 focused tests passed:** 202 shared-filesystem tests, 66 existing Skill-management tests, 17 native-archive tests, 7 input-acquisition tests and 4 lock tests. These cover both the new path and existing consumers of the shared lock and ZIP reader.

The [separate final-stack E2E report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16424#issuecomment-6675739412) records 12 real HTTP and 4 terminal Chromium cases, including real 20 MiB installation and cancellation without retransmission. Those results apply to cumulative head `0da85ad2db65ea7eb7bd0241841c57b40d20fb7a`, including all four PRs; they do not imply this first PR exposes the complete feature.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Build, typecheck and 296 focused tests |
| 🪟 Windows | Not run locally |
| 🐧 Linux | Not run locally |

### Environment (optional)

macOS 26.6.2 arm64, Node.js 26.7.0, pnpm 11.24.0; isolated worktree. Split source: #15862 at `780f1c6a08b493232adda97f235558121c4412b9`. Branch creation baseline: main at `7bd78683e63a50334fbcb124568101868048264c`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the shared lock and ZIP dependency also serve existing operations, so their regression behavior matters. Copying a host ZIP adds temporary disk usage. Metadata checks do not make a concurrently modified source an atomic snapshot: callers must keep it stable while copying, and can provide an expected digest. Preserved recovery backups may require manual cleanup after recovery.
- Not validated / out of scope: HTTP/SDK/UI exposure belongs to the next three PRs. This layer adds no cross-process lock, automatic retry, resumable upload or durable recovery journal. The local Node 26.7 test result does not establish that the earlier Node 22/24 cancellation-stream report is resolved. Prior review dispositions and deferred suggestions remain in #15862.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: existing request formats, the shared JSON limit and legacy source size limits remain unchanged. The deliberate change to existing installations is preservation of abandoned recovery backups and an explicit error when restoration cannot be confirmed.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/d94a429f3961cafd60495870c66015ca4be550de/docs/design/2026-10-29-skill-archive-installation.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/d94a429f3961cafd60495870c66015ca4be550de/docs/design/2026-10-29-skill-archive-installation.zh-CN.md). Both describe the complete design and identify each PR's delivery boundary.

## Linked Issues

Split from #15862; follows #15030.

<details>
<summary>中文说明（完整背景、改动与验证）</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

一个内容有效的 Skill ZIP，也可能因为现有安装请求的大小限制而无法安装。本 PR 让安装器能够直接处理磁盘上的 ZIP，为后续支持大包上传做准备，避免把整个压缩包放进 JSON 请求或内存 Buffer。

这是四个拆分 PR 中的安装器层。**只合入本 PR，浏览器还不能上传 20 MiB ZIP**：新的 HTTP 入口、SDK 调用和界面接入由 #16422–#16424 提供。现有安装流程会用到下述 ZIP 读取库升级和恢复备份保护。

### 具体改了什么，为什么需要

| 改动 | 实际行为 | 解决的问题 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 准备安装器自己的 ZIP 副本 | 接收输入流，或把 daemon 所在主机上的普通 ZIP 文件复制到安装器持有的临时文件。按实际字节计数、计算 SHA-256，可校验调用方提供的预期摘要，并检测复制期间常见的源文件变化。 | 等待和解压期间需要稳定输入。原 ZIP 仍属于调用方，安装器清理的是自己的临时副本。 |
| 直接从磁盘解压 | 打开准备好的磁盘 ZIP，逐条目写入现有暂存区；安装生效前检查实际展开字节、条目数、路径、重复或冲突条目及特殊文件。 | 不必把完整压缩包读入内存，同时给新来源明确的资源上限。压缩包很小，也可能展开成很大的内容。 |
| 支持等待和解压期间取消 | 等锁的操作可以及时退出；取消这个排队者不会让下一位绕过当前持锁者。正在解压时，会等活动文件写入结束，再释放操作所有权。 | 避免已取消的安装继续无谓排队，也避免下一次安装在前一次仍写文件时就开始执行。 |
| 明确替换何时完成 | 在开始替换旧安装前提供最后一次检查，在新安装已提交、尽力清理备份之前发出完成通知。替换一旦获准开始，迟到的取消信号不会将它中途打断。 | 后一 PR 需要一个可信的时间点来记录“安装已成功”，即使 HTTP 响应丢失也能查询。本 PR 提供这些阶段边界；回执存储和查询由 #16422 实现。 |
| 保留失败恢复需要的材料 | 替换已有 Skill 失败时，尝试恢复旧安装。无法确认恢复成功时，返回需要恢复的错误及保留路径。后续安装会保留遗留备份；正常成功的安装仍会删除自己产生的备份。 | 遗留备份可能是唯一可恢复的旧副本。此前后续安装清理遗留文件时，可能把它一并删除。这项保护同时适用于 ZIP、目录和 GitHub 安装。 |

新的获取和解压路径采用以下限额；现有来源继续使用原有限额。

| 限制 | 现有 base64 ZIP | 新的文件获取与解压路径 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 压缩 ZIP 大小 | 7,864,071 字节，受 10 MiB JSON 请求上限约束 | 50 MiB |
| 解压后实际保留的内容 | 总量 64 MiB，单文件 32 MiB | 总量 200 MiB，普通资源可使用剩余总量 |
| 条目数 | 2,000 个保留文件 | 4,096 条 ZIP 记录，过滤前计数，含目录和被忽略的元数据 |
| 根 Skill 入口文档 | 32 MiB | 32 MiB |

CLI 使用的 ZIP 读取库也从 yauzl 2.10 升级到 3.4。原实现调查在 Node 26.7 上复现了磁盘文件输入挂起：一个有效的 70 MiB 资源用 2.10 解压到一半停止，同一归档用 3.4 能完成。这是升级依赖的原因。旧 base64 解压路径也使用该依赖，因此一并执行了其回归测试。

## 为什么需要

现有浏览器上传会先把 ZIP 字节转换为 base64，再放进 JSON。Base64 大约增加三分之一体积：**20 MiB ZIP 编码后约为 26.7 MiB**，尚未计算 JSON 元数据，就已经超过共享的 **10 MiB JSON 上限**。目标是在保持该共享上限的同时，支持这类归档。

传输之后还有另一层限制：一个含 70 MiB 资源的有效归档，也会超过现有单文件 32 MiB、总量 64 MiB 的解压上限。因此新路径需要磁盘文件输入和独立的解压预算。只提高 JSON 上限，仍然需要缓冲整个压缩包，也没有解决解压限额。

原 #15862 同时包含安装器、HTTP 行为、SDK 传输和浏览器交互。现在先独立审查文件系统改动、取消顺序和失败恢复，再审查这些能力如何提供给客户端。

| 顺序 | PR | 职责 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **#16421，即本 PR** | 准备和解压归档，提供取消、提交和恢复行为 |
| 2 | #16422 | 提供原生上传和主机文件 API、宣告限额、存储与查询安装回执 |
| 3 | #16423 | 通过 TypeScript SDK 提供上述操作 |
| 4 | #16424 | 接入浏览器 File 上传、结果检查及旧 daemon 回退 |

后续每个 PR 都以前一层分支为目标。前一层合入后，将下一层同步并改为 main，再运行常规 PR CI 后合入。目前常规 CI 的分支筛选覆盖第一层的 main 目标，不覆盖后三个叠加分支目标。

## 审查验证计划

### 如何验证

- 安装原有的小 base64 ZIP、目录和 GitHub 来源；来源校验与大小限制应保持原行为。
- 从主机文件准备 ZIP，复制完成后替换原文件；解压应使用私有副本，清理不得删除调用方的原路径。检测到复制中途变化或预期摘要不匹配时，应在解压前失败。
- 检查新边界：压缩输入 50 MiB 接受、多 1 字节拒绝；实际保留的展开内容 200 MiB 接受、多 1 字节拒绝；第 4,097 条 ZIP 记录被拒绝。重复或冲突路径、链接不得覆盖暂存内容。
- 让安装 A 持有锁，B 排队后取消，再让 C 排队；B 应退出且不执行自己的任务，C 必须等 A 完成。
- 在解压期间取消；候选内容不应成为已安装的 Skill，清理须等待活动写入结束。在替换获准开始后取消，替换应继续完成并报告已提交结果。
- 替换已有 Skill，并在完成前注入失败；应尽可能恢复旧安装。如果恢复本身也失败，错误须指出保留的恢复材料，后续安装必须保留该备份。

### 改动前后证据

本层不适用浏览器截图；对外上传流程由后续 PR 交付。

精确提交 `d94a429f3961cafd60495870c66015ca4be550de` 的根目录构建、类型检查、格式检查及定向 ESLint 均通过。**296 个定向测试全部通过**：共享文件系统 202 个、既有 Skill 管理 66 个、原生归档 17 个、输入获取 7 个、互斥锁 4 个，同时覆盖新路径和共享锁、ZIP 读取库的原有消费者。

[单独的整组 E2E 报告](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16424#issuecomment-6675739412) 记录了 12 个真实 HTTP 用例和 4 个 Chromium 终态用例，包括真实 20 MiB 安装及取消后查询且不重传。这些结果对应包含四个 PR 的累计提交 `0da85ad2db65ea7eb7bd0241841c57b40d20fb7a`，不表示本 PR 单独暴露了完整功能。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 构建、类型检查及 296 个定向测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | 未在本地执行 |
| 🐧 Linux | 未在本地执行 |

### 环境

macOS 26.6.2 arm64、Node.js 26.7.0、pnpm 11.24.0，独立 worktree。拆分来源为 #15862 的 `780f1c6a08b493232adda97f235558121c4412b9`；创建分支时的 main 基线为 `7bd78683e63a50334fbcb124568101868048264c`。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：共享锁和 ZIP 依赖也服务于现有操作，因此需要关注回归行为。复制主机 ZIP 会增加临时磁盘占用。元数据检查不能把被并发修改的来源变成原子快照；调用方仍须在复制期间保持来源稳定，并可提供预期摘要。保留的恢复备份可能需要在恢复完成后手动清理。
- 未验证或不在范围内：HTTP、SDK 和界面接入属于后续三个 PR。本层不增加跨进程锁、自动重试、断点续传或持久化恢复日志。Node 26.7 的本地测试通过，不能证明此前 Node 22/24 的取消流报告已解决。历史审查处置和延后建议仍保留在 #15862。
- 兼容与迁移：现有请求格式、共享 JSON 上限及旧来源大小限制不变。针对现有安装的明确行为调整是保留遗留恢复备份，并在无法确认恢复成功时返回明确错误。

设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/d94a429f3961cafd60495870c66015ca4be550de/docs/design/2026-10-29-skill-archive-installation.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/d94a429f3961cafd60495870c66015ca4be550de/docs/design/2026-10-29-skill-archive-installation.zh-CN.md)。两种语言都描述完整设计，并标明各 PR 的交付边界。

## 关联

从 #15862 拆分；基于 #15030 的后续增强。

prs.title: feat(cli): add semantic statusline colors and live footer preview
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Give built-in status-line items four consistent active-theme colors: project/Git, model/reasoning, context/tokens, and session metadata. Separators stay neutral, and disabling theme colors removes semantic coloring.

Keep the actual input and footer visible while `/statusline` is open, and preview every selection immediately through the saved status line's rendering path. Remove the separate in-dialog preview. The picker owns input while open, including mouse focus and paste; Enter saves once, and Esc discards the draft and restores the previous preset, command, or disabled configuration.

## Why it's needed

Using one accent color for every item makes unrelated information difficult to scan. The old in-dialog preview also hides the real input/footer and does not reflect the saved status line's available width or wrapping. In-place preview makes the result visible before saving without persisting intermediate changes, consistently in Ink and OpenTUI.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. In both Ink and OpenTUI, open `/statusline` with a saved preset. Confirm the picker is above the still-visible input and footer, there is no internal Preview section, and toggling items or Use theme colors updates the real footer immediately. Check all four categories; same-category items should match and separators should remain neutral.
2. Press Enter after a change. Expect one save confirmation and the same footer content, wrapping, and colors as the preview. Reopen, change options, and cancel with Esc; expect the original configuration without a settings write. If search is active, the first Esc clears it and the next cancels. Repeat cancellation from custom-command and disabled status-line configurations, preserving custom ANSI colors and an explicit hide-context setting.
3. Resize to 80×24 and 40×20, select enough items to wrap, and navigate to the final item. Expect a usable compact picker, visible input/footer, and the existing two-row status-line limit without overlap. Switching between Qwen Dark and Qwen Light should repaint the category colors without restarting; NoColor should leave the preset footer uncolored.
4. While configuring, click the visible inactive input, type, and bracketed-paste text. The picker alone should receive typing, the input must remain unchanged, and no prompt should submit. After cancellation, ordinary typing and paste should work again.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Interactive tmux testing reproduced the issue with the global 0.26.5 CLI and verified the local bundle in both renderers. Nonessential picker rows are omitted in these layout excerpts.

Before: the picker contains its own preview, and the real input/footer disappears.

```text
Configure Status Line
...
Preview
➜ workspace · statusline-model · v0.26.5
```

After: there is no internal preview; the real input and footer remain beneath the picker. This excerpt is from the final OpenTUI mouse/paste verification, where the input remained empty.

```text
Configure Status Line
...
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
>   Type your message or @path/to/file
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ➜ workspace · statusline-model · Context 100% left · 0 total in · v0.26.5 · 1.0k window
  ⏸ Ask permissions (shift + tab to cycle)
```

ANSI captures confirmed that the previous uniform Qwen Dark accent `(203,166,247)` becomes project `(166,227,161)`, model `(203,166,247)`, context `(137,180,250)`, and session `(249,226,175)`. Theme switching, save/cancel, command/null restoration, narrow wrapping, and input ownership passed. An independent test engineer's E2E report is posted separately on this PR.

Local regression checks passed: full build and typecheck, reviewed CLI build and bundle, 1,236 unique affected unit tests with one existing skip, all 11 native status-line scenarios, native input focus checks at widths 40/80 with eight normal submissions, and two interactive integration tests per renderer. Changed-file lint/formatting, diff checks, and bilingual design-link validation also passed.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

macOS terminal/tmux; the global 0.26.5 CLI for baseline reproduction, and the locally built bundle under Node for Ink and Bun for strict OpenTUI. Tests used isolated workspace/home/runtime settings, no sandbox and no model requests; user-global settings were not modified.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: keeping the composer mounted requires strict picker input ownership and a bounded height budget. Keyboard, mouse, paste, resize, and save/cancel paths were verified in both renderers, with additional native OpenTUI regression coverage.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows/Linux were not tested locally. Preserve current main's real status-line placement below the input and its two-row limit; this is not a global footer redesign. Unrelated OpenTUI NoColor UI chrome is outside this change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no new persisted settings, dependency changes, or migration. Custom-command output semantics are unchanged after cancellation.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/dragon/issue-8363-statusline-preview/docs/design/statusline-preset-live-preview.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/dragon/issue-8363-statusline-preview/docs/design/statusline-preset-live-preview.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized, including decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria, and scope.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #8363

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次变更

为内置状态栏项提供四组一致的当前主题色：项目/Git、模型/推理、上下文/token，以及会话元数据。分隔符保持中性色，关闭主题色后移除语义着色。

打开 `/statusline` 时保留真实输入框和页脚，每次选择都立即通过已保存状态栏的渲染路径预览。移除对话框内部的独立预览。配置期间由选择器独占输入，包括鼠标聚焦和粘贴；Enter 只保存一次，Esc 丢弃草稿并恢复之前的 preset、command 或禁用配置。

## 为什么需要

所有项使用同一种强调色，让不同信息难以快速区分。旧的框内预览还会隐藏真实输入框/页脚，不能反映保存后状态栏的可用宽度或换行方式。原位预览让用户在保存前看到结果，不持久化中间变更，并保持 Ink 与 OpenTUI 行为一致。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在 Ink 和 OpenTUI 中，从已保存的 preset 打开 `/statusline`。确认选择器位于仍然可见的输入框和页脚上方，没有内部 Preview 区域，切换条目或 Use theme colors 会立即更新真实页脚。检查四类信息：同类颜色应一致，分隔符应保持中性色。
2. 修改后按 Enter，应仅出现一次保存提示，保存后的页脚内容、换行和颜色与预览一致。重新打开、修改选项并按 Esc 取消，应恢复原配置而不写入设置。有搜索内容时，第一次 Esc 清空搜索，第二次取消。再从自定义 command 和禁用状态栏配置重复取消测试，确认恢复自定义 ANSI 色并保留显式隐藏上下文指示器的设置。
3. 调整为 80×24 和 40×20，选中足够多的条目使其换行，并导航至最后一个条目。紧凑选择器应可用，输入框/页脚保持可见，状态栏遵循现有两行上限且不重叠。切换 Qwen Dark 与 Qwen Light 应无需重启就刷新分类颜色；NoColor 下 preset 页脚应无颜色。
4. 配置期间点击可见但不活跃的输入框，键入并进行 bracketed paste。只有选择器应接收键入，输入框内容不变且不提交 prompt。取消后普通键入和粘贴应恢复正常。

### 证据（修改前后）

交互式 tmux 测试使用全局 0.26.5 CLI 复现问题，并在两种渲染器中验证本地 bundle。以下布局摘录省略了无关选择器行。

修改前：选择器包含自己的预览，真实输入框/页脚消失。

```text
Configure Status Line
...
Preview
➜ workspace · statusline-model · v0.26.5
```

修改后：没有内部预览，真实输入框和页脚保留在选择器下方。该摘录来自最终 OpenTUI 鼠标/粘贴验证，输入框始终为空。

```text
Configure Status Line
...
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
>   Type your message or @path/to/file
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ➜ workspace · statusline-model · Context 100% left · 0 total in · v0.26.5 · 1.0k window
  ⏸ Ask permissions (shift + tab to cycle)
```

ANSI 捕获确认：原先统一的 Qwen Dark 强调色 `(203,166,247)` 变为项目 `(166,227,161)`、模型 `(203,166,247)`、上下文 `(137,180,250)`、会话 `(249,226,175)`。主题切换、保存/取消、command/null 恢复、窄屏换行和输入归属检查全部通过。独立测试工程师的 E2E 报告将作为单独评论附在本 PR。

本地回归检查通过：完整 build 和 typecheck、审查后的 CLI build 和 bundle、1,236 个去重后的受影响单元测试（另有一个已有 skip）、全部 11 个原生状态栏场景、40/80 列原生输入聚焦检查及八次正常提交，以及每种渲染器各两个交互集成测试。变更文件 lint/格式、diff 检查和双语设计链接验证也通过。

### 已测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

macOS 终端/tmux；用全局 0.26.5 CLI 复现基线，用本地构建的 bundle 在 Node 下验证 Ink、在 Bun 下验证严格 OpenTUI。测试隔离 workspace/home/runtime 设置，不使用 sandbox、不发送模型请求，也未修改用户全局设置。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：保留 composer 挂载要求选择器严格独占输入，并为其限制高度。两种渲染器的键盘、鼠标、粘贴、缩放及保存/取消路径均已验证，另补充了原生 OpenTUI 回归覆盖。
- 未验证或范围外：Windows/Linux 未在本地测试。保留当前 main 中真实状态栏位于输入框下方的位置及两行上限，不进行全局页脚重设计。无关的 OpenTUI NoColor UI chrome 不在本次范围内。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无；不新增持久化设置、不修改依赖、不需要迁移。取消后自定义 command 的输出语义保持不变。

设计：[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/dragon/issue-8363-statusline-preview/docs/design/statusline-preset-live-preview.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/dragon/issue-8363-statusline-preview/docs/design/statusline-preset-live-preview.zh-CN.md)。两个版本完整同步，包括决策、约束、验收标准和范围。

修复 #8363。

prs.title: feat(hooks): add FileChanged notifications for local sessions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds `FileChanged` hooks for local, non-managed sessions. Hooks can observe literal filenames in the working directory or register absolute files and recursive directories through successful synchronous `SessionStart` and `FileChanged` output. Notifications carry the listening session, configured absolute path and `add`, `change` or `unlink`, including changes made by external processes.

Registrations follow session ownership, working-directory changes and hook reloads. Initially missing paths and deleted/recreated roots can recover. Explicit symbolic-link files and directory roots observe their targets while preserving the configured alias in notifications; recursive discovery keeps implicit symbolic links, `.git` and `node_modules` subtrees excluded unless explicitly registered.

CI compatibility repairs retain the complete gates while using fresh verification directories and runner-local Java dependency caches. Hosted workflow fault checks require both the parent's consumed record and its delivery mirror's corrected consumed state, and the digest-tamper probe updates its exact resource row by primary key. Attestation-loss injection covers both attempts of the existing bounded read-only EOF retry while preserving recovery-blocking assertions. RocketMQ downloads have bounded connection/transfer/retry windows. The hard-pinned 5.5.1 release first uses a public Apache mirror and falls back to the two official Apache sources; its independent SHA-512 check remains mandatory before extraction. Other versions retain the official-source checksum chain. Cold-resume TUI verification waits for the original assistant reply and checks the typed user text in the same frame using the shared wait policy. The branch also contains the upstream CI history and hosted macOS Intel startup-budget fixes. The self-hosted browser gate prepares missing DejaVu font data in the runner user's font directory, then rechecks that user. Preparation uses private APT lists and package extraction at the runner's existing privilege level; it never elevates or executes the PR-provided host installer.

Commit `be264d0c9f9f9662702f7c7a1a7c4d2a84311441` fixes a CI test that assumed an ordering Git does not guarantee. The preceding Linux run recorded 117,400 passes, one order-only failure and 152 skips: both expected worktree-prune entries were present, but reversed in all three attempts. The assertion now requires exactly the same two complete records without ordering. Production behavior, the 20-second deadline and test selection are unchanged. The original file passes 48/48; a controlled reversal of real Git announcement lines also passes the original case, and ten missing/extra/duplicate/wrong-object controls are rejected.

Commit `1a8b2591` integrates upstream main `4dd7ac7` and resolves the overlapping prune-test repair using the upstream order-normalized, exact two-record assertion. Commit `16a439b6` corrects cache-repair eligibility: only default `_tool` cache candidates invoke the unchanged canonical-path and symlink safeguards. Other configured cache roots retain their provisioned permissions and continue through the original Java installation and tests. No new privileges, test selectors, coverage guards or deadlines were introduced. Commit `16ef4bb269` qualifies the Managed database template in two unit-test fixtures. This preserves their original binding on the branch and selects the same named private template after newer main is integrated; SQL, transaction fields, assertions and test selection are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Memory and other integrations need notifications from editors, shells and external writers, including files outside the working directory. This supplies a general filesystem event while leaving initial reconciliation and durable synchronization to the integration.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Register initially missing literal filenames, then create, atomically replace and delete them. Expect file notifications while unrelated siblings stay silent.
- Register an external directory, add nested files, delete and recreate the root, then write again. Notifications should continue; replacing or clearing dynamic registrations should retain static registrations.
- Register a symbolic-link file or directory, modify its target through the real path, and confirm the hook receives the configured alias. Multiple aliases should each notify. Refresh registration after retargeting a link; implicit child links should remain silent.
- Change the working directory or rotate the session and reload hooks. Only the current owning session should notify; temporary ACP/MCP configurations and managed, remote or sandbox sessions should remain disarmed.
- On a runner with font drift, expect DejaVu font data to be prepared under that runner's XDG/HOME directory, followed by the unchanged font check. Package or remaining-font failures must stop the gate; healthy runners make no preparation requests and PR-provided scripts never gain new privileges.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before the explicit-link repair, real CLI probes on the earlier source received zero notifications for static file links, dynamic file links and dynamic directory links, while the regular-file control notified. The d38 bundle passed all three configured aliases plus the control, preserving exact paths and session identity. Directory recreation produced `change → unlink → add → change`; both probes exited naturally with code 0 and empty stderr. These are historical source-scoped probes. The later main integration changes production Java, schema, SQL and other upstream inputs, so earlier SDK results are not current-tree runtime-equivalence evidence.

The resolved main-integration tree passed a complete build and typecheck, 1,714 core regressions, 912 ACP regressions, 50 Web Shell regressions and the complete 48-case prune file, all without test skips. Twelve strict assertion controls accept both valid report orders and reject missing, duplicate, extra or misattributed records. The subsequent two-file cache fix leaves the entire application package tree, dependency lock and manifests unchanged. Its workflow-contract checks pass 121/121, original cache-safety checks 8/8 and routing checks 92/92. The test engineer also verified 45 cache contexts and nine controlled flows without executing Java or modifying shared directories. Both source audits were clean; normal commit hooks preserved the verified trees.

Local workflow-reader runs retain their failures: the integration run recorded 1,235 passes, 23 failures and 25 conditional skips; the cache-fix reader run recorded 645 passes, 22 failures and 15 conditional skips. The 22 repeated failures reproduce with identical diagnostics on untouched main4dd under macOS Bash 3.2. The other original 90-second autofix timeout has no proven cause; isolated main/candidate controls passed without extending the deadline. The actual [1a8b Linux test job](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40664712936/job/122736421859) passed 117,940 test executions with zero failures and 152 existing skips, including the complete 150-case failure-reporter file, 339-case autofix file and original timed-out case. Initial local coverage-directory and linter-PATH failures remain recorded; serialization and the correct tool paths subsequently passed. Workflow-size validation also passed with the actual script under isolated Linux Bash 5, and the CI budget check passed.

### Current verification

Verification snapshot: 2026-11-06 13:08 Asia/Shanghai. Head `4ecf7ef64b9ffbf3c86842fe34b83f38d83c8bfe`, tree `32b7aa0b5592f23930a17f10d2951a55ef5f148a`. GitHub reports MERGEABLE. The normal merge of main `9b1ce46` had one conflict in the Web Shell translation tests; the browser notification and upstream quota cases were both kept. The subsequent disjoint merge of `17ad9cd` incorporates the watched lint allowlist update required by the freshness gate. Both commits passed normal hooks and preserved their verified trees. Earlier FileChanged, R20, cache safety and Java size fixes remain intact.

The local Core package build succeeded. The initial translation run collected zero tests because a new Core export was missing from stale local output; after the build, all 23 translation cases passed, including both sides of the merge. The 226 focused Core tests and 98 CI reader tests also passed, for 347 passes with no failures on those executed cases. The generated settings schema was unchanged. The final lint sync leaves the tested source files unchanged. CI's frozen install will validate the CLI archive dependency and its lockfile entry. Full root build/typecheck and fresh Web Shell artifact checks were not run locally because workspace prerequisites are incomplete; the existing Managed Java/Maven/SQL/setup budget is exhausted. No test selector or required gate was weakened.

Current-source [Main](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42157671002), [Managed fast](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42157670952), [TUI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42157670824), [Serve A/B](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42157670826), [Visuals](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42157670896), [Live Host](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42157670775), [Landlock](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42157670780) and [Reference](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42157670771) are all SUCCESS on 4ecf. ## 改动

为本地非托管会话添加 `FileChanged` hook。Hook 可观察工作目录中的字面文件名，也可通过执行成功的同步 `SessionStart` 和 `FileChanged` 输出注册绝对文件或递归目录。通知携带监听会话、配置中的绝对路径及 `add`、`change` 或 `unlink`，覆盖外部进程的写入。

注册跟随会话归属、工作目录变化和 hook 重载；初始缺失路径和删除后重建的根可以恢复。显式符号链接文件和目录根观察其目标，通知保留配置中的别名；递归发现仍排除未显式注册的符号链接、`.git` 和 `node_modules` 子树。

CI 兼容修复保留完整门禁，并使用新的验证目录和 runner 本地 Java 依赖缓存。Hosted workflow 故障检查同时要求父级记录和投递镜像最终均为已消费状态，digest 篡改探针按资源主键更新精确一行。Attestation 丢失注入覆盖既有有界只读 EOF 重试的两次尝试，同时保留恢复阻断断言。RocketMQ 下载有连接、传输和重试时限。已固定摘要的 5.5.1 优先使用公共 Apache 镜像，并回退到原两个 Apache 官方来源；解包前仍必须通过独立固定 SHA-512 校验，其他版本保留官方来源的摘要链。冷恢复 TUI 验证按共享等待策略等待原助手回答，再检查同一帧中的用户原文。分支也已同步上游 CI 历史处理和托管 macOS Intel 启动预算修复。 自托管浏览器检查现在会在 runner 用户自己的字体目录准备缺失的 DejaVu 字体数据，并以同一用户重新校验。准备过程使用私有 APT 索引和软件包解包，保持 runner 原有权限，不提权，也不执行 PR 中的宿主安装脚本。

## 原因

Memory 等集成需要观察编辑器、shell 和外部进程的写入，包括工作目录之外的文件。本改动提供通用文件系统事件，初始对账和持久同步仍由集成负责。

## 评审验证

- 注册初始缺失的字面文件名，再创建、原子替换和删除；应收到文件通知，无关兄弟路径保持静默。
- 注册外部目录，新增嵌套文件，删除并重建根后再次写入；通知应持续。替换或清空动态注册时保留静态注册。
- 注册符号链接文件或目录，通过真实路径修改目标；hook 应收到配置的别名。多个别名各自通知，链接改指后刷新注册；隐式子链接保持静默。
- 改变工作目录，或轮换会话后重载 hook；只有当前归属会话收到通知，ACP/MCP 临时配置及托管、远程、沙箱会话保持禁用。
