prs.body:
## What Both parts of #13340 in one PR, per the plan discussed with @doudouOUC in that thread. ### 1. Web Shell: render the ExitPlanMode approval as markdown `packages/web-shell/client/components/messages/ToolApproval.tsx` rendered the plan as a raw `
{contentText}
`, so the markdown the model writes (the `exit_plan_mode` schema itself declares "Supports markdown") showed up as literal `##` / `#` lines in a fixed-height box. The `isExitPlanApproval` branch now renders the plan with the existing `Markdown` primitive (react-markdown + remark-gfm, with the `isSafeHref`/`isSafeImageSrc` sanitisation that matters for model-generated content). The `.planContent` height clamp is kept, and the raw plan text remains available as the element's `title` plus the rendered plain text, so the alertdialog's `aria-describedby` keeps a plain-text accessible equivalent. Non-plan content paths still use `
`.

### 2. Core: make the plan-mode reminder ask for a Todo list when Session Workflow is on

`getPlanModeSystemReminder()` never mentioned `todo_write`, so with `experimental.sessionWorkflow` enabled the model almost always wrote a text plan and the structured DAG approval path (`planTodos.length > 0`) was effectively unreachable (documented in #8393).

- `getPlanModeSystemReminder` now takes a `sessionWorkflow` parameter; when it is true (and the interactive exit-plan flow applies, i.e. not plan-only mode) the "When to Converge" section instructs the model to capture the plan as a structured Todo list via `todo_write` (stable ids, `blockedBy` for real dependencies) before calling `exit_plan_mode`.
- All call sites pass the gate through from config: `client.ts` (per-turn reminder), `enterPlanMode.ts` (tool `llmContent`), the ACP session (`Session.ts`) and `nonInteractiveHelpers.ts` — all via `config.isSessionWorkflowTodoContextActive?.() === true`, the same source `todo_write` already uses for its `sessionWorkflow` stamp.
- `plan-mode-entry-policy.ts` now also precomputes the session-workflow variant so the tool-response budget protection keeps matching `enter_plan_mode` output.

Plan-only mode (SDK/subagent contexts, which never run the interactive exit-plan approval) is unchanged.

prs.title: test(managed-agent): use CSI fixture for lifecycle receipt
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Keeps the publication lifecycle contention test on a CSI original so its receipt still exercises the tenant-guard path. The prepared execution is now settled with the exact finished envelope between `finish` and `prepareAdmission`, which is the state the CSI admission contract requires. One shared CSI registration also replaces the four identical literals across the publication test fixtures.

Only test fixtures and the required imports change. The latch ordering, timeout, assertions, receipt replay, and production locking behavior stay unchanged.

## Why it's needed

After #16335, an ordinary non-CSI receipt deliberately skips the tenant guard. The existing fixture creates a non-CSI original, but the test still waits for receipt to execute the guard SQL. Both parameterized cases therefore time out before lifecycle completion can be released, rather than proving that receipt and lifecycle completion avoid a deadlock.

Routing the original through CSI alone is not sufficient. CSI admission requires a SETTLED original execution whose saved result is JSON-equal to the finished envelope. Settling that execution after `finish`, rather than during fixture population, preserves the runtime authorization needed by `finish` while satisfying the later SETTLE check.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `ToolPublicationLifecycleMySqlIT` through the real MySQL integration tier. Both parameterized cases should pass `prepareAdmission`, reach the receipt guard, release lifecycle completion, finish both operations, and preserve one receipt transaction on replay. The intended result is not merely a shorter wait or a removed assertion: the original latch ordering and no-deadlock checks must all hold.

The three neighboring publication fixtures that now use the shared registration should also retain their existing behavior.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: full Java job `127288076569` failed both parameterized cases at the receipt latch because the non-CSI fixture could not reach the guard it waited for. Review `5788475771` then reproduced the intermediate CSI head against disposable MySQL 8.4: both cases failed in `prepareAdmission` with `Original result is not settled`, confirming the additional fixture requirement.

After: head `a88b6a88c6e71bfa6bafce8d5848c4a0b809da98` passes the targeted real-MySQL run in official JDK 21 / Maven and MySQL 8.4.6 containers. Failsafe collected both `replay=false` and `replay=true`: **2 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped**. Each case created and migrated its own schema and preserved the latch ordering and replay assertions. The hosted two-fork full-tier workflow and required checks remain pending; the separate Linux shard failure is the previously reported `vite-config.test.ts` timeout, not a MySQL failure.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS host |  N/A   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux containers |  ✅ targeted MySQL: 2/2   |

### Environment (optional)

The local run used `maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-21-alpine` and `mysql:8.4.6`, with native AIO disabled, binary logging skipped, and the CI packet budget. The SDK and Managed Agent reactor installed successfully with zero Checkstyle violations before Failsafe ran the target class with one fork. H2 was not used as a substitute. This is targeted integration evidence, not a claim that the entire two-fork workflow has run locally.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: this deliberately keeps the test on the CSI guard path and supplies the settled execution that path already requires. The settlement uses the same envelope produced by `finish`, not a placeholder result.
- Not validated / out of scope: the hosted two-fork full-tier workflow and required checks remain pending. The local evidence is limited to the two parameterized `ToolPublicationLifecycleMySqlIT` cases; it is not a full-suite green claim. No H2 substitute, production behavior change, timeout increase, weaker assertion, or selector exclusion is introduced. Separate non-CSI no-guard coverage is outside this fixture correction.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; this is a test-only fixture correction and deduplication.

## Linked Issues

Closes #16405

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

让 publication lifecycle 的锁竞争测试继续使用 CSI original，使 receipt 仍然经过 tenant guard 路径。在 `finish` 与 `prepareAdmission` 之间，使用同一份完成的 envelope 将 prepared execution 设为 SETTLED，满足 CSI admission 的现有契约。另用一份共享 CSI registration 替换 publication 测试 fixture 中四份完全相同的字面量。

这里只修改测试 fixture 和必要的 import，latch 顺序、超时、断言、receipt replay 以及生产锁逻辑全部保持不变。

## 为什么需要

#16335 之后，普通非 CSI receipt 会有意跳过 tenant guard。现有 fixture 创建的是非 CSI original，但测试仍等待 receipt 执行 guard SQL。两个参数化用例因此都会在 receipt latch 处超时，lifecycle 无法释放，无法继续证明 receipt 与 lifecycle completion 不会死锁。

仅把 original 改为 CSI 还不够。CSI admission 要求 original execution 已 SETTLED，且保存的结果与完成的 envelope JSON 相等。在 `finish` 之后而不是 fixture 初始化阶段完成 settlement，既保留 `finish` 所需的 runtime authorization，也满足后续 SETTLE 检查。

## Reviewer 验证计划

### 如何验证

通过真实 MySQL integration tier 运行 `ToolPublicationLifecycleMySqlIT`。两个参数化用例都应通过 `prepareAdmission`、到达 receipt guard、释放 lifecycle completion、完成两个操作，并在 replay 时仍只保留一笔 receipt 事务。预期结果不是单纯缩短等待或删除断言，而是原有 latch 顺序和防死锁检查全部成立。

另外三个改用共享 registration 的 publication fixture 也应保持既有行为。

### 前后证据

修复前：完整 Java job `127288076569` 中，两个参数化用例都在 receipt latch 失败，因为非 CSI fixture 无法到达它等待的 guard。评审 `5788475771` 随后用一次性 MySQL 8.4 复现了中间 CSI head：两个用例都在 `prepareAdmission` 以 `Original result is not settled` 失败，确认了这一额外 fixture 条件。

修复后：`a88b6a88c6e71bfa6bafce8d5848c4a0b809da98` 已在官方 JDK 21 / Maven 与 MySQL 8.4.6 容器中通过定向真实 MySQL 验证。Failsafe 实际收集 `replay=false` 和 `replay=true` 两个用例，结果为 **2 tests、0 failures、0 errors、0 skipped**。两个用例分别创建并迁移独立 schema，原有 latch 顺序和 replay 断言均保持。托管双 fork full-tier workflow 与 required checks 仍待完成；另一 Linux shard 的失败仍是此前记录的 `vite-config.test.ts` 超时，不是 MySQL 失败。

### 测试平台

|     操作系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS 宿主  |  N/A   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux 容器  |  ✅ 定向 MySQL：2/2   |

### 环境（可选）

本地验证使用 `maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-21-alpine` 与 `mysql:8.4.6`，按 CI 配置关闭 native AIO、跳过 binary log 并设置 packet budget。目标测试前，SDK 与 Managed Agent reactor 均安装成功，Checkstyle 为 0 violations；随后 Failsafe 以单 fork 运行目标类。没有用 H2 替代。该证据只覆盖定向集成用例，不宣称本地已经运行整个双 fork workflow。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：本 PR 有意让该测试继续使用 CSI guard 路径，并提供该路径原本要求的 settled execution。settlement 使用 `finish` 产生的同一份 envelope，不是占位结果。
- 未验证或不在范围内：托管双 fork full-tier workflow 与 required checks 仍待完成。本地证据只覆盖两个 `ToolPublicationLifecycleMySqlIT` 参数化用例，不宣称全套测试转绿。没有用 H2 替代，没有改变生产行为、延长超时、放宽断言或排除 selector。独立的非 CSI 无 guard 覆盖不在这次 fixture 修正范围内。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无；这只是测试 fixture 修正和去重。

## 关联 Issue

Closes #16405

</details>

prs.title: feat(cli): thread /btw session history and decouple its request lifecycle
prs.body:
> **WIP** — not yet manually tested by the author. The TUI evidence below comes from an agent-driven tmux session against a real model; please treat it as preliminary.

## What this PR does

Side questions asked with `/btw` now belong to the session instead of standing alone. The last 20 answered side questions are replayed after the main conversation when the next one is asked, so a follow-up side question can refer to earlier ones. Every surface that answers side questions (the interactive TUI, ACP, the daemon stream used by Web Shell, channels and the SDK) goes through the same per-session state.

The side-question fork now sends the full conversation history and keeps the main request's tool declarations while asking the provider not to call them, so its request prefix matches the main agent's request. When a stream retry restarts the request, text streamed by the failed attempt is discarded; remote clients are told through a new `reset` generation event, and the daemon's answer snapshots clear accordingly.

In the TUI, side questions run concurrently: starting a new one no longer cancels the previous one, and only Esc, Ctrl+C or Ctrl+D cancels the one on screen. A bare `/btw` reopens the newest running side question, or the newest answer. Answers stream into the bottom area (capped to the viewport while streaming), show the retry status with a countdown, and with an empty prompt ←/→ browse earlier answers, `c` copies the shown answer, `x` clears earlier answers, and Space/Enter dismiss without cancelling. A reply that only tries to call a tool now shows a clear notice instead of "No response received." The loading indicator suggests `/btw` on turns of 30 seconds or more until the user has tried it, and only when tips are enabled. The side-question prompt is stricter about not promising follow-up actions.

## Why it's needed

Each `/btw` was isolated, so a follow-up side question could not build on the previous answer, and a bare `/btw` only printed a usage error. The fork sent only the last 40 history entries without tools, which lost context in long sessions and missed the prompt cache. A second `/btw` silently cancelled the first. Retries that restarted the request could leave a duplicated prefix in the answer, including in text already streamed to remote clients.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start a session, tell the model a fact (for example a codename), then `/btw what is the codename?` — the answer should stream into the bottom area.
2. Ask `/btw quote the side question I asked just before this one` — it should quote the first side question, which only exists in side-question history.
3. With the prompt empty, press ← to browse the older answer, `c` to copy it (a "Copied to clipboard" notice appears and nothing is typed into the prompt), then Space to dismiss.
4. Run a bare `/btw` — the newest answer reopens.
5. Send two `/btw` questions back to back and press Esc on the second while it is pending; a bare `/btw` then shows the first one's answer, and the cancelled one is not recorded.
6. `/clear` drops side-question history.
7. Over the daemon/Web Shell, ask two side questions in the same session and confirm the second sees the first.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: each `/btw` was answered in isolation, a bare `/btw` printed `Please provide a question. Usage: /btw <your question>`, and a second `/btw` cancelled the first.

After (built CLI in tmux, deepseek-v4-pro):

Second side question answered from side-question history:
```

  │ /btw quote verbatim the side question I asked you just before this one                           │
  │                                                                                                  │
  │ what is the release codename?                                                                    │
  │                                                                                                  │
  │ ←/→ browse earlier answers · c copy · x clear history · Press Space, Enter, or Escape to dismiss │
  ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
```

Browsing the earlier answer and copying it:
```
  ╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │ /btw what is the release codename? (1/1)                                                         │
  │                                                                                                  │
  │ The release codename is BLUE HERON.                                                              │
  │                                                                                                  │
  │ Copied to clipboard                                                                              │
  │ ←/→ browse earlier answers · c copy · x clear history · Press Space, Enter, or Escape to dismiss │
  ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
```

Bare `/btw` after the older question kept running in the background while a newer one was cancelled with Esc:
```
  ╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │ /btw what is the deadline?                                                                       │
  │                                                                                                  │
  │ The deadline is Friday.                                                                          │
  │                                                                                                  │
  │ ←/→ browse earlier answers · c copy · x clear history · Press Space, Enter, or Escape to dismiss │
  ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
```

Long answer streaming with the viewport capped (question header stays visible):
```

  │ /btw list 80 bird species, one per line, numbered                                                │
  │                                                                                                  │

  │  32. Dark-eyed Junco                                                                             │
  │  33. Song Sparrow                                                                                │
  │  34. Chipping Sparrow                                                                            │
  │  35. House Finch                                                                                 │
  │  36. Purple Finch                                                                                │
  │  37. Indigo Bunting                                                                              │
  │  38. Scarlet Tanager                                                                             │
  │  39. Baltimore Oriole                                                                            │
  │  40. Orchard Oriole                                                                              │
  │  41. Rose-breasted Grosbeak                                                                      │
  │  42. Common Loon                                                                                 │
  │  43. Pied-billed Grebe                                                                           │
  │  44. Double-crested Cormorant                                                                    │
  │  45. Turkey Vulture                                                                              │
  │  46. Osprey                                                                                      │
  │  47. Cooper's Hawk                                                                               │
  │ + Answering...                                                                                   │

  │ Press Escape, Ctrl+C, or Ctrl+D to cancel                                                        │
  ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
```

A fuller HTML proof page (all captured frames plus per-suite test results) was produced locally; it is not attached because GitHub does not render HTML attachments.

Unit tests: the new and updated suites (side-question session, forked-agent cache path, view controller, command, generation stream, daemon btw stream, bridge client, message rendering, tip history, i18n, InputPrompt, AppContainer, advisor) pass — 878 tests. Full workspace typecheck passes. `acp-output.test.ts` has one failure that reproduces on the base commit, and two daemon idempotency tests in `server.test.ts` are flaky locally; neither touches this change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️ agent-driven only   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Built CLI (`node packages/cli/dist/index.js`) in tmux 120×40, Node 26.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: each side question now carries the full history (that is what makes its prefix match the main request); threaded side answers add at most 20 more turns. `c` and `x` act only while the prompt is empty and an answer is shown, so a prompt that starts with those letters typed right after an answer triggers the action instead — the footer shows the keys. Several clients attached to one daemon session share its side-question history.
- Not validated / out of scope: retry countdown, the remote `reset` event and the 30-second tip were verified by unit tests only. The Anthropic converter has no mapping for "function calling off", so there a stray tool call falls back to the notice. OpenTUI gets streaming, history and reopen but not the browse/copy/clear keys. No modal panel and no keybinding configuration changes.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the daemon generation stream can now emit a `reset` event for side questions; clients that consume answer snapshots need no change, clients that consume raw generation events should clear accumulated text on `reset`.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-11-06-btw-session-history.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-06-btw-session-history.zh-CN.md)

None.

### 这个 PR 做了什么

`/btw` 旁路问题现在归属于会话，而不再彼此孤立。最近 20 条已回答的旁路问题会在下一次提问时追加在主对话之后，因此后续旁路问题可以引用之前的问题。所有回答旁路问题的入口（交互式 TUI、ACP、Web Shell 使用的 daemon 流、channels 和 SDK）都通过同一份按会话的状态。

此前每次 `/btw` 都是孤立的，后续旁路问题无法基于上一个回答，无参 `/btw` 只会报用法错误。分叉只发送最近 40 条历史且不带工具，长会话会丢上下文，也无法命中提示词缓存。第二次 `/btw` 会静默取消第一次。重新发起请求的重试可能在答案中留下重复的前缀，包括已经流式发给远程客户端的文本。

### 审阅测试计划

#### 如何验证

1. 启动会话，告诉模型一个事实（例如代号），然后执行 `/btw what is the codename?`，答案应流式显示在底部区域。

4. 执行无参 `/btw`，最新的回答会重新打开。
5. 连续发送两个 `/btw`，在第二个等待时按 Esc；之后无参 `/btw` 显示第一个问题的答案，被取消的问题不会被记录。
6. `/clear` 会清空旁路问题历史。
7. 通过 daemon/Web Shell 在同一会话中问两个旁路问题，确认第二个能看到第一个。

之前：每次 `/btw` 都孤立回答，无参 `/btw` 输出 `Please provide a question. Usage: /btw <your question>`，第二次 `/btw` 会取消第一次。

#### 测试平台

macOS：⚠️ 仅 agent 驱动测试；Windows、Linux：⚠️ 未测试。

#### 环境

构建后的 CLI（`node packages/cli/dist/index.js`），tmux 120×40，Node 26。

### 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：每个旁路问题现在携带完整历史（这是让前缀与主请求一致的前提）；线程化的旁路回答最多再增加 20 轮。`c` 和 `x` 只在输入框为空且显示答案时生效，因此刚看到答案就输入以这两个字母开头的提示词会触发对应操作；底部提示会显示这些键。连接同一个 daemon 会话的多个客户端共享该会话的旁路问题历史。

无。

prs.title: fix(cli): report pre-send refusals instead of replaying answers
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When the client refuses a turn before sending it — the session token limit or a UserPromptSubmit hook block — the stream carries no content, and the shared result builder fell back to the previous turn's assistant message. A persistent stream-json session therefore reported the refused message as a success carrying the earlier answer. This records the refusal on the adapter that stream-json, json, and text output share, and turns that would-be success into an error result with the refusal text and no `result` field. An error the caller already classified keeps its own subtype but reports the real refusal as its message, and the latch is cleared when the result that ends the turn is built, so it cannot relabel a later turn. A refusal that lands after the turn already streamed text leaves that text as the turn's answer and keeps the success envelope. The error reuses the existing `error_during_execution` subtype, so all three SDK protocol definitions stay unchanged and this does not depend on #15358.

## Why it's needed

Consumers branch on the result envelope (`is_error` / `subtype`), so a refused message currently looks answered and silently repeats stale content — a shell wrapper that only checks the status proceeds with the previous answer. The issue reproduces it with a two-message stream-json session, where the refused turn returned `{"subtype":"success","is_error":false,"result":"answer 1"}`.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the adapter suite from `packages/cli`: `npx vitest run src/nonInteractive/io/StreamJsonOutputAdapter.test.ts`. The added cases feed each refusal event after a previous assistant message exists, then assert `is_error: true`, `subtype: "error_during_execution"`, the refusal text in `error.message`, and the absence of a `result` field. They also cover the neighbouring shapes: text produced before the refusal, a refusal in a later model round, a caller-classified error, and a refused turn followed by a turn that answers normally. Each case fails before the change and passes after it.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the refused turn emits `{"type":"result","subtype":"success","is_error":false,"result":"<previous answer>"}`. After: it emits `{"type":"result","subtype":"error_during_execution","is_error":true,"error":{"message":"Session token limit exceeded: ..."}}` with no `result`. This is a non-user-visible protocol change in headless output, so there is no TUI before/after.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux was verified inside a `node:22-bookworm` container; Windows was not exercised, and the change has no platform-specific code.

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the latch is cleared when a result is built and consumed by that same build, so it cannot relabel a later turn's result. Refusals still end the turn; in a single-shot `-p` run a refusal that has nothing of its own to report exits with code 1 so the process status agrees with the error envelope, while a refusal that lands after the turn streamed text keeps the success envelope and exits 0. A persistent `--input-format stream-json` session ignores the per-turn status and keeps its existing behavior.
- Not validated / out of scope: the max-turns sibling refusal stays with #15358.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — no new subtype, no configuration, no SDK type change. Single-shot `-p` exit status for these two refusals changes from 0 to 1 for scripts that relied on the old value.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15704

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

当客户端在发送前拒绝一轮请求（会话 token 上限，或 UserPromptSubmit hook 拦截）时，流里没有任何内容，而共用的 result 构建逻辑会回退到上一轮的助手消息。持久化的 stream-json 会话因此把被拒绝的消息报告成一次成功，并带上之前的答案。本改动在 stream-json、json、text 三种输出共用的适配器上记录拒绝原因，把原本会生成的成功结果转换成错误结果：带拒绝原因、不带 `result` 字段。调用方已经判定为错误的结果保留原有 subtype，但文案换成真实的拒绝原因；记录在构建 result 时清空，因此不会污染后续回合。拒绝发生时本轮已经输出过文本的，那段文本就是本轮的答案，结果保持成功信封。错误复用现有的 `error_during_execution` subtype，因此三套 SDK 的协议定义都不需要改，也不依赖 #15358。

## 为什么需要

调用方根据 result 信封（`is_error` / `subtype`）分支处理，现在被拒绝的消息看起来像已回答，并且静默重复旧内容——只判断退出码的 shell 包装脚本会拿着上一轮答案继续执行。issue 里用两条消息的 stream-json 会话复现：被拒绝的一轮返回 `{"subtype":"success","is_error":false,"result":"answer 1"}`。

## 评审验证方式

在 `packages/cli` 下运行 `npx vitest run src/nonInteractive/io/StreamJsonOutputAdapter.test.ts`。新增用例在已有上一轮助手消息的前提下注入拒绝事件，断言 `is_error: true`、`subtype: "error_during_execution"`、`error.message` 为拒绝原因，且没有 `result` 字段；同时覆盖相邻形态：拒绝前本轮已有文本、拒绝发生在后续模型轮次、调用方已判定的错误、以及被拒绝的一轮之后紧跟正常回答的一轮。这些用例改动前为红，改动后为绿。

## 改动前后

改动前被拒绝的一轮输出 `{"type":"result","subtype":"success","is_error":false,"result":"<上一轮答案>"}`；改动后输出 `{"type":"result","subtype":"error_during_execution","is_error":true,"error":{"message":"Session token limit exceeded: ..."}}`，且不含 `result`。这是无头输出的协议行为变化，不涉及 TUI，因此没有界面前后对比。

## 测试环境

macOS 通过；Linux 在 `node:22-bookworm` 容器内通过；Windows 未验证，改动不含平台相关代码。

## 风险与范围

记录在构建 result 时清空、并被这次构建消费，不会污染后续回合。拒绝仍然结束回合：单次 `-p` 运行下没有自身输出的拒绝现在以退出码 1 结束、与错误信封一致；本轮已经有文本的拒绝保持成功信封、退出码 0。持久 `--input-format stream-json` 会话丢弃每轮状态、行为不变。max-session-turns 的同类处理仍归 #15358。没有新增 subtype、配置或 SDK 类型变更。单次 `-p` 下这两种拒绝的退出码由 0 变为 1，依赖旧值的脚本需要留意。

## 关联 issue

Fixes #15704

</details>

prs.title: ci(release): only file issues on failure and reconcile stale ones
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Both fan-out release notifiers treated a cancelled run as a failure and filed an issue, and neither workflow had any path to close that issue once a later attempt shipped. Each notifier now reacts only to an actual failure of its build or publish job, and each workflow gains a success-gated sibling job that closes the bot-authored issue an earlier attempt filed. The shared release step behind that reconciliation now takes the issue-title prefix and the release version, so the CLI release and both fan-out workflows reuse one implementation instead of growing separate copies.

## Why it's needed

A shipped release could sit under an open failure report: release v0.26.3's VSCode companion run passed on attempt 2 while its failure issue stayed open until it was closed by hand. Cancellation also filed issues for runs that shipped nothing. Stale failure issues are picked up by the scheduled autofix agent and turned into PRs against releases that already landed, so the false report has a cost beyond noise.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

From the repository root, run `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/release-fanout-workflows.test.js scripts/tests/release-workflow.test.js`. The five new cases pin that neither notifier mentions `cancelled`, that each reconcile job is success-gated, checks out the workflow's own commit, calls the shared step with its own title prefix, and cannot turn a shipped release red. One case drives the script with a fake `gh` and two bot-authored issues whose titles differ only by workflow prefix, and asserts that only the matching issue is closed. The existing release.yml reconciliation cases keep passing unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, a cancelled build or publish filed `VSCode IDE Companion Release Failed for …` / `Chrome extension release failed for …`, and a passing re-run left it open. After, cancellation files nothing and a passing re-run closes the workflow-owned issue with a comment. This is CI-only behaviour, so there is no UI before/after.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

The script is bash and both jobs run on `ubuntu-latest`; Windows is not a supported target. Linux was verified inside a `node:22-bookworm` container with `jq` installed.

### Environment (optional)

Unit and workflow-contract tests only; no release run was triggered.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: each successful release now runs one short reconciliation job, which comments on and closes only a `github-actions[bot]` issue whose title matches `<prefix><version> on ` exactly. A human filing the same title is never touched, and the step is `continue-on-error` so it cannot fail a shipped release.
- Not validated / out of scope: the notifier still has no dry-run guard and does not react to a `prepare` failure in the companion workflow; both predate this change and were left untouched.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The workflows grow by about 1.5 KB each, within the size-ratchet allowance, so no baseline update is needed.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15840

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

两个发布下游通知器此前把「取消」也当成失败并创建 issue，而且两个 workflow 都没有在后续重跑成功后关闭该 issue 的路径。现在通知器只在 build 或 publish 真正失败时创建 issue，每个 workflow 新增一个成功才触发的兄弟作业，用于关闭上一次尝试创建的、由机器人提交的 issue。负责关闭的共用发布脚本现在接收 issue 标题前缀与发布版本，CLI 发布和两个下游 workflow 复用同一份实现，而不是各自再复制一份。

## 为什么需要

已发布的版本可能一直挂着一个未关闭的失败报告：v0.26.3 的 VSCode companion 运行在第 2 次尝试成功，但它此前创建的失败 issue 一直开着，直到被手动关闭。取消的运行也会创建 issue，尽管它什么都没发布。残留的失败 issue 会被定时 autofix 机器人捡走，针对已经发布的版本开出 PR，因此误报的代价不只是噪音。

## 评审验证方式

在仓库根目录运行 `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/release-fanout-workflows.test.js scripts/tests/release-workflow.test.js`。新增的 5 个用例固定住：两个通知器不再包含 `cancelled`；reconcile 作业为成功门控、checkout 使用 workflow 自身提交、用各自标题前缀调用共用脚本、且不会让已发布版本变红。其中一个用例用假 `gh` 和两条仅前缀不同的机器人 issue 驱动脚本，断言只关闭匹配的那条。`release.yml` 原有的 reconcile 用例保持不变并通过。

## 改动前后

改动前，build 或 publish 被取消也会创建 `VSCode IDE Companion Release Failed for …` / `Chrome extension release failed for …`，并且重跑成功后该 issue 仍然开着。改动后，取消不再创建 issue，重跑成功会带评论关闭该 workflow 创建的 issue。这是纯 CI 行为，没有界面前后对比。

## 测试环境

脚本是 bash，两个作业都在 `ubuntu-latest` 上运行，Windows 不是支持目标。macOS 通过；Linux 在 `node:22-bookworm` 容器内（安装 `jq`）通过。

## 风险与范围

每个成功发布多跑一个很短的 reconcile 作业，它只会评论并关闭作者为 `github-actions[bot]`、标题精确匹配 `<前缀><版本> on ` 的 issue；真人提交的同名 issue 不会被碰，该步骤设置 `continue-on-error`，不会把已发布版本变红。通知器仍没有 dry-run 门控、也不响应 companion 的 `prepare` 失败，这两点都是既有行为，本次未改。两个 workflow 各增长约 1.5 KB，仍在 size ratchet 允许范围内，无需更新 baseline。

## 关联 issue

Fixes #15840

</details>

prs.title: fix(channels): stop resending a GitHub reply after an ambiguous answer
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the restart-retry pass for pending GitHub replies treat an ambiguous delivery answer as consumed, so a reply GitHub may already have posted is not sent a second time. The ambiguous audit row now records which pending record it decided, and the resend guard reads that.

## Why it's needed

At channel start, `retryPendingFinalDeliveries()` re-sends replies stored in the pending-delivery file. When GitHub answers a re-send ambiguously (a 502, a timeout — the write may have landed), the pass audits `failed_ambiguous` and then removes the record so it is never sent again.

That removal can fail — ENOSPC, EACCES, a failed rename — and the record then survives to the next start. The guard that should stop the second send, `hasPostedPublicationAudit()`, only recognised a `posted` row carrying that `pendingId`, and the `failed_ambiguous` row carried none. So on the next start the record was sent again, and a thread whose first comment had actually landed received a second public reply.

Fixes #16394.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The regression test drives two consecutive retry passes. The first one answers the comment call ambiguously and leaves the pending file unparseable, so the record survives; the second pass starts with that record still on disk.

Without the change, `createComment` is called twice across the two passes (the duplicate this issue reports). With the change, it is called once — the second pass finds the `failed_ambiguous` audit for that `pendingId`, drops the record, and sends nothing.

### Evidence (Before & After)

```
# without the fix (source reverted, new test kept):
AssertionError: expected "spy" to be called 1 times, but got 2 times
 Tests  1 failed | 521 skipped (522)

# with the fix:
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  522 passed (522)
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Unit tests only; macOS is the only platform I ran them on. The code path is platform-independent.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an ambiguous answer is now sticky for that pending record even if GitHub provably never created the comment. That is the same at-most-once contract the source-key guard already applies to `failed_ambiguous`, so the two idempotency paths now agree instead of disagreeing. The cost of being wrong is a reply that is never retried; the cost of the old behaviour was a duplicate public comment.
- Not validated / out of scope: I did not exercise a real failed rewrite (ENOSPC/EACCES) against a live GitHub endpoint; the test simulates it by making the pending file unparseable, the same way the neighbouring test does. The broader rework suggested in the issue — converging this pass on `readPublicationAuditKeys()` — is deliberately not part of this change: that guard resolves "last outcome per source key wins", and a later definite `failed` row re-opens a key, so moving onto it needs its own correctness argument for records retried across restarts.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Existing audit rows without a `pendingId` keep their current meaning.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16394

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

让 GitHub 待发回复的重启重发流程把「歧义」的投递答复视为已消费，从而不会把 GitHub 可能已经发出的回复再发一次。歧义审计行现在会记录它判定的是哪条待发记录，重发守卫据此读取。

## 为什么需要

channel 启动时，`retryPendingFinalDeliveries()` 会重发待发文件里保存的回复。当 GitHub 对重发给出歧义答复（502、超时——写操作可能已经成功）时，这一轮会记一条 `failed_ambiguous` 审计，随后删除该记录，保证不再重发。

但删除可能失败——ENOSPC、EACCES、rename 失败——记录于是留到了下次启动。本该拦住第二次发送的 `hasPostedPublicationAudit()` 只认携带该 `pendingId` 的 `posted` 行，而 `failed_ambiguous` 行不带 `pendingId`。于是下次启动会再次发送，第一次评论其实已经落地的线程就收到了第二条公开回复。

修复 #16394。

## 审查测试计划

### 如何验证

回归测试连续驱动两轮重发。第一轮让评论调用返回歧义、并让待发文件不可解析，记录因此存活；第二轮开始时该记录仍在磁盘上。

没有本改动时，两轮合计 `createComment` 被调用两次（即本 issue 报告的重复）。有本改动时只调用一次——第二轮发现该 `pendingId` 的 `failed_ambiguous` 审计，删除记录，不再发送。

### 证据（改动前后）

```
# 撤掉修复、保留新测试：
AssertionError: expected "spy" to be called 1 times, but got 2 times
 Tests  1 failed | 521 skipped (522)

# 加上修复：
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  522 passed (522)
```

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

仅单元测试；我只在 macOS 上跑过。该代码路径与平台无关。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：对某条待发记录而言，歧义答复现在变成粘性的，即使 GitHub 确实没建出评论。这与 source-key 守卫对 `failed_ambiguous` 已采用的至多一次契约一致，因此两条幂等路径从互相矛盾变为一致。判错的代价是一条回复不再重试；旧行为的代价是多出一条公开评论。
- 未验证 / 范围之外：我没有对真实 GitHub 端点制造真实的写入失败（ENOSPC/EACCES）；测试通过把待发文件变为不可解析来模拟，与相邻测试手法相同。issue 中建议的更大幅度重构——让本轮改用 `readPublicationAuditKeys()`——有意没有包含在本改动中：该守卫按「同一 source key 最后一条 outcome 胜出」，之后一条确定性的 `failed` 会重新打开该 key，跨重启重发的记录要用它需要单独的正确性论证。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。没有 `pendingId` 的历史审计行语义不变。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): give static transcript text an explicit wrap width
prs.body:
## What this PR does

On the static transcript path, a block of text that had no width of its own was measured implicitly by the layout engine, so a line that filled the terminal could run into the reserved right margin and the terminal would then break it hard in the middle of a word. This PR states the width explicitly for the three conversation block types that were affected: ordinary paragraphs, markdown list items, and markdown blockquotes. The width is opt-in per call site, and only the conversational call sites opt in; call sites whose available width already includes their own border and padding are deliberately left alone.

This is a take-over of #15021 by agreement with its author (@PanSHIgg), who asked for the work to move forward here and will close that PR once this one is open. The paragraph half is his change, carried over as-is; the list-item and blockquote halves extend the same mechanism to two call sites that were left as follow-ups in the original PR.

## Why it's needed

The reported symptom is one or two characters landing alone in column zero after a line that reached the right edge, with the following line's indent shifted by a column. It is width-dependent and was reported on Windows at 100 columns. The root cause is that the wrapping text had no declared width, so the layout engine could hand the terminal a line one or a few cells wider than the space actually reserved for it. Giving the block its real width removes that possibility for the three affected block types.

The original PR covered paragraphs only and explicitly deferred list items and the remaining call sites. While verifying the paragraph fix in a real terminal, the same defect was observed on numbered lists and on blockquotes, so all three are fixed here rather than in three separate rounds.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The regression tests render the real transcript component inside a real static list at a fixed terminal width and assert that no rendered line is wider than the space the transcript reserves (terminal width minus the two-column margins). Each of the three block types has its own test, and each test fails on the build where its own block type is still unfixed:

| build | failing tests |
| --- | --- |
| current `main`, no fixes | paragraphs, flat list, nested list, blockquote — `5 failed` |
| + paragraph fix only | flat list, nested list |
| + list fix only | blockquote |
| + all three | none — `237 passed` across the transcript and markdown suites |

So the three defects are separated by independent signals: fixing one does not hide another. A reviewer can reproduce the first row by reverting the source changes and re-running the transcript test file.

For the live check: run the CLI in a 100-column Windows terminal with the virtualized history disabled, and ask for a long single-paragraph answer, a numbered list of two long items, and a long one-line blockquote. Before the change, words break mid-word at the right edge and the fragment lands in column zero. After the change, wrapping happens at word boundaries and the right margin stays intact.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Both frames below are the same model, the same working directory and a real 100-column Windows ConPTY; only the built bundle differs.

Before — build without the fixes:

![Before: blockquote, paragraph and list all break at the right margin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aleks-0/qwen-code/pr-assets-14075/pr-assets/14075-three-base-100col.png)

After — build with the three fixes:

![After: the same three blocks wrap at word boundaries and the right margin is intact](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aleks-0/qwen-code/pr-assets-14075/pr-assets/14075-three-fixed-100col.png)

The same frames as text, so the break points are greppable. Before — blockquote, paragraph and list all break; worst line is 100 cells against a 98-cell ceiling:

```
  ◆︎  │ История вычислительной техники начинается с механических счётных устройств — абака, счётовой
       доски и арифмометра Лейбница, — продолжается разностной и аналитической машинами Чарлза Бэбби
джа
       с первыми программами Ады Лавлейс, переходит к электромеханическим реле Конрада Цузе и лампов
ым
```

After — same three blocks, no orphan in column zero, worst content line 98:

```
  ◆︎  │ История вычислительной техники начинается с механических счётных устройств — абака, счётовой
       доски и арифмометра Лейбница, — продолжается разностной и аналитической машинами
       Чарлза Бэббиджа с первыми программами Ады Лавлейс, переходит к электромеханическим реле
```

Breaks visible before and gone after: blockquote `Бэбби`/`джа`, `лампов`/`ым`; paragraph `сформулиров`/`ано`, `вме`/`сте`; list `врод`/`е`.

Independent verification of the original paragraph work, carried over from #15021: the paragraph regression test fails on the base commit (`2 failed | 42 passed`) and passes with the fix (`44/44`), and the Windows build, typecheck, lint and bundle are green here. Credit to @holny for the earlier reproduction attempts in the issue thread.

One caveat about the pair above, stated plainly: the "before" frame was captured from the commit this branch was cut from, while the branch itself sits on a later `main` after a merge. The comparison therefore shows the product before and after the three fixes plus unrelated upstream movement. The per-path unit tests, not the screenshots, are what attribute the fix to these changes.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests via the package's own vitest runner. Live frames from a real ConPTY session driven through a pseudo-terminal harness with the terminal buffer captured headlessly; the CLI was built and bundled locally on Windows.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an explicitly declared width clips instead of overflowing if a call site opts in while passing an available width that already accounts for its own border and padding. That is why the opt-in is per call site and is enabled only on the conversational paths, which pass the width the block may actually use.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS and Linux. Also not validated: terminals that render ambiguous-width characters as two cells. The fix restores the reserved two-column right margin, which absorbs that drift on lines with no ambiguous glyphs, but a boundary line carrying several of them can still exceed the terminal width by more than the margin; that residual is unchanged by this PR and is tracked in the issue.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No public options or settings are added or changed.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14075

Take-over of #15021 by agreement with its author; the paragraph change and the verification above are carried over from it. The remaining caveat noted under Risk & Scope is carried over as well, so the closing keyword reflects the reported symptom being addressed on the reported platform, not a claim that ambiguous-width terminal behaviour was measured.

QwenCode QwenLLM

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

在静态会话（static transcript）渲染路径上，没有自身宽度的文本块会被布局引擎隐式测量，因此占满终端宽度的行可能侵占预留的右边距，随后由终端在单词中间强制断行。本 PR 为受影响的三类会话内容块显式声明宽度：普通段落、markdown 有序/无序列表项，以及 markdown 引用块。该宽度按调用点逐个开启，只在会话类调用点启用；那些可用宽度本身已包含自身边框与内边距的调用点有意保持不动。

这是与 #15021 作者（@PanSHIgg）协商后对该 PR 的接手（take-over）。作者已同意在此推进，并在本 PR 开出后关闭原 PR。段落部分原样沿用其改动；列表项与引用块两部分把同一机制扩展到原 PR 中留作后续项的两个调用点。

## 为什么需要

报告的症状是：某行顶到终端右边缘后，有一两个字符单独落在第 0 列，下一行的缩进也随之错位。该问题与宽度相关，报告环境为 Windows、100 列。根因是换行文本未声明宽度，布局引擎可能交给终端比实际可用空间宽一格或数格的行。为这三类内容块声明真实宽度即可消除该可能。

原 PR 只覆盖段落，并明确把列表项及其余调用点留作后续。在真实终端中验证段落修复时，同样的缺陷在有序列表和引用块上也被观察到，因此三者一并在此修复，而不是分三轮。

## 评审验证方案

### 如何验证

回归测试在固定终端宽度下把真实会话组件渲染进真实的 static 列表，并断言任何渲染行的宽度都不超过会话预留的空间（终端宽度减去两列边距）。三类内容块各有自己的测试，并且每个测试都在“该类型尚未修复”的构建上失败：

| 构建 | 失败的测试 |
| --- | --- |
| 当前 `main`，无任何修复 | 段落、扁平列表、嵌套列表、引用块 — `5 failed` |
| 仅段落修复 | 扁平列表、嵌套列表 |
| 仅列表修复 | 引用块 |
| 三项全部 | 无 — 会话与 markdown 两个测试套件共 `237 passed` |

因此三个缺陷由彼此独立的信号区分：修复其中一个不会掩盖另一个。评审者可以回退源码改动后重跑该测试文件来复现第一行。

实机验证：在 100 列 Windows 终端中关闭虚拟化历史运行 CLI，要求模型给出一个长段落、一个含两条长条目的有序列表和一行长引用。修改前，单词在右边缘被截断，碎片落在第 0 列；修改后按词边界换行，右边距保持完整。

### 前后对比证据

以下两帧来自同一模型、同一工作目录、真实 100 列 Windows ConPTY，唯一差别是构建产物。文件：`14075-three-base-100col.png`、`14075-three-fixed-100col.png`。

修改前 — 引用块、段落、列表均断裂；最宽行 100 格，上限为 98 格（见英文正文代码块）。

修改后 — 同样三块内容，第 0 列无孤立碎片，最宽内容行 98 格。

修改前可见、修改后消失的断裂：引用块 `Бэбби`/`джа`、`лампов`/`ым`；段落 `сформулиров`/`ано`、`вме`/`сте`；列表 `врод`/`е`。

来自 #15021 的独立验证结论一并保留：段落回归测试在基线提交上失败（`2 failed | 42 passed`），加上修复后通过（`44/44`）；本分支在 Windows 上的构建、类型检查、lint 与打包均为绿。感谢 @holny 在 issue 讨论中的早期复现尝试。

关于上述对比的一个坦率说明：“修改前”那一帧取自本分支切出时的提交，而分支本身在合并后已位于更新的 `main`。因此该对比展示的是“三项修复加上无关上游变更”前后的产品状态。真正把修复归因于本次改动的是按路径拆分的单元测试，而不是截图。

### 测试平台

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### 运行环境（可选）

单元测试使用各包自带的 vitest。实机截图由伪终端脚本驱动真实 ConPTY 会话并无头抓取终端缓冲得到；CLI 在 Windows 本地构建并打包。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：若某个调用点在可用宽度已包含自身边框与内边距的情况下开启该开关，显式宽度会造成裁切而不是溢出。因此该开关按调用点启用，且只在会话类路径启用，这些路径传入的正是内容块真正可使用的宽度。
- 未验证／范围之外：macOS 与 Linux。同样未验证：把 ambiguous-width 字符按两格渲染的终端。本修复恢复了预留的两列右边距，在无 ambiguous 字符的行上足以吸收该偏差；但若边界行含有多个此类字符，仍可能超出终端宽度并超过该边距，这一残余问题本 PR 不改变，并在 issue 中继续跟踪。
- 破坏性变更／迁移说明：无。未新增或修改任何公开选项或设置。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #14075

与 #15021 作者协商后的接手 PR；段落改动与上述验证结论均由其继承。Risk & Scope 中提到的残余说明同样保留，因此关闭关键字表示“在报告平台上已处理所报告的症状”，并不声称已测量 ambiguous-width 终端行为。

</details>

prs.title: ci: route the no-AK integration gate to ECS for every pull request
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Routes the no-AK integration gate to the self-hosted ECS pool for every pull request, untrusted forks included, by reading the same classifier output the lint lane reads. The gate's PR-code step already pinned a step-level runner.temp HOME with every model key emptied; that HOME now becomes run-unique and is cleared before use. The routing battery extends its lane-set pin to the recorded two lanes and gains a zero-secrets contract assertion: any real credential added to the PR-code step's env reds the suite. The test lane and the merge-queue-only CLI integration lane keep the association-gated routing unchanged.

## Why it's needed

After the earlier routing changes, an untrusted fork PR's remaining hosted waiters are Test (~40 min) and this gate (~30-60 min) — while the gate is, by construction, the same trust class as the lint lane whose shared-pool risk was accepted on 2026-10-31: its integration step executes PR code, but it holds no secrets (the entire point of the "no-AK" lane is that every model key is emptied at the step that runs that code; the job's only token is the read-only checkout grant). Its PR-code step already isolates HOME. Keeping it on hosted for forks buys no security boundary the lint decision has not already crossed, and it is the largest remaining source of fork PR queue time.

The HOME change closes the one gap found in the lane's existing isolation: RUNNER_TEMP survives across jobs on this pool, so the previously fixed directory name could hand a fork's writes to the next job on the same runner registration — the same cross-job persistence the lint lane's round-2 review caught (R2-1) and fixed with run-unique paths.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Re-run CI on a fork PR from an author without write access: Integration Tests (no-AK, No Sandbox) should land on an ECS runner alongside Lint & Static, while Test stays on ubuntu-latest.
- `node --test .github/scripts/ci-runner-routing.test.mjs` (103 tests): the lane-set pin now expects exactly `lint_and_static` and `integration_no_ak`, and the no-AK case asserts the run-unique HOME and the emptied key env.

prs.title: fix(permissions): report malformed rules instead of dropping them silently
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A permission rule whose parentheses do not balance is parsed as inert: it matches nothing. On the current base (#15794) such a rule already produces one generic warning, but that line cannot say which list owns it — the same malformed rule in `allow` and `deny` prints two identical lines — it repeats for every manager the hosted path builds, and `/permissions` still filters the rule out, so it cannot be seen or deleted there. This PR makes the drop visible: the permission manager warns on the console, naming the list, the raw rule and the consequence, using the same operator-facing breadcrumb `tools.eager` already prints from the same initializer; and `/permissions` keeps the unparsable rule in the listing, marked `(unparsable)`, so it can be seen and deleted instead of being filtered out. Matching semantics are unchanged — a malformed rule still matches nothing, so no allow/deny decision moves.

## Why it's needed

The asymmetry is what makes this a security problem rather than a logging nit: a malformed allow rule fails closed (nothing gets auto-approved), but a malformed deny/ask rule fails open — the restriction the operator wrote does not exist, and neither startup output nor `/permissions` mentioned it. The operator's mental model is "docker is blocked"; the runtime's behaviour is "no such rule". Turning silent fail-open into visible fail-open is the minimal, semantics-preserving step the issue asks for first: the operator still has to fix the configuration, but now they know there is something to fix.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Write a malformed deny rule into a settings file:

```json
{ "permissions": { "deny": ["Bash(docker *"] } }
```

Start the CLI. Before any prompt, stderr shows:

```
permissions.deny: ignoring malformed deny rule (no closing parenthesis at the end): "Bash(docker *". The rule has no effect; write it as "Tool(specifier)", with the "(" and ")" around the whole specifier.
```

Open `/permissions`, switch to the Deny tab: the rule is listed as `(unparsable) Bash(docker *`. Select it and delete it — the row disappears and stays gone on the next open. Then fix the rule to `Bash(docker *)` and restart: no warning, no marker, and a denied command prompts as before.

Focused suites:

```bash
cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/permissions
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/ui/opentui/dialog-data.test.ts src/ui/opentui/dialogs-permissions.test.tsx src/i18n
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: starting with `deny: ["Bash(docker *"]` printed a generic line with no list name — `[permissions] ignoring malformed rule (unbalanced parentheses): Bash(docker *` — emitted by `packages/core/src/permissions/permission-rules.ts`, once per manager the hosted path builds; and `/permissions` simply did not list the rule.

After, from the built CLI with that settings file:

```
permissions.deny: ignoring malformed deny rule (no closing parenthesis at the end): "Bash(docker *". The rule has no effect; write it as "Tool(specifier)", with the "(" and ")" around the whole specifier.
```

With the corrected rule `Bash(docker *)` the same run prints no warning — the negative control.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

macOS: Node 22.23.4, `npm run build`, all focused suites green, plus the headless run quoted above. Linux: Docker `node:22-bookworm`, same suites green, and `tsc --noEmit` clean for both packages. Windows was not run.

### Environment (optional)

Focused unit suites and a headless `dist/index.js` run with a temporary `HOME`; the Linux pass used a Docker volume workspace because a bind-mounted tree trips `rimraf` with `ENOTEMPTY`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a configuration that keeps a malformed rule now prints one line per bad rule from the permission manager at startup (the pre-existing `permission-rules.ts` line can still fire for the same configuration, so a single run may show both shapes), and `/permissions` shows an extra row. No permission decision changes.
- Not validated / out of scope: the issue's other two asks — failing closed (rejecting a malformed deny/ask at load, or denying the tool it names) and the analogous `tools.disabled` typo check — are deliberately left out. The first changes runtime matching semantics, the second is a separate registry check; both fit a follow-up.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. `parseRules` no longer writes to the debug log; reporting moved into the permission manager, its only caller.
- Coordination: #15775 implements the same fix for the same issue, so only one of the two can land; whoever merges second will conflict on the dialog, data and parser files.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15752 — already closed by #15794, which landed the generic warning this PR builds on. This PR is a follow-up to that fix, not a fix for that issue.

The two deferred rule shapes — `Bash(rm -rf /))` and `Bash)` — are tracked in #16078, which stays open for the maintainer decision on whether they should be rejected at load. The separate `tools.disabled` typo check was wired up in #16120 and is not part of this PR.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

括号不配对的权限规则会被解析成惰性规则：它不匹配任何调用。在当前 base（#15794）上，这类规则已经会打一行通用告警，但那一行说不清规则属于哪张列表（同一条畸形规则同时出现在 `allow` 和 `deny` 时会打两行完全相同的日志）、会随 hosted 路径每次新建 manager 重复打印，而且 `/permissions` 仍然把它过滤掉，既看不到也删不掉。这个 PR 把"被丢弃"变成可见：权限管理器在控制台告警，点明所在的列表、原始规则和后果，写法沿用同一个初始化流程里 `tools.eager` 已经在用的"面向操作者"面包屑；同时 `/permissions` 不再过滤掉无法解析的规则，而是把它列出来并标注 `(unparsable)`，让操作者能看到并删除。匹配语义完全没有变——畸形规则依旧不匹配任何东西，所以没有任何 allow/deny 判定会因此改变。

## 为什么需要它

这种不对称正是它属于安全问题而不只是日志问题的原因：畸形 allow 规则是 fail-closed（不会自动放行任何东西），但畸形 deny/ask 规则是 fail-open——操作者写下的限制并不存在，而且启动输出和 `/permissions` 都不会提到它。操作者的心智模型是"docker 被拦住了"，运行时的事实是"根本没有这条规则"。把静默的 fail-open 变成可见的 fail-open，是这个 issue 要求的第一步，也是改动最小、不触碰语义的一步：配置仍然要由操作者自己修，但现在他知道有东西要修。

## Reviewer Test Plan（评审验证计划）

### 如何验证

```json

```

启动 CLI。在任何提示词之前，stderr 会打印：

```
permissions.deny: ignoring malformed deny rule (no closing parenthesis at the end): "Bash(docker *". The rule has no effect; write it as "Tool(specifier)", with the "(" and ")" around the whole specifier.
```

打开 `/permissions`，切到 Deny 标签页：该规则显示为 `(unparsable) Bash(docker *`。选中它并删除，这一行会消失，下次打开也不再出现。再把规则改成 `Bash(docker *)` 重启：没有告警、没有标记，被拒绝的命令照旧弹确认。

定向测试：

```bash
cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/permissions
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/ui/opentui/dialog-data.test.ts src/ui/opentui/dialogs-permissions.test.tsx src/i18n
```

### 证据（改动前后）

改动前：用 `deny: ["Bash(docker *"]` 启动只打印一行不带列表名的通用告警 `[permissions] ignoring malformed rule (unbalanced parentheses): Bash(docker *`（来自 `packages/core/src/permissions/permission-rules.ts`，hosted 路径每新建一个 manager 就重复一次），`/permissions` 也完全不列出这条规则。

改动后，用该配置文件运行构建产物：

```
permissions.deny: ignoring malformed deny rule (no closing parenthesis at the end): "Bash(docker *". The rule has no effect; write it as "Tool(specifier)", with the "(" and ")" around the whole specifier.
```

把规则改成 `Bash(docker *)` 后同样运行不再打印任何告警——反向对照。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

macOS：Node 22.23.4，`npm run build`，上述定向测试全部通过，并做了上文引用的 headless 运行。Linux：Docker `node:22-bookworm`，同样的测试全部通过，两个包的 `tsc --noEmit` 也干净。Windows 未运行。

### 运行环境（可选）

定向单元测试，加上用临时 `HOME` 跑的 `dist/index.js` headless 运行；Linux 那轮用 Docker volume 作工作区，因为 bind mount 的目录会让 `rimraf` 报 `ENOTEMPTY`。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：如果配置里保留了畸形规则，启动时权限管理器会按每条坏规则打印一行（原有的 `permission-rules.ts` 那行仍可能对同一份配置触发，所以一次运行可能同时看到两种文案），`/permissions` 也会多出一行。没有任何权限判定发生变化。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：issue 提出的另外两项——fail-closed（加载时拒绝畸形 deny/ask，或直接拒绝它点名的工具）以及 `tools.disabled` 拼写错误的同类校验——有意未包含。前者会改变运行时匹配语义，后者是另一条注册表校验路径，都更适合作为后续 PR。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。`parseRules` 不再写 debug 日志，告警移到了权限管理器里，而它是唯一的调用方。
- 协作：同样修复这个 issue 的 #15775 仍然开着，两者只能落一个；后合的那个会在对话框、数据与 parser 文件上冲突。

关联 #15752——该 issue 已由 #15794 关闭，后者落了本 PR 在其基础上继续的通用告警；本 PR 是那次修复的后续，而不是修复 #15752 本身。

prs.title: fix(cli): reply to SDK initialize only after config is ready
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The SDK `initialize` control response is now sent after config initialization finishes, not right after the request is handled. The initialize request is still handled first, so its SDK MCP servers and staged SDK-only config are in place before extensions load. If config initialization fails, the request receives an error response instead of no reply at all.

In protocol terms, the frame's meaning changes from "request accepted" to "SDK mode is ready": a client may treat a successful `initialize` reply as permission to send its first prompt.

## Why it's needed

`initialize` was answered before `config.initialize()` ran, so the reply only meant "request accepted". A client that sent its first prompt on that reply then blocked on readiness; when the shared extension store was locked by another process, it waited out the ~28s retry budget and surfaced "Extension store is busy". Making the reply wait for config initialization turns it into the readiness signal clients already assume it is, and gives initialization failures a place to be reported.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Use the controlled repro from the issue: hold the `extension-store/lock` and start a stream-json SDK session.
2. Send `initialize`, then one user frame.
Before: `initialize` replies while the lock is still held, and the first prompt later fails with "Extension store is busy". After: the `initialize` reply arrives only once config initialization has completed, so a prompt sent after it no longer races extension loading. If initialization fails, the same request gets an error response.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Non-UI change, so N/A for screenshots. `replies to initialize only after config initialization finishes` fails on the previous ordering (reply sent while initialization is pending) and passes here; `replies to initialize with an error when SDK mode initialization fails` covers the new failure reply. Existing dispatch behaviour is unchanged and covered by `ControlDispatcher` tests, including the deferred failure path: with `deferResponse` the dispatcher must send nothing and leave the reply to the caller.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Unit tests on macOS and in a `node:22-bookworm` container; Windows not exercised.

### Environment (optional)

`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/nonInteractive/control/ControlDispatcher.test.ts src/nonInteractive/session.test.ts` (97 tests).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the initialize reply now includes config initialization latency, so clients that pipelined work on the old "accepted" ack see a later reply. That is the intended protocol meaning of the frame.
- Not validated / out of scope: the read path still takes the exclusive extension-store lock; concurrent sessions sharing one config dir can still serialize. Only the readiness ordering is changed here.
- Known pre-existing limitation, stated because the reply is now a readiness signal: duplicate `initialize` request ids. `registerIncomingRequest` overwrites the entry by id and a cancel answers only one frame, so the earlier caller waits out the SDK timeout. The registry behaviour is unchanged by this PR.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Closes #15796

prs.title: feat(sdk): support native Skill archives and receipt lookup (3/4)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the archive-installation protocol already delivered by #16421 and #16422 available through the public TypeScript SDK. A caller can send a ZIP directly as File, Blob or bytes, or ask the daemon to install a ZIP already on its host by absolute path with an optional SHA-256 check. Both global User Skills and a specifically selected workspace are supported.

Every native installation gets an attempt ID before the request is sent. A successful response includes that ID and the archive digest; transport failures, timeouts and HTTP failures retain the ID and original failure details. The caller can query the attempt afterward to distinguish a committed installation from one that did not commit or needs recovery, without automatically sending the archive again. The same authentication, timeout, cancellation and browser progress transport is shared with ordinary file uploads.

This is layer 3/4 split from #15862. #16421 and #16422 are now merged; this PR targets `main` and contains only the original seven SDK files (+633/-98). #16424 supplies the Web Shell integration afterward. Synchronizing main preserves the existing User Skill activation API and does not add UI behavior to this layer.

## Why it's needed

After the daemon layer lands, integrations can use the new archive protocol only by implementing their own HTTP calls. For example, a client holding a 20 MiB ZIP should be able to send that File directly instead of encoding it as base64 inside the legacy JSON request. When the ZIP already exists on the daemon host, the client should be able to identify that file and optionally verify its digest without downloading and uploading it again.

The second problem is an uncertain result: a dropped connection or a cancelled request does not establish whether installation committed. Losing the attempt ID would leave the integration unable to query the daemon and could lead it to repeat an installation unnecessarily. This layer exposes the receipt protocol and preserves the ID across failures so the integration can reconcile the result first.

Native installation requests default to 130 seconds, leaving room for the daemon's 120-second publication budget. An explicit zero disables the client timeout only; caller cancellation still applies. Explicit timeout and cancellation options also work for existing config-install sources. Unknown or expired receipts return `undefined`; ownership and other HTTP failures still throw. Receipts are process-local, retained for ten minutes after settlement, with a 256-entry capacity, so they are a bounded reconciliation mechanism rather than durable history.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Install a valid archive as a global User Skill and into a selected secondary workspace. Confirm the returned attempt ID and digest match, and only the selected destination receives the files.
- Install a host ZIP with a correct digest, then try an incorrect digest. Confirm the failed request preserves its attempt ID, HTTP details and original cause, and its receipt shows that it did not commit.
- Query a completed attempt through the same owner. Confirm an unknown attempt returns no receipt, while an inaccessible workspace remains an error. A failed upload must not automatically issue another installation request.
- Check the native timeout margin, explicit zero, caller cancellation and browser progress contract. Confirm ordinary file uploads retain authentication, attribution, response validation and cancellation behavior; standalone sessions and existing Skill activation remain compatible.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for browser UI: this layer changes the SDK. The six focused SDK test files pass 649 tests, including native archive methods, ordinary file uploads, standalone sessions, REST requests, User Skill activation and public exports. The separate public-surface typecheck also passes, so the legacy-source-union assertion is checked by TypeScript, not only loaded by the unit test runner. Changed-file Prettier and ESLint checks pass.

Root build, root typecheck and bundle also passed. At synchronized head `e85772f40ed3d959307cfc6db2561e4262b7c433`, 15 built-SDK acceptance cases passed: 14 against a real daemon and one real loopback disconnection. They cover 20 MiB File/Blob, host ZIP, owner-scoped receipts, retained failure IDs and ordinary uploads. [Full report and review dispositions](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16423#issuecomment-6676803794) record artifact hashes, assertions and limits. This exercised the public CommonJS SDK with Node fetch; no browser/XHR or ESM consumer was run. Test processes exited 0; daemon shutdown exited 1 on an ACP preheat `kill EPERM`, with no owned process left behind. [Full CI for this head](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42161803613) is running and is not yet counted as passed.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Local SDK checks; exact-head integration evidence below |
| 🪟 Windows | Not run locally; see this head's CI |
| 🐧 Linux | Not run locally; see this head's CI |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, Node.js 26.7.0, pnpm 11.24.0, isolated worktree. Original SDK head: `e011fd8b92e1700e72be96299e091becf8ecaca8`; synchronized main baseline: `da7af136e5e13e2a6a367501b722c7beaa1b1933`. The normal PR CI workflow is now eligible because the target is main; its results must be checked independently of local evidence.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: The shared binary transport serves both archive installs and ordinary uploads. Regression checks cover those consumers. The new public types and methods are additive; the legacy runtime source union stays unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: Browser UI integration belongs to #16424. This PR does not provide durable receipts, cross-process serialization, resumable uploads or automatic retries, and does not change daemon archive limits or the legacy JSON limit.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: Existing config-install calls remain accepted. The workspace-qualified config-install error message now uses the same Skill label as the singular client; HTTP status and body remain available. New native methods require the daemon capability delivered by #16422; integrations must preflight capabilities when connecting to an older daemon.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/da7af136e5e13e2a6a367501b722c7beaa1b1933/docs/design/2026-10-29-skill-archive-installation.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/da7af136e5e13e2a6a367501b722c7beaa1b1933/docs/design/2026-10-29-skill-archive-installation.zh-CN.md). Both versions describe the complete feature and the four delivery layers.

## Linked Issues

Split from #15862; follows #15030. Dependencies #16421 and #16422 are merged; #16424 is the remaining UI layer.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

通过公开 TypeScript SDK 提供 #16421 和 #16422 已交付的归档安装协议。调用方可以直接发送 File、Blob 或字节形式的 ZIP，也可以提供 daemon 主机上的 ZIP 绝对路径，并选择校验 SHA-256。支持安装到全局 User Skill 或明确选定的工作区。

每次原生安装都会在发送前获得尝试 ID。成功响应包含该 ID 和归档摘要；传输错误、超时和 HTTP 失败仍保留 ID 及原始错误信息。调用方可以随后查询这次尝试，区分已经提交、未提交或需要恢复，而不自动重新发送归档。归档与普通文件上传共用认证、超时、取消及浏览器进度传输逻辑。

这是 #15862 拆分后的第 3/4 层。#16421 和 #16422 均已合入，本 PR 直接以 `main` 为目标，只包含原有 7 个 SDK 文件（+633/-98）。#16424 随后提供 Web Shell 接入。本次同步保留 main 已有的 User Skill 激活接口，本层不增加界面行为。

## 为什么需要

daemon 层合入后，集成方仍需要自己编写 HTTP 请求，才能使用新归档协议。例如，客户端已经持有一个 20 MiB ZIP 时，应能直接发送这个 File，而不用先编码成 base64 放进旧 JSON 请求。如果 ZIP 已经位于 daemon 主机上，客户端应能引用该文件并按需校验摘要，而不用先下载再上传。

另一个问题是安装结果不确定：连接断开或请求取消，不代表安装一定没有提交。如果丢失尝试 ID，集成方就无法查询 daemon，可能重复执行一次已经成功的安装。本层提供回执查询，并在失败时保留 ID，让集成方先确认结果。

原生安装默认超时为 130 秒，为 daemon 的 120 秒发布预算留出返回余量。显式设置为零只关闭客户端超时，调用方仍可取消。显式超时和取消选项也适用于既有配置安装来源。未知或已过期的回执返回 `undefined`，归属错误及其他 HTTP 错误仍抛出。回执保存在进程内，终结后保留十分钟，容量为 256 条，因此只用于有限时间内确认结果，不是持久化历史。

## 审查验证计划

### 如何验证

- 将有效归档分别安装为全局 User Skill 和指定的次工作区 Skill。确认返回的尝试 ID、摘要一致，文件只写入所选目标。
- 使用正确摘要安装主机 ZIP，再使用错误摘要尝试安装。确认失败仍保留尝试 ID、HTTP 详情和原始原因，查询回执显示未提交。
- 通过同一归属查询已完成尝试。确认未知尝试返回无回执，而不可访问工作区仍是错误。上传失败不得自动发起第二次安装。
- 检查原生超时余量、显式零值、调用方取消及浏览器进度契约。确认普通文件上传保留认证、调用方标识、响应校验和取消行为，独立会话及已有 Skill 激活保持兼容。

### 改动前后证据

本层改动 SDK，不涉及浏览器界面。6 个定向 SDK 测试文件共 649 个测试通过，覆盖原生归档、普通上传、独立会话、REST 请求、User Skill 激活及公开导出。单独的公开类型检查也已通过，旧来源联合类型未被扩大的断言确实由 TypeScript 检查，而不是仅由单测加载。改动文件的 Prettier 和 ESLint 检查通过。

根目录构建、类型检查及 bundle 也已通过。在同步提交 `e85772f40ed3d959307cfc6db2561e4262b7c433` 上，15 项构建后 SDK 验收通过：14 项连接真实 daemon，另 1 项验证真实回环连接断开。覆盖 20 MiB File/Blob、主机 ZIP、按归属查询回执、失败后保留 ID 及普通上传。[完整报告及评审处置](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16423#issuecomment-6676803794) 记录产物摘要、断言与限制。本次通过 Node fetch 使用公开 CommonJS SDK，未执行浏览器/XHR 或 ESM 消费方。测试进程 exit 0；daemon 关闭时因 ACP 预热进程 `kill EPERM` 退出 1，独立检查未发现残留进程。[当前提交完整 CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42161803613) 正在运行，尚未计作通过。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 本地 SDK 检查；当前提交的集成证据见下 |
| 🪟 Windows | 未在本地执行；查看当前提交的 CI |
| 🐧 Linux | 未在本地执行；查看当前提交的 CI |

### 环境

macOS arm64、Node.js 26.7.0、pnpm 11.24.0，独立 worktree。原始 SDK 提交为 `e011fd8b92e1700e72be96299e091becf8ecaca8`，同步后的 main 基线为 `da7af136e5e13e2a6a367501b722c7beaa1b1933`。目标改为 main 后，常规 PR CI 已满足触发条件；其结果必须与本地证据分别检查。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：归档安装和普通上传共用二进制传输，回归检查覆盖这两类消费者。公开类型和方法为增量扩展，旧 runtime 来源联合类型保持不变。
- 未验证或不在范围内：浏览器界面由 #16424 接入。本 PR 不提供持久化回执、跨进程串行、断点续传或自动重试，也不修改 daemon 归档限额或旧 JSON 上限。
- 兼容与迁移：既有配置安装调用仍可使用。指定工作区配置安装的错误文本改为与单数客户端一致的 Skill 标签，HTTP 状态和正文仍可读取。新原生方法需要 #16422 提供的 daemon 能力；连接旧 daemon 时，集成方必须先检查能力声明。

设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/da7af136e5e13e2a6a367501b722c7beaa1b1933/docs/design/2026-10-29-skill-archive-installation.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/da7af136e5e13e2a6a367501b722c7beaa1b1933/docs/design/2026-10-29-skill-archive-installation.zh-CN.md)。两种语言均描述完整功能及四层交付边界。

## 关联

从 #15862 拆分；基于 #15030 的后续增强。依赖 #16421、#16422 已合入；剩余界面层为 #16424。

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): show notification guides only for the browser's OS
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The Task notifications popover in the Web Shell lists the system-level setup steps to try when reminders do not appear. It currently renders the macOS guide and the Windows guide side by side, unconditionally, so every user sees instructions for an operating system they are not on.

This PR detects the operating system of the browser that is showing the page and renders only the matching guide. Unrecognized platforms keep both guides rather than showing none, so the change cannot hide help from anyone.

## Why it's needed

Closes #16363. The popover is the place a user lands when notifications are not working, and it is where they are told what to check in their OS settings. On macOS the Windows steps are noise, and on Windows the macOS steps are noise; both point at settings that do not exist on the user's machine. Filtering by the client OS keeps that fallback path direct.

The platform is read from `navigator.platform`, so it reflects the machine running the browser, not the daemon, container or server that hosts the Web Shell. This matters because the Web Shell is commonly served from a remote daemon whose OS is unrelated to the user's.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The added cases assert the rendered guide headings for a given `navigator.platform`:

| `navigator.platform` | Guides shown |
| :--- | :--- |
| `Win32` | Windows |
| `MacIntel` | macOS |
| `iPhone` | macOS |
| `Linux x86_64` | macOS and Windows |
| unset / empty | macOS and Windows |

Run the component tests from `packages/web-shell`:

```bash
npx vitest run client/components/messages/BrowserNotificationControl.test.tsx
```

All 20 cases pass (15 existing, 5 added). The 5 added cases include the negative control described below.

### Evidence (Before & After)

I wrote a standalone reproduction against unmodified `main` at `92bed7ee` before touching the component. It rendered the popover with `navigator.platform` stubbed to `Win32` and to `MacIntel` and asserted the guide headings:

```
AssertionError: expected [ 'macOS', 'Windows' ] to deeply equal [ 'Windows' ]
AssertionError: expected [ 'macOS', 'Windows' ] to deeply equal [ 'macOS' ]
```

Both guides rendered on both platforms, which reproduces the issue.

As a negative control for the fix itself, I reverted only the component change and re-ran the new cases:

```
× lists only the guides for Win32
× lists only the guides for MacIntel
× lists only the guides for iPhone
Tests  3 failed | 17 passed (20)
```

The Linux and unset cases pass either way by design, since they keep the pre-existing behavior. Restoring the fix takes the file to 20/20.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Linux and Windows were not run locally. The `Linux x86_64` platform string is covered by a unit test.

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests via `vitest` (jsdom). Full `client/components/messages/` directory: 55 files, 1566 tests, all passing. Prettier, ESLint and `tsc --noEmit` are clean for the package.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: `/^Win/i.test(platform)` and `/Mac|iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(platform)` rely on `navigator.platform`, which is deprecated and frozen in some browsers. The fallback is deliberate: anything not recognized keeps both guides, so a wrong or missing value cannot hide the instructions.
- Not validated / out of scope: not verified in a real browser against a live `qwen serve` daemon; verification is at the jsdom unit-test level. Linux and Windows were not exercised locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No new i18n keys, no public API change. The existing translation strings for both guides are reused unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Closes #16363

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

Web Shell 的「任务通知」浮层里，列着「没收到提醒时该检查什么」的系统级设置步骤。目前它把 macOS 和 Windows 两份指引并排、无条件地渲染出来，所以每个用户都会看到不属于自己操作系统的那一份。

这个 PR 检测当前显示页面的浏览器所在的操作系统，只渲染匹配的那一份。无法识别的平台会保留两份而不是一份都不显示，因此这个改动不会让任何人看不到帮助。

## 为什么需要

关闭 #16363。用户发现通知不工作时就会打开这个浮层，也正是在这里被告知要去系统设置里检查什么。在 macOS 上 Windows 的步骤是干扰，在 Windows 上 macOS 的步骤是干扰；两者都指向用户机器上并不存在的设置。按客户端操作系统过滤，能让这条兜底路径更直接。

平台信息读自 `navigator.platform`，因此反映的是运行浏览器的那台机器，而不是托管 Web Shell 的 daemon、容器或服务器。这一点很重要，因为 Web Shell 常常由远端 daemon 提供服务，而那个 daemon 的操作系统与用户无关。

## 审阅者验证方式

新增用例针对给定的 `navigator.platform` 断言渲染出的指引标题：

| `navigator.platform` | 显示的指引 |
| :--- | :--- |
| `Win32` | Windows |
| `MacIntel` | macOS |
| `iPhone` | macOS |
| `Linux x86_64` | macOS 与 Windows |
| 未设置 / 空 | macOS 与 Windows |

在 `packages/web-shell` 下运行组件测试：

```bash
npx vitest run client/components/messages/BrowserNotificationControl.test.tsx
```

20 个用例全部通过（原有 15 个，新增 5 个）。新增的 5 个中包含下述负向对照。

### 证据（修改前后）

在改动组件之前，我先针对未经修改的 `main`（`92bed7ee`）写了一个独立复现。它把 `navigator.platform` 分别打桩为 `Win32` 和 `MacIntel` 渲染浮层，并断言指引标题：

```
AssertionError: expected [ 'macOS', 'Windows' ] to deeply equal [ 'Windows' ]
AssertionError: expected [ 'macOS', 'Windows' ] to deeply equal [ 'macOS' ]
```

两个平台上两份指引都渲染了，问题得到复现。

作为修复本身的负向对照，我只回退组件改动后重跑新增用例：

```
× lists only the guides for Win32
× lists only the guides for MacIntel
× lists only the guides for iPhone
Tests  3 failed | 17 passed (20)
```

Linux 和未设置的两条用例在两种情况下都通过，这是设计使然——它们保留的是原有行为。恢复修复后该文件为 20/20。

### 测试平台

|     系统   | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

Linux 和 Windows 未在本地运行。`Linux x86_64` 这个平台字符串由单元测试覆盖。

### 环境（可选）

通过 `vitest`（jsdom）运行单元测试。`client/components/messages/` 整个目录：55 个文件、1566 个测试全部通过。该包的 Prettier、ESLint 与 `tsc --noEmit` 均无问题。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：`/^Win/i.test(platform)` 与 `/Mac|iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(platform)` 依赖 `navigator.platform`，该属性已被废弃，并且在部分浏览器中已冻结。兜底是有意为之：任何无法识别的值都保留两份指引，因此错误或缺失的值不会导致指引消失。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：没有在真实浏览器中对接运行中的 `qwen serve` daemon 验证；验证停留在 jsdom 单元测试层面。Linux 与 Windows 未在本地运行。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。没有新增 i18n key，没有公共 API 变化。两份指引沿用的现有翻译字符串保持不变。

## 关联 Issue

Closes #16363

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): match one sed character for . and bracket expressions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The shell tool's in-process sed simulation now compiles substitution patterns with the `s` and `u` flags. This makes `.` match a carriage return and makes character classes and quantifiers operate on Unicode characters instead of UTF-16 code units. A literal `]` outside a bracket expression is escaped during translation so the stricter Unicode mode still accepts patterns such as `[\[\]]`.

## Why it's needed

On CRLF files, `s/=.*$/=new/` matched nothing and the tool reported that the edit made no changes. On files containing astral characters, `s/^.//` removed one half of an emoji and wrote the lone surrogate back as U+FFFD, silently corrupting the file. Real sed treats both cases as one character.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the sed parser unit tests. The new regression case covers the six rows from the issue: astral characters with `.`, a negated class, a zero-width `x*` match, and a CRLF substitution. Before the change it fails on the first astral row; after the change all cases pass. Also confirm that ordinary bracket patterns such as `[abc]`, `[^abc]`, and `[\[\]]` still take the simulation path rather than falling back.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI. Unit tests: 53 passed, including new pins for negated, mixed and equivalence-class POSIX forms (`[^[:space:]]`, `[[:alpha:]abc]`, `[[=a=]]`) and for the GNU/BSD multibyte-backreference split. The full core suite passed 39,351 tests; the single `bun-pty.test.ts` failure also reproduces on unmodified main. Typecheck, lint, and formatting pass.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux was verified in a Docker `node:22-bookworm` arm64 container.

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.4; unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the `u` flag can reject patterns that previously compiled, so those commands now fall back to real sed. That is the existing fail-safe path and never writes a wrong file.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows; GNU sed's zero-width `x*` iteration and multibyte backreferences are bytewise, while BSD sed and this simulation are characterwise. The POSIX-class guard now declines any pattern containing `[:`, `[.` or `[=`, so mixed and negated character classes also fall back to real sed instead of being simulated wrongly.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Closes #15675

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

shell 工具的进程内 sed 模拟现在会用 `s` 和 `u` 标志编译替换模式。这样 `.` 能匹配回车符，字符类和量词也按 Unicode 字符而不是 UTF-16 code unit 工作。翻译时会把字符类外的字面量 `]` 转义，保证更严格的 Unicode 模式仍能接受 `[\[\]]` 这类模式。

## 为什么需要

在 CRLF 文件上，`s/=.*$/=new/` 匹配不到任何内容，工具会报告没有产生修改。在包含星平面字符的文件上，`s/^.//` 只删掉 emoji 的一半，并把孤立代理项写成 U+FFFD，静默损坏文件。真实 sed 在两种情况下都按一个字符处理。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

运行 sed 解析器单测。新增回归用例覆盖 issue 里的六行：星平面字符配合 `.`、否定字符类、零宽 `x*` 匹配，以及 CRLF 替换。修改前第一行星平面用例失败，修改后全部通过。同时确认 `[abc]`、`[^abc]`、`[\[\]]` 这类普通字符类仍然走模拟路径，而不是回退。

### 证据（修改前后）

UI 变化：N/A。单测 53 通过，新增取反/混合/等价类 POSIX 形态（`[^[:space:]]`、`[[:alpha:]abc]`、`[[=a=]]`）以及 GNU/BSD 多字节反向引用分歧的钉子。core 全量 39,351 通过；唯一失败的 `bun-pty.test.ts` 在未修改的 main 上也能复现。类型检查、lint、格式化均通过。

### 测试环境

|    系统    | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

Linux 在 Docker `node:22-bookworm` arm64 容器中验证。

### 运行环境（可选）

Node 22.23.4；仅单测。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：`u` 标志会拒绝一些以前能编译的模式，这些命令会回退到真实 sed。这是既有的 fail-safe 路径，不会写错文件。
- 未验证/超出范围：Windows；GNU sed 的零宽 `x*` 与多字节反向引用按字节推进，而 BSD sed 和本模拟按字符推进。POSIX 字符类 guard 现在对含 `[:`、`[.`、`[=` 的模式一律回退，混合与取反写法也不再被错误模拟。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。

## 关联 issue

Closes #15675

</details>
