prs.title: fix(cli): surface stacked-skill overflow in non-interactive and ACP runs
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Non-interactive runs now report when more `/skill` tokens are stacked than the five-skill limit. `handleSlashCommand`'s stacked branch already received `exceededMax` from the parser but dropped it, so the result now carries the warning text, headless (`-p`, JSON, stream-JSON) writes it to stderr, and ACP (`daemon`, Web Shell, channels) emits it as a client-visible slash-command notice before the prompt runs.

## Why it's needed

Issue #16396: headless and daemon/ACP runs silently discarded the sixth and later `/skill` tokens. Both interactive surfaces already warn with `Only the first 5 skills were loaded. Additional /skill tokens were treated as prompt text.`, but the non-interactive path had no equivalent, so scripts and channel users could not tell that part of their input was ignored. The fix only reports the overflow: exactly `MAX_STACKED_SKILLS` skills load, the overflowing tokens stay prompt text, and a normal run keeps exit code 0 because the warning is never an `error` result.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Reproduce with six stacked skills through `handleSlashCommand` (unit level, no model call): before the fix the result had `stackedSkillOverflow === undefined`; after the fix it carries the warning and exactly five skill bodies are merged into the prompt, while the sixth token stays in the prompt text.

Run the two touched suites:

```
cd packages/cli
node ../../node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run \
```

prs.title: fix(core): report a cancelled shell as interrupted, not completed
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an explicit `interruptedBeforeCompletion` marker to a tool result and sets it when the shell tool is cancelled by the user. The scheduler's post-execute cancellation branch now chooses the cancellation notice from that marker instead of assuming that a returned result means the tool finished. The ACP session pipeline, which mirrors that branch for `qwen --acp`, the web shell and IDE clients, reads the same marker and keeps the producer's partial output as the detail.

## Why it's needed

On Esc/Ctrl+C the shell tool kills the process group but returns an ordinary result whose own content already says the command was cancelled. The scheduler's `aborted` branch hardcoded "The tool had already completed; its output was discarded", which discards that truthful text and tells the model the work finished — and not to retry it. For half-run migrations or deploys, a step that was killed is recorded as done.

The shell tool is not the only possible producer of this shape: any tool that reports interruption by returning rather than throwing was mislabelled the same way, so the signal lives on the result rather than being inferred from shell's wording. Of the producers that now set it, only `create_sub_session` was shown reachable in measurement. `monitor`, `workflow` (early abort) and `ask_user_question` set it as defence: the scheduler cancels those calls before `execute()` runs, so the marker is not read on those paths today. `ask_user_question` sets it only when the turn was actually aborted — a plain decline is a completed decision and leaves the marker unset.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Follow the reproduction in #15833 (`work.sh` writing `start`, sleeping, then `done`), run it through the CLI and press Esc about 1s in.
2. Ask the model whether the command finished.
Before: the tool result says the tool had already completed and that the output was discarded. After: it says the call was intentionally cancelled and that it must not retry or work around it.
Timeouts and background-promote refusals keep their existing outcomes; only a user cancel sets the marker on the shell path.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Non-UI change, so N/A for screenshots. The new scheduler table case fails on the previous code with `The tool had already completed; its output was discarded` and passes here; the shell test asserts the marker is set only on a user cancel; the question-tool tests assert it is set only when the turn was aborted; and the new ACP case asserts an interrupted result reaches the model as interrupted, with its partial output appended, while the unflagged case keeps the old wording.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Unit tests on macOS and in a `node:22-bookworm` container; Windows not exercised.

### Environment (optional)

`cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/coreToolScheduler.test.ts src/tools/shell.test.ts src/tools/askUserQuestion.test.ts` (942 tests); `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: one optional field on the result type. It is written by the shell tool and three returned-cancellation producers (only `create_sub_session` was reachable in measurement), and read only by the cancelled branch.
- Not validated / out of scope: `monitor`, `workflow` (early abort) and `ask_user_question` set the marker defensively; the scheduler cancels them before execution, so no model-visible change is claimed for those paths. A call cancelled before it starts ("cancelled before it could start") is not covered. A cancel that lands while the shell's confirmation dialog is still open (approval mode `default`) is also uncovered: it reports the generic cancelled reason, identically before and after this change. The managed-runtime surface still reports the old wording — its wrapper rebuilds a tool result from an explicit field whitelist that does not forward this marker — so this PR does not reach sessions whose tools run through that wrapper. Tracked as a follow-up rather than treated as fixed here. The sub-agent tool is also not covered: it returns its cancel as content parts and sets no marker, and the scheduler's detail gate requires a string `llmContent`, so setting the marker alone would not preserve its partial result. The ACP pipeline is covered by this PR.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Closes #15833

Thanks @stars-spark for the detailed reproduction.

prs.title: fix(core): name the model and setting in media refusals
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a model cannot accept an image, audio, or video file, Qwen Code refuses it with a message the model then reads. That message named neither the model nor the setting behind the refusal, and it read identically whether the input modalities were guessed from the model name or declared by the user. In both cases it ended by pointing at skills, which is the wrong direction when the real cause is a configuration value.

The refusal now leads with the model id and states how the modalities were resolved. A value inferred from the model name tells the caller to declare `generationConfig.modalities` on the provider entry. A value the user declared points at where it was declared instead. The rest of the guidance — that `read_file` cannot process the file either, and the skills fallback — is unchanged, as is the separate PDF wording that suggests installing the document-skills extension.

## Why it's needed

Reported in #16178. A provider-backed model with image input configured was refused, and the message sent the reporter down a resize-image path; the setting had been right all along and the resolved route genuinely had no image modality. The message was accurate about the state but not actionable, because the one fact that would have separated "you configured this wrong" from "we guessed wrong from the name" was already computed and then discarded.

The resolved configuration already tracks where each field came from, so the distinction costs no new resolution logic. The source kind is carried on the request context for the API-time path; the read_file path reads it directly. It is deliberately withheld when the generator is serving a model other than the configuration's primary one, so a sub-agent or side query cannot inherit the primary model's attribution and report a setting the user never set for it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Configure an OpenAI-compatible provider entry whose model id matches no known family pattern, without `generationConfig.modalities`, then ask the agent to read a PNG. The refusal should name that model id and say the modalities were inferred from the model name, with the exact JSON key to add.

Then add `"modalities": { "image": true }` to that entry and repeat: the image is read instead of refused, which confirms the advice points at the field that actually decides the outcome.

A model whose id does match a known vision pattern, with image modality left on, should still read images normally — the new text only replaces a refusal.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before and after are the text the model receives. Captured from the real read_file path and the real request-building pipeline, with a 1x1 PNG on disk and modalities resolving empty:

Before (both cases identical):

```
[Unsupported image file: "image.png". This model does not support image input. The read_file tool cannot process this type of file either. ...]
```

After, modalities guessed from the model name:

```
[Unsupported image file: "image.png". Model 'my-custom-openai-id' does not support image input: its input modalities were inferred from the model name. Declare "generationConfig": { "modalities": { "image": true } } on this provider entry to enable it. The read_file tool cannot process this type of file either. ...]
```

After, modalities declared on the provider entry without image:

```
[Unsupported image file: "image.png". Model 'my-custom-openai-id' does not support image input: this provider entry's "generationConfig.modalities" is set without image. Check it and re-select the model with /model. The read_file tool cannot process this type of file either. ...]
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Unit tests, type checking, lint, and formatting were all run inside a `node:22-bookworm` Linux container against the merged base. The macOS column is ⚠️ rather than ✅: the same suite also passes there, but the bundle build needed for the full CLI integration harness does not complete on this machine's container filesystem, so the end-to-end evidence above was produced from the source-level pipeline rather than a bundled CLI run. Nothing in this change is platform-specific.

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests and type checking in a Linux container; no sandbox, no live model endpoint.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the refusal text is what the model reads, so changed wording can shift model behaviour around file handling. The leading clause keeps the substring previous assertions and any model familiarity rely on, and the advice is additive.
- Not validated / out of scope: the reporter's original observation that the setting appeared to need a restart is not addressed here. The modalities are re-resolved on auth refresh and on `/model`, so the hint says "re-select the model with /model" rather than claiming a restart is required; whether their hot-reload path was misbehaving is a separate question left open on the issue.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The new request-context field is optional and nothing else reads the message text.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16178

prs.title: fix(ci): report main CI runs a job timeout cancelled
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The main-CI failure tracker now also reports a run GitHub concluded `cancelled`, after separating a job-timeout cancellation from a concurrency supersede by the job annotation. A timed-out run gets rerun whole instead of one-for-one, and the report names the cancelled job and step and says why the run ended.

## Why it's needed

The gate in `main-ci-failure-issue.yml` only admitted `conclusion == 'failure'`. A job that hits its `timeout-minutes` cap caps the whole run as cancelled with no failing job anywhere in it, so that class of breakage produced no report at all — which is how the E2E `sandbox:docker` shard sat red for weeks (#16214). Roughly half of that day's main E2E runs ended cancelled and only the failure-conclusion ones were ever looked at.

The two ways a run ends cancelled need opposite treatment. A concurrency supersede is replaced by the run that cancelled it and owns nothing, so reporting it would file an issue per supersede. A timeout is a real breakage whose only trace is this event. The job annotation tells them apart: only a timeout carries "The job has exceeded the maximum execution time". Reads fail open like every other one in that step, and the repeating dedupe marker bounds a misclassified supersede to one comment.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the two touched suites:

```
npx vitest run scripts/tests/main-ci-failure-issue-workflow.test.js
node --test .github/scripts/ci/main-failure-signature.test.mjs
```

Then confirm the classification against a run that actually timed out. Run 41743539611 is the one this issue was split from: its `E2E Test (Linux) - sandbox:docker - shard 1/1` job was cancelled at 01:14 after the full 60 minutes.

```
gh api "repos/QwenLM/qwen-code/check-runs/<id>/annotations" --jq '.[].message'
```

Expected: `The job has exceeded the maximum execution time of 1h0m0s`, which is what `cancellation_kind=timeout` selects on. A cancelled run without that annotation (a supersede) selects `superseded=true` and reports nothing.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — CI workflow change, not user-visible.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A  |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only; no workflow run was executed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the annotation read is one API call per cancelled job, bounded by the cancelled jobs in that run. A cancelled run whose annotations cannot be read is reported rather than dropped — a misclassified supersede costs one comment, a dropped timeout costs the regression, which is the direction the existing fail-open reads already take. A timed-out run's whole-run rerun counts as attempt 2, so a repeat timeout files rather than reruns again; that is deliberate.
- Not validated / out of scope: the workflow itself was not executed end to end. The annotation classification was verified against real cancelled runs through the same commands the step runs, but the rerun, dispatch gates and issue rendering were exercised only by the suite's stubs.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16272

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

主 CI 失败追踪现在也会上报 GitHub 结论为 `cancelled` 的运行，并通过 job annotation 区分「超时取消」与「并发取消」。超时的运行改为整轮重跑而不是只重跑失败 job；报告会写明被取消的 job 和步骤，并说明运行为什么结束。

## 为什么需要

`main-ci-failure-issue.yml` 的门条件只接受 `conclusion == 'failure'`。job 撞到 `timeout-minutes` 上限时，整个运行会被标记为 cancelled，而其中没有任何失败的 job，于是这一类故障完全不会产生报告——E2E 的 `sandbox:docker` shard 就是这样红了数周（#16214）。当天 main 上的 E2E 运行约有一半以 cancelled 结束，而只有结论为 failure 的那些被看过。

两种 cancelled 需要相反的处理方式。并发取消会被取消它的那次运行取代、本身不拥有结果，上报它等于每取消一次就开一个 issue；超时则是真实故障，这个事件是它唯一的痕迹。两者的区别在 job annotation 上：只有超时带有 "The job has exceeded the maximum execution time"。读取失败时按开放处理，与该步骤其它读取一致；重复的 dedupe marker 会把误判为超时的并发取消收敛到一条评论。

## 审阅者验证方式

跑两个受影响的测试套件：

```
npx vitest run scripts/tests/main-ci-failure-issue-workflow.test.js
node --test .github/scripts/ci/main-ci-failure-signature.test.mjs
```

再用真实超时的运行确认分类。run 41743539611 就是这个 issue 拆分来源：它的 `E2E Test (Linux) - sandbox:docker - shard 1/1` 跑满 60 分钟后于 01:14 被取消。

```
gh api "repos/QwenLM/qwen-code/check-runs/<id>/annotations" --jq '.[].message'
```

预期输出 `The job has exceeded the maximum execution time of 1h0m0s`，这正是 `cancellation_kind=timeout` 的判据。不带该 annotation 的 cancelled 运行（并发取消）会得到 `superseded=true`，不上报。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A —— CI workflow 改动，非用户可见。

### 测试环境

### 环境（可选）

N/A —— 仅单元测试，未实际执行 workflow。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：annotation 读取按被取消的 job 数量增加 API 调用，上限由该运行的 cancelled job 数决定。读不到 annotation 的 cancelled 运行会选择上报而不是丢弃——误判的并发取消只多一条评论，漏掉的超时则丢掉整个回归，这与此处既有读取的 fail-open 方向一致。超时运行的整轮重跑算作新的运行，因此重复超时会转而 filing 而不是无限重跑，这是有意为之。

- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 issue

Fixes #16272

prs.title: fix(permissions): match amend invocations instead of raw text
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The AUTO-mode amend guard now matches parsed shell invocations instead of testing the raw command text. It splits compound commands, strips heredoc bodies, unwraps shell wrappers, skips transparent execution prefixes, and only then checks for a `git commit` invocation carrying `--amend`.

The guard still recognizes absolute git paths, `.exe` paths, environment assignments, `sudo`/`env`/`timeout`-style prefixes, shell wrappers, control-flow keywords, and `eval`. Inert text inside arguments, quoted strings, grep patterns, and heredocs is no longer treated as an amend.

## Why it's needed

Issue #13570 reported that commands containing no git invocation were hard-blocked merely because their text mentioned `git commit --amend`. This affected bug reports, tests, changelog entries, commit-message arguments, grep patterns, and heredocs.

The previous substring match was also easy to defeat through indirection. Parsing actual command segments fixes the false positive while making recognition stricter about what actually executes.

This PR addresses defect 1 in #13570 only. #13636 already fixed the destructive-denial escalation path; the policy changes for the user-prompt escape hatch, `pmForcedAsk` ordering, and `skipClassifierReason` ordering are intentionally out of scope here.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

With AUTO mode active and no session commit registered, run a command that merely contains the amend phrase in data, such as `node -e 'console.log("a report about git commit --amend behaviour")'`, `echo "git commit --amend"`, `grep -n "git commit --amend" CHANGELOG.md`, or a heredoc that writes the phrase to a file. The command should reach normal permission evaluation instead of returning the destructive-command denial.

Then try actual amends through common spellings: `git commit --amend --no-edit`, `/usr/bin/git commit --amend`, `git -c core.editor=true commit --amend`, `bash -c 'git commit --amend'`, `sudo env GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=now git commit --amend`, `timeout 10 git commit --amend`, `if true; then git commit --amend; fi`, and `eval 'git commit --amend'`. These should remain blocked when HEAD was not registered as a session commit.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A. This is a permission-parser change with unit coverage, not a user-visible layout change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Local tests were intentionally not run under the current execution constraints. CI will exercise the added regression cases.

### Environment (optional)

N/A.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: The new recognizer handles the shell forms the codebase already models. Runtime string construction remains outside static recognition, as it was with the previous guard — but that parity does not hold for every indirection form: the previous substring guard still fired on some spellings this token-based recognizer cannot see, so the two are not interchangeable and this PR narrows the surface rather than matching it exactly.
- Not validated / out of scope: Verified locally — `destructive-commands.test.ts` and `shell-semantics.test.ts` (156 passing) and `prettier --check` on both changed files. Not run: the rest of `packages/core`, the build, and typecheck; those are CI's. The prompt-based escape hatch, user `ask`-rule ordering, and `skipClassifierReason` ordering from #13570 are not changed in this PR.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13570

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

AUTO 模式的 amend 防护现在匹配解析后的 shell 调用，而不是检查原始命令文本。它会拆分复合命令、移除 heredoc 正文、解开 shell wrapper、跳过透明执行前缀，然后才检查是否存在带 `--amend` 的 `git commit` 调用。

防护仍然能识别绝对 git 路径、`.exe` 路径、环境变量赋值、`sudo`/`env`/`timeout` 这类前缀、shell wrapper、控制流关键字以及 `eval`。参数、引号字符串、grep 模式和 heredoc 中仅提及 amend 的惰性文本不再被当作 amend。

## 为什么需要

Issue #13570 报告：一些根本没有执行 git 的命令，只因为文本里出现了 `git commit --amend` 就被直接拦截。受影响的有 bug 报告、测试、changelog、提交信息参数、grep 模式和 heredoc。

旧的子串匹配也很容易被间接写法绕过。解析真实命令段既修复了误报，也让识别更贴近实际执行内容。

这个 PR 只处理 #13570 的缺陷 1。#13636 已经修复了 destructive denial 的升级路径；用户 prompt 逃生口、`pmForcedAsk` 顺序和 `skipClassifierReason` 顺序属于策略变更，本 PR 有意不处理。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

在 AUTO 模式且未注册会话提交的情况下，运行只在数据中包含 amend 短语的命令，例如 `node -e 'console.log("a report about git commit --amend behaviour")'`、`echo "git commit --amend"`、`grep -n "git commit --amend" CHANGELOG.md`，或用 heredoc 把该短语写进文件。命令应进入正常权限评估，而不是返回 destructive-command 拒绝。

然后尝试实际 amend 的常见写法：`git commit --amend --no-edit`、`/usr/bin/git commit --amend`、`git -c core.editor=true commit --amend`、`bash -c 'git commit --amend'`、`sudo env GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=now git commit --amend`、`timeout 10 git commit --amend`、`if true; then git commit --amend; fi` 和 `eval 'git commit --amend'`。当 HEAD 不是本会话注册的提交时，这些命令仍应被拦截。

### 证据（Before & After）

N/A。这是权限解析变更并配有单元测试，不涉及用户可见布局变化。

prs.title: feat(mods): run the prompts a Mod submits in the OpenTUI terminal
prs.body:
## What this PR does

In the OpenTUI terminal, a Mod's `$.prompt.submit({ text, asUser? })` now starts a turn of its own once the session is idle, as it already does in headless runs and in the Ink terminal. Before this, OpenTUI did not take these prompts: `$.session.version()` did not list the method, and a call resolved to `{ drop: 'this host does not run prompts a Mod submits' }`.

- **The terminal opts in.** OpenTUI tells the Mod session at load that it runs these prompts, in the same call that already opts in to `prompt.submit` and the band above the prompt.
- **When it runs.** Once the session is idle, the shell asks the live turn to take the next queued prompt and run it as a turn of its own, sent as Ink sends it: the framed text, the Mod's text as the submitted prompt, the hooks' context, the Mod's name and its recall query. UserPromptSubmit hears it, `turn.start` and `turn.complete` fire, and the transcript records it as the Mod's. It waits for the prompts and commands the person queued, while a dialog is open, while a `!` command runs, and while a submission the person sent is still being routed through the command registry and dispatcher, since that submission may still start a turn. OpenTUI runs no Goal and no background-notification turns, so neither holds it.
- **How it shows.** The transcript shows an info line with the same text Ink shows, `Mod <name>: <text>`, with `asUser` too. It is not a user row: it is not logged as the person's input, is not a rewind target and is never handed back to the input box. It does not pass the Mods' `prompt.submit` hooks again, reads no `@` reference and runs no command, even when it is slash-form text. A dual-output sidecar receives the Mod's text and a `mod_prompt` system message, as in Ink.
- **The person stays in control.** Every submission the person sends, prompt or command, resets the Mods' 8-turn count. Esc on a turn, or declining every tool it asks to run, drops the Mods' prompts still queued and refuses new ones until the person sends something; the prompt of a stopped Mod turn is taken out of the conversation so the next prompt does not reach the model behind it. A turn a Mod ends with `$.turn.abort` keeps the queue.
- **Resume.** OpenTUI's resume used to drop `notification` history items. It now draws them as info rows, as Ink does, so a resumed session shows the Mod's line. As a side effect, a resumed session in OpenTUI now also shows the background-agent and cron notification lines that Ink already shows.

The real-terminal integration test `integration-tests/interactive/mods-prompt-submit.test.ts` is no longer Ink-only, so the OpenTUI E2E leg runs it too. Removing the `describe.skipIf` wrapper re-indents the file, which is why its diff is large; the test bodies are unchanged. The user guide and the design document (English and Chinese) describe the OpenTUI behavior.

## Why it's needed

This is step 6, the last step of the `prompt.submit` plan in #13749. After step 5, a Mod that follows up on a turn worked in headless runs and Ink, but in OpenTUI the same Mod's follow-up was dropped. With this change a Mod behaves the same in every host that runs it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Install a Mod whose `turn.complete` hook, once, logs whether `(await $.session.version()).qwen.methods` lists `prompt.submit`, then calls `await $.prompt.submit({ text: 'List the TODOs you just mentioned.' })` and logs the result. Start `qwen` with the OpenTUI renderer (`QWEN_TUI_RENDERER=opentui`, under bun) and type `Look at the TODOs`.
  - Expected: after the first answer, the line `Mod followup-mod: List the TODOs you just mentioned.` appears and a second turn runs. The second model request's last user message is the `<qwen:mod-prompt mod="followup-mod">` block with the line naming the Mod.
  - On `main`, the method is not listed, the call resolves to `{"drop":"this host does not run prompts a Mod submits"}` and no second turn runs.
- A Mod that submits at every `turn.complete` stops after 8 Mod turns with `[Mod followup-mod] $.prompt.submit refused: the Mods have started 8 turns since the last prompt from the person`. Pressing Esc during one of those turns stops the chain.
- `/resume` that session in OpenTUI: the Mod's prompt comes back as the same `Mod followup-mod: …` line.
- `npx vitest run src/ui/opentui src/services/mod-session.test.ts src/services/interactive-mod-session.test.ts src/ui/utils/resumeHistoryUtils.test.ts` in `packages/cli`; after `npm run bundle`, `QWEN_E2E_RENDERER=opentui vitest run --root ./integration-tests interactive/mods-prompt-submit.test.ts`, and the same with `QWEN_E2E_RENDERER=ink`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The built CLI in a real OpenTUI terminal (node-pty, 160×50, bun, `QWEN_TUI_RENDERER_STRICT` so it cannot fall back to Ink) against a loopback OpenAI-compatible fixture, with the Mod above installed through `qwen extensions install`. Before is `main` at `4cea3a792f`, After is this PR; both bundles were built locally from the same tree, Before with the CLI sources of `main`.

Before:

```
  > Look at the TODOs
  ◆︎ Answer 1
  ●︎ [Mod followup-mod] lists prompt.submit: false
  ●︎ [Mod followup-mod] submitted {"drop":"this host does not run prompts a Mod submits"}
```

After:

```
  > Look at the TODOs
  ◆︎ Answer 1
  ●︎ [Mod followup-mod] lists prompt.submit: true
  ●︎ Mod followup-mod: List the TODOs you just mentioned.
  ●︎ [Mod followup-mod] submitted {"text":"List the TODOs you just mentioned.","origin":{"kind":"plugin","name":"followup-mod"}}
  ◆︎ Answer 2
```

| | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Model requests | 1 | 2 |
| Second request's last user message | none | `<qwen:mod-prompt mod="followup-mod">\nList the TODOs you just mentioned.\n</qwen:mod-prompt>` and the line saying the Mod sent it and the user did not type it |
| Transcript records | `real_user` | `real_user`; `mod_prompt` with `"mod": "followup-mod"` |

Automated checks:

- `packages/cli`: all of `src/ui/opentui` plus `mod-session`, `interactive-mod-session` and `resumeHistoryUtils` pass, 103 files, 2957 tests. New tests cover the framed turn under the Mod's line with no user row and no input log, an `asUser` slash-form prompt sent bare, one turn at a time, Esc and decline-all stopping the queue (and taking the stopped prompt out of the conversation) while `$.turn.abort` keeps it, the send options and sidecar, the shell's drain (after the turn ends, after held commands, behind a command still being routed or awaiting its defer verdict), and resume.
- `integration-tests/interactive/mods-prompt-submit.test.ts` passes under both renderers: Ink 2/2 (about 19 s) and OpenTUI 2/2 (about 25 s).
- 14 targeted mutants are caught: the opt-in, the `@` skip, the Mod name, the sidecar message, the Esc stop, the decline-all stop, the orphan strip, the in-flight guard in `runModPrompt`, the `modPrompt` hand-off, the person-submission reset, the prompt subscription, the routing guard, the streaming guard and the resume projection. One guard survives on purpose: the drain also checks that the held-command queue is empty. That queue's own drain marks itself running first, so the check only matters on paths where that drain paused without a turn or a dialog. I kept it as a defensive check.
- `tsc --noEmit` for cli and integration tests, ESLint and Prettier pass on the changed files.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local bundle (`npm run bundle`); Ink under node 22, OpenTUI under bun 1.4, both through the integration harness's real terminal.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a Mod's prompt now starts turns on its own in OpenTUI too. The same bounds apply as in Ink: the 8-turn limit, the reset on the person's input, and Esc or decline-all stopping the queue. In OpenTUI the reset happens when the person sends something, including input queued during a turn, rather than when it runs; both orders lead to the same outcome, since the person's queued input runs before any Mod prompt.
- Resume side effect: OpenTUI now shows notification lines (background agents, cron, multi-agent replies) on resume, matching Ink; before, it dropped them.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS and Windows locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Sessions whose Mods never call `$.prompt.submit` behave as before.

Design document: [English](docs/design/2026-10-30-mod-prompt-submit.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-10-30-mod-prompt-submit.zh-CN.md). Both are updated together: §9 (where hosts take the prompts, the new OpenTUI terminal paragraph, the turn limit, what does not run), the decisions (the notification line in both terminals, and why OpenTUI waits for what the person sent) and the acceptance list.

## Linked Issues

Part of #13749.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在 OpenTUI 终端中，Mod 的 `$.prompt.submit({ text, asUser? })` 现在会在会话空闲后启动一个独立的回合，与它在 headless 运行和 Ink 终端中已有的行为一致。此前 OpenTUI 不接手这类提示：`$.session.version()` 不列出该方法，调用返回 `{ drop: 'this host does not run prompts a Mod submits' }`。

- **终端主动声明。** OpenTUI 在加载时告诉 Mod 会话它会运行这类提示，与它声明 `prompt.submit` 和输入框上方区域是同一次调用。
- **何时运行。** 会话空闲后，shell 让实时回合取出队列里的下一条提示，作为独立回合运行，发送方式与 Ink 相同：框文、作为提交提示的 Mod 文本、hook 附加的上下文、Mod 的名字和召回查询。UserPromptSubmit 会听到它，`turn.start` 和 `turn.complete` 都会触发，transcript 把它记为 Mod 的提示。它会等用户排队的提示和命令先运行，并在对话框打开、`!` 命令运行、以及用户发出的提交仍在经过命令注册表和分发器期间等待，因为那条提交还可能开始一个回合。OpenTUI 不运行 Goal，也没有后台通知回合，所以两者都不会拦住它。
- **如何显示。** transcript 显示一条 info 行，文字与 Ink 相同：`Mod <name>: <text>`，`asUser` 时也一样。它不是用户消息行：不作为用户输入写入日志，不是回退目标，也不会被放回输入框。它不会再经过 Mod 的 `prompt.submit` hook，不读取 `@` 引用，也不运行任何命令，即使它是斜杠形式的文本。dual output 旁路与 Ink 一样收到 Mod 的文本和一条 `mod_prompt` 系统消息。
- **用户始终掌控。** 用户发出的每条提交，无论提示还是命令，都会把 Mod 的 8 回合计数清零。在回合中按 Esc，或拒绝回合要运行的全部工具，会丢弃 Mod 仍在排队的提示，并在用户再次发出内容前拒绝新的提示；被停下的 Mod 回合的提示会从对话中移除，这样下一条提示不会排在它后面发给模型。Mod 用 `$.turn.abort` 结束的回合会保留队列。
- **恢复会话。** OpenTUI 的恢复以前会丢掉 `notification` 历史项，现在像 Ink 一样把它们画成 info 行，所以恢复的会话会显示 Mod 的那一行。副作用是 OpenTUI 恢复的会话现在也会显示 Ink 本来就显示的后台 agent 和 cron 通知行。

真实终端集成测试 `integration-tests/interactive/mods-prompt-submit.test.ts` 不再只限 Ink，OpenTUI 的 E2E 一档也会运行它。去掉 `describe.skipIf` 外层后整个文件的缩进被重排，所以 diff 较大；测试内容本身没有变化。用户指南和设计文档（英文和中文）描述了 OpenTUI 的行为。

## 为什么需要

这是 #13749 中 `prompt.submit` 计划的第 6 步，也是最后一步。第 5 步之后，跟进回合的 Mod 在 headless 和 Ink 中可用，但在 OpenTUI 中同一个 Mod 的跟进会被丢弃。这次改动后，Mod 在所有运行它的宿主中行为一致。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

- 安装一个 Mod：它的 `turn.complete` hook 只执行一次，先记录 `(await $.session.version()).qwen.methods` 是否列出 `prompt.submit`，再调用 `await $.prompt.submit({ text: 'List the TODOs you just mentioned.' })` 并记录结果。用 OpenTUI 渲染器（`QWEN_TUI_RENDERER=opentui`，在 bun 下）启动 `qwen`，输入 `Look at the TODOs`。
  - 预期：第一个回答之后出现 `Mod followup-mod: List the TODOs you just mentioned.` 这一行，并运行第二个回合。第二个模型请求的最后一条用户消息是 `<qwen:mod-prompt mod="followup-mod">` 块以及注明 Mod 的那一行说明。
  - 在 `main` 上，该方法不被列出，调用返回 `{"drop":"this host does not run prompts a Mod submits"}`，也不会运行第二个回合。
- 每次 `turn.complete` 都提交提示的 Mod 在 8 个 Mod 回合后停止，并显示 `[Mod followup-mod] $.prompt.submit refused: the Mods have started 8 turns since the last prompt from the person`。在这些回合中按 Esc 会终止这条链。
- 在 OpenTUI 中对该会话执行 `/resume`：Mod 的提示以同样的 `Mod followup-mod: …` 行恢复。
- 在 `packages/cli` 中运行 `npx vitest run src/ui/opentui src/services/mod-session.test.ts src/services/interactive-mod-session.test.ts src/ui/utils/resumeHistoryUtils.test.ts`；`npm run bundle` 之后运行 `QWEN_E2E_RENDERER=opentui vitest run --root ./integration-tests interactive/mods-prompt-submit.test.ts`，再用 `QWEN_E2E_RENDERER=ink` 运行一次。

### 证据（前后对比）

构建后的 CLI 在真实 OpenTUI 终端（node-pty，160×50，bun，开启 `QWEN_TUI_RENDERER_STRICT`，不会退回 Ink）中对接本地回环的 OpenAI 兼容 fixture，上面的 Mod 通过 `qwen extensions install` 安装。Before 是 `main` 的 `4cea3a792f`，After 是本 PR；两个包都在本地从同一棵树构建，Before 使用 `main` 的 CLI 源码。

Before：

```
  > Look at the TODOs
  ◆︎ Answer 1
  ●︎ [Mod followup-mod] lists prompt.submit: false
  ●︎ [Mod followup-mod] submitted {"drop":"this host does not run prompts a Mod submits"}
```

After：

```
  > Look at the TODOs
  ◆︎ Answer 1
  ●︎ [Mod followup-mod] lists prompt.submit: true
  ●︎ Mod followup-mod: List the TODOs you just mentioned.
  ●︎ [Mod followup-mod] submitted {"text":"List the TODOs you just mentioned.","origin":{"kind":"plugin","name":"followup-mod"}}
  ◆︎ Answer 2
```

| | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 模型请求数 | 1 | 2 |
| 第二个请求的最后一条用户消息 | 无 | `<qwen:mod-prompt mod="followup-mod">\nList the TODOs you just mentioned.\n</qwen:mod-prompt>`，以及说明这条消息由 Mod 发来、用户没有输入它的那一行 |
| transcript 记录 | `real_user` | `real_user`；带 `"mod": "followup-mod"` 的 `mod_prompt` |

自动化检查：

- `packages/cli`：`src/ui/opentui` 全部测试加上 `mod-session`、`interactive-mod-session` 和 `resumeHistoryUtils` 通过，103 个文件、2957 个测试。新增测试覆盖：带框文的回合显示在 Mod 的行下，没有用户行，不写输入日志；斜杠形式的 `asUser` 提示原样发送；一次一个回合；Esc 和拒绝全部工具停下队列（并把被停下的提示移出对话），`$.turn.abort` 保留队列；发送选项和旁路；shell 的排空（回合结束后、暂缓的命令之后、在仍在路由或仍在等待延后判定的命令之后）；恢复会话。
- `integration-tests/interactive/mods-prompt-submit.test.ts` 在两种渲染器下都通过：Ink 2/2（约 19 秒），OpenTUI 2/2（约 25 秒）。
- 14 个针对性变异被测试抓住：声明、跳过 `@`、Mod 名字、旁路消息、Esc 停止、拒绝全部工具停止、移除孤立提示、`runModPrompt` 的进行中检查、`modPrompt` 传递、用户提交清零、提示订阅、路由检查、回合进行中检查、恢复投影。有一项检查是有意保留、没有测试抓住的：排空还会检查"暂缓命令队列是否为空"。那个队列自己的排空会先把自己标记为运行中，所以这项检查只在它暂停、但既没有回合也没有对话框的路径上起作用，作为防御保留。
- cli 和集成测试的 `tsc --noEmit`、改动文件的 ESLint 和 Prettier 通过。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

本地打包（`npm run bundle`）；Ink 在 node 22 下、OpenTUI 在 bun 1.4 下，均通过集成测试框架的真实终端运行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：Mod 的提示现在在 OpenTUI 中也会自己启动回合。约束与 Ink 相同：8 回合上限、用户输入清零计数、Esc 或拒绝全部工具停下队列。OpenTUI 在用户发出内容时清零（包括回合进行中排队的输入），而不是在它运行时；两种顺序结果相同，因为用户排队的输入总是先于 Mod 的提示运行。
- 恢复会话的副作用：OpenTUI 恢复时现在会显示通知行（后台 agent、cron、多 agent 回复），与 Ink 一致；此前会丢掉它们。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：本地未在 macOS 和 Windows 上验证。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。Mod 从不调用 `$.prompt.submit` 的会话行为不变。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-10-30-mod-prompt-submit.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-10-30-mod-prompt-submit.zh-CN.md)。两者同步更新：§9（宿主从哪里接手提示、新增的 OpenTUI 终端一段、回合上限、不会运行的情况）、设计决策（两种终端都显示通知行，以及 OpenTUI 为什么等用户发出的内容先走）和验收列表。

## 关联 Issue

属于 #13749 的一部分。

prs.title: fix(sdk): resolve tool name from _meta.toolLifecycle so web-shell stops showing unknown Tool
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The daemon UI normalizer now treats `_meta.toolLifecycle.toolName` as the last source when it resolves a tool call's name. The chain stays ordered — an explicit `title`, a top-level `toolName`/`name`, and `_meta.toolName`/`_meta.name` all still win; the lifecycle name is only consulted when none of them is present.

## Why it's needed

In the web-shell session view, every tool call made by a foreground subagent is labelled "unknown Tool". The frames that carry those calls name the tool in exactly one place: `_meta.toolLifecycle.toolName` (emitted by `createTranscriptToolLifecycleUpdate` in `packages/acp-bridge/src/transcript-replay.ts`). The normalizer never read that field, so the projected block had no `toolName` and fell back to the generic `'Tool'` title, and the web-shell adapter's `resolveToolCallName(block.toolName, block.rawInput) || 'unknown'` rendered the pair as "unknown Tool". The tools themselves ran correctly — only the labels were lost.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the SDK tests for the projection path:

```
cd packages/sdk-typescript
npx vitest run test/daemon-ui-transcript.test.ts test/tool-lifecycle.test.ts \
  test/unit/daemon-transcript-projection.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false
```

The new case feeds one `tool_call_update` whose only name carrier is `_meta.toolLifecycle.toolName: 'read_file'`, projects it into the transcript, and asserts the resulting block matches `{ kind: 'tool', toolName: 'read_file', title: 'Tool' }` — the name lands on `toolName` only; the human-readable title is deliberately left untouched. Before the change that block was `{ kind: 'tool', title: 'Tool' }` with no name, i.e. exactly the input that produces "unknown Tool" downstream. A second case pins the precedence: an explicit `title` and `_meta.toolName` still beat the lifecycle name.

The existing case `tool lifecycle > does not create or overwrite Chat cards for metadata-only updates` was rewritten for this behaviour: pure `_meta.toolLifecycle` frames (no status/content/title/kind) are now forwarded as `nameOnly` events, so the reducer can name an existing block by `toolCallId` and never creates a card from them. Every tool call therefore contributes two extra events (started/ended) to the shared daemon stream, and consumers that render `tool.update` must ignore `nameOnly` events. The silent-shell heartbeat drop for `shellProgress`/`subagentProgress` frames is unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (reproduced on the base commit with the new test in place):

```
FAIL  test/daemon-ui-transcript.test.ts > tool name carried only by the lifecycle metadata > names an existing block from the producer lifecycle frame
AssertionError: expected { id: 'tool-1', kind: 'tool', …(8) } to match object { kind: 'tool', …(2) }
  {
    "kind": "tool",
-   "title": "read_file",
-   "toolName": "read_file",
+   "title": "Tool",
  }
```

After:

```
 ✓ test/daemon-ui-transcript.test.ts (38 tests) 70ms
 ✓ test/tool-lifecycle.test.ts (5 tests) 29ms
 ✓ test/unit/daemon-transcript-projection.test.ts (23 tests) 71ms
 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  66 passed (66)
```

Browser screenshot: N/A. This is a label/projection defect, and the two visual paths to it are both closed on this machine — the repo pins a Playwright browser revision that the local install cannot provision, and there is no live `qwen serve` session with a foreground subagent to attach to. The evidence above is the assertion the browser would render from: `toolName === 'read_file'` instead of `'unknown'`.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux: unit tests listed above. macOS/Windows: not run locally; this is a pure projection change with no platform-specific code, so CI covers it.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a false tool name could be picked up if some other producer stuffed an unrelated string into `_meta.toolLifecycle.toolName`. The field is only written by the replay/emitter pair that uses it as the canonical tool name, and the fallback sits last in the chain, so explicit values always win.
- Not validated / out of scope: a browser-level screenshot (see the Evidence note for why). The projection that produces the label is covered by the tests above: a frame named only by its lifecycle metadata now projects the real tool name instead of `'Tool'`.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: `@qwen-code/sdk` consumers that render `tool.update` now receive a status-less `nameOnly` variant (one extra event per lifecycle frame); ignore those events, or gate rendering on `status`. `DaemonTranscriptState` gains a `pendingToolNameByCallId` field, initialised by `createDaemonTranscriptState` — code that builds the state literal directly must add it.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16301

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

daemon UI normalizer 解析工具调用名字时，把 `_meta.toolLifecycle.toolName` 追加为最后一个来源。优先级不变：显式 `title`、顶层 `toolName`/`name`、`_meta.toolName`/`_meta.name` 仍然优先，只有它们都缺失时才读生命周期里的名字。

## 为什么需要

web-shell 会话视图里，前台 subagent 发起的每一个工具调用都显示为 "unknown Tool"。这类调用帧只在 `_meta.toolLifecycle.toolName` 带名字（由 `packages/acp-bridge/src/transcript-replay.ts` 的 `createTranscriptToolLifecycleUpdate` 产出），而 normalizer 从不读这个字段，于是投影出的 block 没有 `toolName`，title 兜底成 `'Tool'`，web-shell 适配层 `resolveToolCallName(...) || 'unknown'` 就渲染成 "unknown Tool"。工具本身执行是正常的，只是标签丢了。

## 复核方式

跑 `packages/sdk-typescript` 下三个测试文件（命令见上方）。新增用例构造一个只靠 `_meta.toolLifecycle.toolName: 'read_file'` 带名字的 `tool_call_update`，断言投影出的 block 是 `{ kind: 'tool', toolName: 'read_file', title: 'Tool' }` —— 名字只写进 `toolName`，人类可读的 title 刻意不动；修复前该 block 是 `{ kind: 'tool', title: 'Tool' }`（没有名字）。另外，纯 `_meta.toolLifecycle` 帧现在被转发成 `nameOnly` 事件，不再丢弃。第二个用例钉住优先级：显式 `title` 与 `_meta.toolName` 仍然压过生命周期名字。

原有 `tool lifecycle > does not create or overwrite Chat cards for metadata-only updates` 已按新行为改写：纯 `_meta.toolLifecycle` 帧（无 status/content/title/kind）现在被转发成 `nameOnly` 事件，不再丢弃，但仍不会创建卡片；silent-shell 心跳（`shellProgress`/`subagentProgress`）继续被丢弃，丢弃守卫没有被放宽。

## 风险

只在解析链尾部追加一个名字来源；显式值优先级不变；没有平台相关代码。UI 截图 N/A：本机 Playwright 浏览器修订被 pin 住无法安装，也没有可挂接的 `qwen serve` 前台 subagent 会话，证据以投影层红/绿断言为主。

Fixes #16301

</details>

prs.title: feat(skills): expose native archive routes and receipts (2/4)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Connects the archive installer merged in #16421 to the daemon's configuration API. Clients can install a large Skill ZIP either by sending its bytes directly or by referring to a ZIP already on the daemon host. If the connection is lost, they can query the outcome of that installation attempt without uploading the archive again.

This is layer 2/4 of #15862. #16421 has merged; this PR now targets `main`. The later SDK (#16423) and Web Shell (#16424) layers remain separate.

### Installation and result flow

1. The client chooses a UUID for the attempt before sending. For browser-style uploads it sends the ZIP as `application/octet-stream`; for an existing host file it sends an absolute daemon-host path and an optional SHA-256 in the modern JSON install request.
2. The daemon validates the selected owner, trust, name, media type and attempt ID before accepting the archive. It records the attempt, obtains a private ZIP using the merged installer, then enters the same mutation lock as existing installations.
3. Receiving, copying, waiting and extraction share one 120-second budget. Before replacement starts, cancellation stops the operation. Once replacement is admitted, commit or rollback finishes even if the client disconnects.
4. A successful response includes the attempt ID, archive digest and installation result. If the response is missing, the client reads the receipt for the same owner.

| Receipt | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `running` | The operation is still active; the receipt includes its phase. |
| `committed` | This attempt published the archive. A later runtime activation failure is reported separately as a warning. |
| `not_committed` | Publication did not happen, or restoration of the previous installation was confirmed. |
| `recovery_required` | The previous state could not be confirmed restored; retained paths identify recovery material. |
| Missing or inaccessible receipt | The result is unknown. This does not establish that retrying is safe. |

The singular configuration routes own global installation; workspace-qualified routes select that workspace and never fall back to primary. Receipt reads use the original owner's identity and current access checks, without starting a runtime.

The capability response advertises both supported inputs and their limits: 50 MiB compressed, 200 MiB retained extracted content, 4,096 ZIP records, and 32 MiB for the root Skill entry document. The two capability tags describe distinct operations; this PR does not add independent enable/disable switches for them.

## Why it's needed

A 20 MiB ZIP becomes about 26.7 MiB after base64 encoding, exceeding the existing 10 MiB JSON request limit. #16421 supplied disk-based acquisition and extraction, but clients still need an HTTP entry point that can reach it. The raw endpoint carries ZIP bytes directly; the host-file source avoids sending bytes again when another integration has already placed the archive on the daemon host.

A lost response creates a different problem: installation may already have committed. Retrying the POST can replace content again, while checking the current Skill list cannot prove what this particular attempt did. An owner-scoped receipt provides that evidence without retransmission. Duplicate IDs under the same owner return 409 and do not run the installation again.

Receipts are deliberately bounded: two operations may be active across the daemon, including waits and cleanup; terminal receipts remain for ten minutes after work settles, with a total capacity of 256. Full capacity rejects new work instead of evicting an unexpired receipt.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Install a real 20 MiB ZIP through raw upload into global scope, and through a host-file source into a secondary workspace. Verify expanded bytes and archive digest, and confirm the secondary installation does not appear in primary.
- Query a completed attempt through its original owner, then through another owner. The first should expose the result; the other must not reveal it. Reusing the same attempt ID must not install twice.
- Cancel before publication, then query the result. Cancel after publication is admitted and verify the committed outcome survives a lost response. A post-commit activation error must remain a warning on a committed installation.
- Verify media/encoding errors, wrong scope, duplicate attempts, concurrent admission, receipt capacity, runtime invalidation and trust revocation. Older base64, folder and GitHub request formats retain their limits.
- Verify the user Skill activation API merged separately in #16186 still persists its settings atomically after this branch is synchronized.

### Evidence (Before & After)

At synchronized head `876ff91b2b437adfef336afd3505b0ce2b51d8d2`, root build, bundle, typecheck, targeted lint/format checks and 1951 focused CLI tests passed. The synchronization preserved the original 16-file archive patch (+1496/-17), including each file's added/deleted lines. Three textual conflicts with #16186 were resolved by retaining both sets of routes, test fixtures and service callbacks.

Independent daemon-only acceptance passed all 19 real HTTP checks (12 archive cases and 7 user-activation cases), and the existing post-commit activation-failure route test passed independently. The test runner exited 0 and the source/head/bundle were unchanged. Daemon shutdown exited 1 with an ACP preheat `kill EPERM`; independent cleanup checks found no remaining owned processes or intake directories. This run did not exercise browser integration or live-session activation convergence.

Earlier [full-stack HTTP/browser acceptance](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16424#issuecomment-6675739412) applies to cumulative head `0da85ad2db65ea7eb7bd0241841c57b40d20fb7a`, including the later SDK/UI layers. It remains separate from the daemon-only validation above.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Build, typecheck, focused tests and real HTTP acceptance |
| 🪟 Windows | Not run locally |
| 🐧 Linux | Not run locally |

### Environment (optional)

macOS 26.6.2 arm64, Node.js 26.7.0, pnpm 11.24.0, isolated worktree. Original layer head: `69c723241d5a82a9d0c262ea89ad35ff3a7ac3b8`. Synchronized main: `17ad9cdb048c7209329f1df8ed91b819a5c5766a`, the squash merge of #16421.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: global and selected-workspace ownership must remain distinct. Host ZIPs are copied into private storage; the caller must keep the source stable during copying. Recovery-path details intentionally also reach legacy installation errors because #16421 applies backup protection to every source.
- Not validated / out of scope: local Linux/Windows execution, durable receipts, cross-process serialization, resumable uploads and automatic retries. A restart or expired receipt makes the result unknown. Historical review dispositions remain in #15862; synchronization does not implement its deferred suggestions.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: new native inputs use the modern config API. Legacy runtime routes reject the new host-file source; existing request formats and the shared 10 MiB JSON limit remain unchanged. SDK and browser integration follow in #16423 and #16424.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/17ad9cdb048c7209329f1df8ed91b819a5c5766a/docs/design/2026-10-29-skill-archive-installation.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/17ad9cdb048c7209329f1df8ed91b819a5c5766a/docs/design/2026-10-29-skill-archive-installation.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Split from #15862; follows merged #16421 and #15030. Merge sequence: #16421 → #16422 → #16423 → #16424. Each later PR must be synchronized and retargeted to main after its predecessor lands, and must run normal PR CI before merging.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

将 #16421 已合入的归档安装器接到 daemon 配置 API。客户端可以直接发送大 ZIP 的二进制内容，也可以引用已在 daemon 主机上的 ZIP；连接中断后，可以查询本次安装结果，无需重传归档。

这是 #15862 拆分后的第 2/4 层。#16421 已合入，本 PR 现在以 `main` 为目标。后续 SDK（#16423）和 Web Shell（#16424）仍分别交付。

### 安装与结果查询流程

1. 客户端在发送前生成 UUID 作为尝试 ID。上传场景直接发送 `application/octet-stream` ZIP；文件已在主机上的场景，通过现代 JSON 安装请求发送 daemon 主机绝对路径及可选的 SHA-256。
2. daemon 在接收归档前验证所选所有者、信任、名称、媒体类型和尝试 ID，登记尝试，使用已合入的安装器获取私有 ZIP，再进入原有安装操作使用的同一变更锁。
3. 接收、复制、等锁和解压共用 120 秒预算。开始替换前取消会停止操作；替换获准后，即使客户端断开，也会完成提交或回滚。
4. 成功响应包含尝试 ID、归档摘要和安装结果。响应丢失时，客户端读取同一所有者的回执。

| 回执 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `running` | 操作仍在进行，回执包含当前阶段。 |
| `committed` | 本次尝试已发布归档；后续运行时激活失败单独作为警告。 |
| `not_committed` | 未发生发布，或已确认恢复原安装。 |
| `recovery_required` | 无法确认原状态已恢复；保留路径指出恢复材料。 |
| 回执不存在或不可访问 | 结果未知，不能据此认定可以安全重试。 |

单数配置路由负责全局安装；带 workspace 的路由只选择对应工作区，不会回退到 primary。回执查询使用原所有者身份和当前访问校验，也不会启动运行时。

能力响应宣告两种输入及其限额：压缩量 50 MiB、实际保留展开内容 200 MiB、4,096 条 ZIP 记录、根 Skill 入口文档 32 MiB。两个能力标签描述不同操作；本 PR 不增加分别启停它们的策略开关。

## 为什么需要

20 MiB ZIP 经 base64 编码约为 26.7 MiB，超过现有 10 MiB JSON 请求上限。#16421 已提供磁盘获取和解压能力，客户端仍需要能够调用它的 HTTP 入口。原生端点直接传 ZIP 字节；主机文件来源则避免在其他集成已经把归档放到 daemon 主机后再次传输。

响应丢失带来另一个问题：安装可能已经提交。重发 POST 可能再次替换内容，而查询当前 Skill 列表不能证明这一次尝试做了什么。按所有者隔离的回执无需重传即可提供证据。同一所有者重复使用尝试 ID 会返回 409，不会再次安装。

回执有明确边界：每个 daemon 最多同时进行两个操作，包含等锁和清理；终态回执从操作结束后保留十分钟，总容量 256。容量满时拒绝新工作，不会提前丢弃未过期回执。

## 审查验证计划

### 如何验证

- 使用真实 20 MiB ZIP，分别通过原生上传安装到全局、通过主机文件安装到 secondary workspace，核对展开字节和归档摘要，并确认 secondary 内容没有安装到 primary。
- 从原所有者和另一所有者查询同一个已完成尝试；前者应得到结果，后者不得看到它。重复尝试 ID 不得重复安装。
- 发布前取消后查询结果；发布获准后取消时，响应丢失不应改变已提交结果。提交后的激活错误应作为已提交安装的警告。
- 验证媒体类型和编码错误、错误 scope、重复尝试、并发准入、回执容量、运行时失效及信任撤销。旧 base64、目录和 GitHub 请求格式保持原有限额。
- 验证单独由 #16186 合入的用户 Skill 启用 API 在分支同步后，仍能原子保存设置。

### 改动前后证据

同步提交 `876ff91b2b437adfef336afd3505b0ce2b51d8d2` 的根目录 build、bundle、typecheck、定向 lint/格式检查及 1951 个定向 CLI 测试通过。同步保留原归档补丁的 16 个文件（+1496/-17），每个文件的增删行都一致。与 #16186 的三处文本冲突通过保留双方路由、测试夹具和服务回调解决。

独立 daemon 单层验收的 19 个真实 HTTP 检查全部通过（归档 12 个、用户启用 7 个），并独立通过既有的提交后激活失败路由测试。测试 runner exit 0，源码、HEAD 和 bundle 保持不变。daemon 退出时因 ACP 预热出现 `kill EPERM` 而 exit 1；独立清理检查确认没有遗留测试进程或接收目录。本轮未验证浏览器接入或活跃会话的激活收敛。

此前[整组 HTTP/浏览器验收](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16424#issuecomment-6675739412) 对应累计提交 `0da85ad2db65ea7eb7bd0241841c57b40d20fb7a`，包含后续 SDK/UI 层，与上述 daemon 单层验证分别记录。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 构建、类型检查、定向测试及真实 HTTP 验收 |
| 🪟 Windows | 未在本地执行 |
| 🐧 Linux | 未在本地执行 |

### 环境

macOS 26.6.2 arm64、Node.js 26.7.0、pnpm 11.24.0，独立 worktree。原分层提交为 `69c723241d5a82a9d0c262ea89ad35ff3a7ac3b8`；同步的 main 为 #16421 的 squash merge `17ad9cdb048c7209329f1df8ed91b819a5c5766a`。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：必须区分全局与所选工作区所有权。主机 ZIP 会复制到私有存储，复制期间调用方须保持来源稳定。恢复路径信息有意同时返回到旧来源安装错误，因为 #16421 对所有来源都提供备份保护。
- 未验证或不在范围内：本地 Linux/Windows 执行、持久化回执、跨进程串行、断点续传和自动重试。重启或回执过期会让结果变成未知。历史审查处置保留在 #15862，同步不会实现此前延后的建议。
- 兼容与迁移：新原生来源使用现代 config API。旧 runtime 路由拒绝新的主机文件来源；现有请求格式及共享 10 MiB JSON 上限不变。SDK 和浏览器集成由 #16423、#16424 后续交付。

设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/17ad9cdb048c7209329f1df8ed91b819a5c5766a/docs/design/2026-10-29-skill-archive-installation.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/17ad9cdb048c7209329f1df8ed91b819a5c5766a/docs/design/2026-10-29-skill-archive-installation.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联

从 #15862 拆分，基于已合入的 #16421 和 #15030。合并顺序为 #16421 → #16422 → #16423 → #16424。后续每个 PR 都须在前一层合入后同步并改为 main，再完成常规 PR CI 后合入。

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): honor configured loading phrases
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Applies configured custom loading phrases in the Web Shell while preserving an embedding host's explicit phrase customization and the built-in fallback. The custom phrase list is available to the browser from workspace settings, but its unsupported array editor stays hidden.

The latest main already honors loading-phrase visibility through #15337. This PR keeps that behavior and its browser-side live-update handling. It also preserves the shared terminal schema's restart requirement and adds a regression using the real schema and restart-selection helpers.

## Why it's needed

#14324 reports both visibility and customization being ignored in the browser. Main now covers visibility; configured custom phrases remain the part addressed here. During maintenance, the branch's shared restart flag was also found to disagree with terminal behavior: the terminal reads an accessibility snapshot taken at startup, so removing the restart requirement silently loses its restart prompt. The flag is restored while keeping the browser's existing live-update exception.

## Reviewer Test Plan

Confirm that configured non-empty phrase strings reach the browser status indicator, invalid entries fall back to built-ins, equal settings reloads keep the customization context stable, and an explicit embedding host callback takes precedence. Confirm that disabling visibility still suppresses phrases. For the restart contract, terminal settings must classify this key as requiring restart, while the Web Shell must avoid a redundant restart banner for the same live setting.

### How to verify

Use the focused CLI schema/helper and workspace-settings suites, the Web Shell settings/status/panel suites, and the loading-phrase App cases. Inspect actual passed/skipped counts. The real-source restart probe must return `true` and include `ui.accessibility.enableLoadingPhrases` in the restart-required list. Inspect the merged App tree to confirm it retains both the effective customization provider and main's MCP App visibility provider.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before maintenance, at PR head `9f42a6c1`, the real source returned `schemaFlag=false`, `requiresRestart=false`, and an empty restart-required list. Existing schema/helper tests still passed because they did not pin this real key's restart contract.
- The added regression failed with `expected false to be true` before the flag repair and passed after it. The new test imports the actual schema and helpers rather than mocking them.
- 2026-10-30 verification: 309 passed. The App selection executed 9 cases; 1,357 App cases were excluded by selection (reported as skipped). The CLI suites passed 198 cases and the Web Shell selection passed 102, including the additional matched voice-settings suite. No full App suite is claimed. The same six phrase cases against current-main App source had 1 failure and 5 passes: configured phrases were undefined rather than the expected list. After restoring the patch, all six plus three host-visibility controls passed. Full workspace build, full workspace/integration typecheck, targeted ESLint and Prettier all passed.
- Prior browser A/B evidence is available in [the existing round-2 verification](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14353#issuecomment-6214730656). That evidence belongs to the earlier head and its author; this maintenance did not rerun that browser session or capture fresh screenshots.

### Maintenance validation (2026-11-02)

Merged main at 8aea64d5 to incorporate the current lint/CI gate without changing this PR's focused 10-file diff. The full workspace build, targeted ESLint/Prettier, and the nine lint-freshness helper tests passed on Windows. The focused suites passed 309 tests: CLI 198, Web Shell 102, and App 9; 1,381 App cases were excluded by selection. The real-source restart probe again returned true and selected this key. The red/green experiments and full workspace/integration typecheck described in the dated October 30 evidence were not repeated today. No new browser A/B, interactive TUI, live model, or Java fast-tier validation is claimed. The previous Java CI run contains heap exhaustion and test errors; the new remote CI result remains pending publication and execution.
### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| macOS | Not tested in this maintenance |
| Windows | 309 focused tests passed; 1,381 App cases excluded by selection; source probe and red/green regression passed |
| Linux | Not tested in this maintenance |

### Environment (optional)

Windows, Node 24.20.0, repository-pinned pnpm 11.24.0. Local source/contract and component verification; no live model call or new browser/TUI session is claimed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: custom phrases are configured through the existing configuration keys; the settings panel does not gain an unsupported array editor.
- Not validated / out of scope: fresh real-browser A/B and Linux/macOS interactive sessions. Suggestion-level documentation and descriptor-coverage follow-ups from earlier rounds remain deferred under the repository's convergence policy.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The shared terminal restart contract is preserved; browser live settings continue using their existing exception.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14324. Visibility is already present in main through #15337; this PR completes the configured-phrase path.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

让 Web Shell 使用配置中的自定义加载短语，同时保留嵌入宿主显式定制的优先级和内置短语兜底。浏览器可从工作区设置读取自定义列表，但设置面板继续隐藏不支持保存的数组编辑行。

最新主干已通过 #15337 支持短语可见性。本 PR 保留这一路径及浏览器实时设置处理，并保持终端共享 schema 的重启要求，新增调用真实 schema 和重启筛选 helper 的回归测试。

## Why it's needed

#14324 同时报告浏览器忽略可见性和自定义配置。主干现已处理可见性，本 PR 继续解决自定义短语。维护时还发现分支上的共享重启标记与终端实际行为不符：终端读取启动时的无障碍配置快照，删除重启要求会使重启提示悄悄消失。因此恢复该标记，同时保留浏览器已有的实时生效例外。

## Reviewer Test Plan

确认有效的自定义字符串进入浏览器状态指示器，无效项回退内置短语；相同设置重新加载时上下文引用保持稳定；嵌入宿主显式传入的回调优先。确认关闭可见性仍隐藏短语。终端必须把该设置列为需重启，Web Shell 则不应为同一实时设置显示多余的重启横幅。

### How to verify

运行 CLI 的 schema/helper 和工作区设置相关套件、Web Shell 设置/状态/面板套件及 App 加载短语用例，核对实际通过与跳过数量。真实源码探针必须返回 `true`，并在需重启列表中包含 `ui.accessibility.enableLoadingPhrases`。检查合并后的 App 树同时保留有效自定义上下文和主干 MCP App 可见性 Provider。

### Evidence (Before & After)

- 维护前 PR 提交 `9f42a6c1` 的真实源码返回 `schemaFlag=false`、`requiresRestart=false`、需重启列表为空。已有 schema/helper 测试仍通过，因为未钉住这个真实键的重启契约。
- 新回归在恢复标记前以 `expected false to be true` 失败，修复后通过。测试直接使用真实 schema 和 helpers，未模拟它们。
- 2026-10-30 验证 309 项通过。App 实际执行 9 项，1357 项因筛选未执行（报告为 skipped），不声称跑过完整 App 套件。CLI 三套件 198 项通过，Web 选择范围 102 项通过（包含额外匹配的 voice-settings 套件）。将同六项短语测试用于当前主干 App 源码时为 1 项失败、5 项通过：自定义列表实际为 undefined。恢复补丁后六项和三个宿主可见性控制用例均通过。全仓构建、全仓及集成类型检查、定向 ESLint、Prettier 均通过。
- [已有第二轮浏览器 A/B 验证](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14353#issuecomment-6214730656)属于较早提交及其验证作者；本轮未重跑该浏览器会话或采集新截图。

### 维护验证（2026-11-02）

合入 main 8aea64d5 以同步最新 lint/CI 门禁，最终仍是本 PR 原有十文件差异。Windows 全仓构建、定向 ESLint/Prettier、九项门禁检查器单测通过；定向套件实际 309 项通过（CLI 198、Web Shell 102、App 9），1381 项 App 用例因筛选未执行。真实源码重启探针再次返回 true 并选出该键。10 月 30 日证据中的红绿实验及全仓/集成类型检查未在今日重跑。不声称新增浏览器 A/B、交互 TUI、真实模型或 Java fast-tier 验证；旧 Java CI 日志包含堆内存耗尽与测试错误，新远端 CI 需发布后实际执行。
### Tested on

| macOS | 本轮未测 |
| Windows | 309 项定向测试通过，1381 项 App 用例因筛选未执行；真实源码探针及回归红绿验证通过 |

Windows、Node 24.20.0、仓库指定 pnpm 11.24.0。本地源码/契约及组件验证，不声称执行真实模型调用或新的浏览器/TUI 会话。

- 风险或取舍：自定义短语通过已有配置键提供；设置面板不增加无法保存的数组编辑器。

prs.title: fix(core): keep the user's instruction last in the model request
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Keeps the user's own instruction as the last content the model reads on a fresh turn. Injected context that currently trails the prompt — hook and Mod context, plus the memory catalog snapshot — is moved ahead of it in the outgoing request, at the single point where every main-turn request is assembled. Stored history is left exactly as it is; only the request copy is reordered.

Leading tool results keep their position, an entry whose tool result is not in the leading run is left untouched, and the volatile reattach tail stays last so the provider cache breakpoint keeps its anchor. A reminder the caller placed between two of its own parts bounds the movable run and stays where the caller put it.

## Why it's needed

A user submitted one complete 2461-character task with seven numbered steps. The model replied "I have not received a specific task yet", and its reasoning read "The user only provided a system reminder about available skills ... no specific task."

The instruction reached the provider intact — its position did not survive assembly. A fresh turn's user entry is built from four independent sources: per-turn reminders prepended ahead of the prompt, the user's own parts, the hook/Mod context block appended behind them, and the memory catalog appended after that. The real task therefore sits mid-entry with injected context on both sides. Three independent caps (8000 characters for the skills listing, 25000 per memory index with two indexes injected, and unbounded hook context) let those surrounding blocks reach tens of kilobytes, at which point a flash-class model reads the envelopes and misses the task.

Moving the instruction to the tail addresses the reported symptom without touching any budget.

The reordering is deliberately request-only. The trailing position of the hook block is load-bearing for stored history: the transcript display projection treats a complete final tagged part as pairing evidence for the display text, and resume re-stamps its delivery receipt only on the final part. Reordering the stored entry would break the display projection and re-deliver already-delivered hook context on every turn.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Start a session with auto-memory enabled and a `UserPromptSubmit` hook that returns `additionalContext`, then submit a long multi-part instruction (several separate text blocks, as an ACP client sends them). Inspect the outgoing request in the debug API log: the reminders, hook block and catalog should precede the instruction, and the instruction's own blocks should close the user entry in their original order. Inspect the session transcript afterwards: the stored entry must still end with the hook block, and a resumed session must not re-deliver that hook context.

Also worth confirming on a tool-result turn: the tool result stays first, and a session that reattaches earlier images keeps its reattach region (marker, label, image) contiguous and last, so prompt caching still hits.

Targeted unit run: `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/llm-chat.test.ts` — 716 passed. Two assertions that pinned the old order were updated: the pending-turn check now asserts the catalog is present and the user text is last, and the durable-recovery check now asserts the request holds the same entries and parts as history with the catalog moved ahead of the recovery prompt. Four regression cases were added for the placement itself, the tool-result and volatile-tail ordering, an untouched prompt, and a caller-interleaved reminder.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — request-shape change, covered by the unit assertions above. No TUI surface changes.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Package-local unit tests only (`packages/core`, vitest). No real-model or daemon run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the model now sees injected context ahead of the instruction rather than split around it. Providers that cache on a stable prefix are unaffected because stored history and the volatile tail keep their order, but a provider sensitive to intra-message ordering would see a different block sequence than before.
- Not validated / out of scope: no real-model reproduction of the original session, and no Windows or Linux run. The aggregate budget across per-turn injected blocks, moving the catalog off the user entry entirely, and the CJK token undercount in the always-on-context warning are separate work (#16184, #14976) and are not addressed here.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No setting, protocol field, or storage format changes; existing transcripts replay unchanged.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-11-04-prompt-context-placement.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-04-prompt-context-placement.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Refs #16259

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

让用户自己的指令成为新轮次中模型最后读到的内容。目前尾随在正文之后的注入上下文——hook 与 Mod 上下文，加上记忆目录快照——会在外发请求中被移到正文之前，改动落在每轮主请求组装的唯一位置。已存历史完全不动，只重排请求副本。

前导工具结果保持原位；工具结果不在前导区段的条目原样返回；易变的 reattach 尾部仍在最后，让服务商缓存断点保有其锚点。调用方放在自己两个分片之间的提醒会成为可移动区段的边界，保持原位。

## 为什么需要

用户提交了一条完整的 2461 字符任务，含 7 个编号步骤。模型回复"目前还没有收到具体任务"，其 thinking 原文是"The user only provided a system reminder about available skills ... no specific task."

指令完整送达了服务商，但它的位置在组装过程中没有保住。一次新轮次的 user 条目由四个独立来源拼成：前置在正文之前的每轮提醒、用户自己的分片、追加在其后的 hook/Mod 上下文块，以及再追加在后的记忆目录。真实任务因此落在条目中段，两侧都是注入上下文。三个各自独立的上限（skills 列表 8000 字符、每个记忆索引 25000 且会注入两个索引、无上限的 hook 上下文）让包围它的块可达几十 KB，此时 flash 级别的模型只读到这些信封，漏掉了任务。

把指令移到尾部即可消除本次报告的现象，且无需改动任何预算。

重排刻意只作用于请求。hook 块位于尾部这一点对已存历史是有承载作用的：transcript 展示投影把完整的末尾 tagged 分片当作展示文本的配对证据，resume 也只对最后一个分片重新盖上投递回执。重排已存条目会破坏展示投影，并让已投递的 hook 上下文每轮重复投递。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

开启 auto-memory，并配置一个返回 `additionalContext` 的 `UserPromptSubmit` hook，然后提交一条长的多分片指令（多个独立文本块，如 ACP 客户端的发送方式）。在 debug API 日志中检查外发请求：提醒、hook 块和目录应排在指令之前，指令自己的分片应按原顺序收尾该 user 条目。随后检查会话 transcript：已存条目必须仍以 hook 块结尾，且 resume 后的会话不应重复投递该 hook 上下文。

工具结果轮次也值得确认：工具结果仍在最前；回放了早前图片的会话，其 reattach 区域（标记、标签、图片）保持连续且位于最后，从而 prompt 缓存仍能命中。

定向单测：`cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/llm-chat.test.ts` —— 716 项通过。两处固定旧顺序的断言已更新：待发送轮次的检查改为断言目录存在且用户正文在最后；持久化恢复的检查改为断言请求与历史持有相同的条目和分片，只是目录被移到了恢复提示词之前。新增 4 个回归用例，覆盖位置本身、工具结果与易变尾部的顺序、未被改动的提示词，以及调用方自行交错的提醒。

### 证据（Before & After）

N/A —— 请求形状变更，由上述单测断言覆盖，TUI 界面无变化。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

仅包内单测（`packages/core`，vitest）。未做真实模型或 daemon 运行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：模型现在看到注入上下文排在指令之前，而不是分布在其两侧。基于稳定前缀做缓存的服务商不受影响，因为已存历史和易变尾部都保持原顺序；但对消息内部块顺序敏感的服务商会看到与之前不同的块序列。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：没有对原始会话做真实模型复现，也没有 Windows 与 Linux 运行。跨每轮注入块的总量预算、把目录彻底移出 user 条目，以及 always-on-context 告警对中文 token 的低估，都是独立工作（#16184、#14976），本 PR 不处理。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。没有设置、协议字段或存储格式变更；既有 transcript 回放不变。

prs.title: feat(cli): report interactive program status with OSC 7501
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The interactive CLI now reports its state to the terminal with OSC 7501 (the program status protocol). It keeps one root record and always tags it `app=qwen-code`. The state is `working` while a turn runs and `blocked` while the agent waits on the user: `kind=permission` for tool, shell, startup and subagent approvals, `kind=question` for `ask_user_question` and the loop-detection prompt, and `kind=auth` for authentication. When a turn ends, the record latches `done` or `error` until the next turn starts. The outcome is decided once at the end of the turn, so errors shown while idle (a failed slash command) and history compaction don't change it. A blocked prompt and a stop-hook loop count as `error`. A cancelled turn goes back to `idle`, and `/clear` resets the record to `idle`.

On exit, `done` and `error` are left in place so the user can still see how the last turn ended, as the spec intends. `idle`, `working` and `blocked` are cleared. The record is also cleared while an external editor owns the terminal and written again when the editor returns or the process resumes after `fg`. The message names the tool at most ("Permission needed: Shell"). Tool arguments, prompts and model output never reach the terminal.

Reports are written only when stdout is a TTY and only when the record changes. A failed write is retried on the next report. Reports are never wrapped for tmux passthrough, because the outer terminal can't tell which pane they came from. `-p`, JSON, stream-JSON and ACP never mount the interactive UI, so they never emit anything. There's no new setting and no new dependency.

## Why it's needed

Terminals and agent inboxes (iTerm2, Rex, cmux, Orca, Prowl, herdr) show per-tab agent status. Without a protocol they guess it from window titles and screen text, and the guess breaks whenever the UI changes. Claude Code, Codex, opencode and pi already emit OSC 7501. This follows the scope the maintainer set in #13870: hook-based, TTY-gated, no new setting, and `done` latched until the next prompt with no focus-based reset.

#13994 targets the same issue. It is currently conflicting, has changes requested, and changes about 2.2k lines, including reworking `use-llm-stream` and the editor-ownership code. This PR is a smaller alternative of about 400 production lines. The turn outcome is read from state that already exists (history errors, the pending retry error, and the existing cancel flag), and the editor handoff is a release/restore pair around the two spawn sites.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start `qwen` in a terminal that supports OSC 7501, or wrap the CLI in something that logs PTY bytes.
2. Submit a prompt and watch the record go idle → working → done.
3. Have the model call a shell command that needs approval. Expect `blocked kind=permission` with the message "Permission needed: Shell", then working → done after approving.
4. Trigger `ask_user_question` and expect `blocked kind=question`.
5. Make a request fail (for example an API 400) and expect `error`. The next successful turn should report `done`.
6. Press Esc during a turn and expect `idle`.
7. `/quit` after `done` should leave `done` in place. `/quit` while idle should send `state=clear`.
8. `qwen -p "..."` in any output format should write no OSC 7501 bytes.

Unit tests: `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/utils/osc.test.ts src/utils/program-status.test.ts src/ui/hooks/use-program-status.test.ts src/ui/hooks/useLaunchEditor.test.ts src/ui/components/shared/text-buffer-external-editor.test.ts`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: there is no OSC 7501 output anywhere in the CLI.

After: the built CLI ran inside a PTY (`@lydell/node-pty`) against a local mock OpenAI-compatible server. That server streams SSE, returns tool calls, returns an HTTP 400 for one prompt, and delays one response by 8 seconds. Every OSC 7501 sequence was captured from the PTY byte stream, and the checks were computed from those bytes. All 15 passed:

![OSC 7501 end-to-end evidence](https://pic.sorrycc.com/1793896371758-463095742.png)

Captured sequence (session A, decoded `msg` shown in quotes):

```text
idle
working → done                                   (plain prompt)
working → blocked kind=permission "Permission needed: Shell"
working → done                                   (approved)
working → blocked kind=question "Waiting for your answer"
working → done                                   (answered)
working → error "Request failed"                 (HTTP 400)
working → done                                   (next turn after the failure)
working → idle                                   (Esc cancel)
working → done → /quit: no clear, done kept
session B: idle → /quit: state=clear
-p text / json / stream-json / -p with a PTY stdout: exit 0, no OSC 7501 bytes
```

Manual check: also checked by hand in a terminal that displays OSC 7501 records.

After the review fixes, the five program-status suites above plus `AppContainer` pass (360 tests). Reverting the latch fix makes four of the new `useTurnOutcome` cases fail (error while idle, compaction after the turn, compaction during the turn, blocked prompt or stop-hook loop).

Targeted suites on the first commit: 1249 passed, 1 skipped (existing). Covered files: `osc`, `program-status`, `use-program-status`, `AppContainer`, `use-llm-stream`, `text-buffer`, `text-buffer-external-editor`, `nonInteractiveCli`. `tsc --noEmit` for `packages/cli`, ESLint and Prettier on the changed files are clean.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS 26.3.2 (arm64), Node v26.5.0, built CLI (`packages/cli/dist`) in a PTY, mock OpenAI-compatible server on 127.0.0.1, isolated `HOME`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the turn outcome is inferred from existing UI state. If something unrelated to the turn (for example a concurrent `/btw`) shows an error during the turn, the turn is marked `error`.
- Not validated / out of scope:
  - The two external-editor call sites and the `kind=auth` / loop-detection / startup-approval paths are covered by unit tests, not end to end.
  - `/resume` and `/branch` don't reset a latched `done` or `error`; only `/clear` does.
  - A slash-command `confirm_action` prompt and approvals parked by background agents don't report `blocked` yet (review R1-3, left for a follow-up).
  - Child records, `progress`, feature probing, focus-based reset and tmux passthrough are deliberately left out.
  - Windows and Linux are not tested.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. There is no new setting or dependency, and `useLlmStream` only gains a read-only `turnCancelledRef` in its return value.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/osc-7501-program-status/docs/design/2026-11-06-osc-7501-program-status.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/osc-7501-program-status/docs/design/2026-11-06-osc-7501-program-status.zh-CN.md). Both cover the same mapping, outcome rules, message policy, lifecycle, tmux decision, risks, validation and follow-ups.

## Linked Issues

Closes #13870. Related: #13994 (earlier, larger attempt at the same issue).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

交互式 CLI 现在用 OSC 7501（程序状态协议）向终端上报自身状态。它只维护一条 root record，并始终带上 `app=qwen-code`。一轮进行中为 `working`；agent 等待用户时为 `blocked`：工具、shell、启动阶段和子 agent 的审批为 `kind=permission`，`ask_user_question` 和循环检测提示为 `kind=question`，认证为 `kind=auth`。一轮结束后，record 锁存为 `done` 或 `error`，直到下一轮开始。结果只在一轮结束时确定一次，因此空闲时显示的错误（例如失败的斜杠命令）和 history 压缩都不会改动它。被 hook 拦下的提示词和 stop hook 循环都算作 `error`。被取消的一轮回到 `idle`，`/clear` 也会把 record 重置为 `idle`。

退出时保留 `done` 和 `error`，这样用户之后仍能看到上一轮是怎么结束的，这也是规范的本意。`idle`、`working`、`blocked` 会被清除。外部编辑器占用终端期间 record 也会被清除，编辑器返回或进程在 `fg` 后恢复时重新写入。消息最多写出工具名（"Permission needed: Shell"），工具参数、提示词和模型输出不会传到终端。

只有 stdout 是 TTY 且 record 发生变化时才写入，写入失败会在下一次上报时重试。上报从不做 tmux passthrough 包装，因为外层终端分辨不出它来自哪个 pane。`-p`、JSON、stream-JSON 和 ACP 都不会挂载交互式 UI，因此不会发送任何内容。不新增设置项，也不引入新依赖。

## 为什么需要

终端和 agent inbox（iTerm2、Rex、cmux、Orca、Prowl、herdr）会显示每个标签页的 agent 状态。没有协议时，它们只能从窗口标题和屏幕文字去猜，UI 一变就猜错。Claude Code、Codex、opencode 和 pi 已经支持 OSC 7501。本 PR 遵循维护者在 #13870 中划定的范围：基于 hook、TTY 门控、不新增设置，`done` 锁存到下一次提交，不做基于焦点的重置。

#13994 针对的是同一个 issue。它目前有冲突、被要求修改，并改动了约 2.2k 行，包括重写 `use-llm-stream` 和编辑器所有权相关代码。本 PR 是一个更小的替代方案，生产代码约 400 行。轮次结果从已有状态读取（history 中的错误、待重试的错误、现有的取消标志），编辑器交接只是在两个启动位置前后成对地 release/restore。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在支持 OSC 7501 的终端里启动 `qwen`，或者用能记录 PTY 字节的工具包住 CLI。
2. 提交一条提示词，观察 record 依次变为 idle → working → done。
3. 让模型调用需要审批的 shell 命令。预期为 `blocked kind=permission`，消息为 "Permission needed: Shell"；批准后依次为 working → done。
4. 触发 `ask_user_question`，预期为 `blocked kind=question`。
5. 让一次请求失败（例如 API 400），预期为 `error`。之后成功的一轮应上报 `done`。
6. 在一轮进行中按 Esc，预期为 `idle`。
7. `done` 之后 `/quit` 应保留 `done`；空闲时 `/quit` 应发送 `state=clear`。
8. 任何输出格式下的 `qwen -p "..."` 都不应写出 OSC 7501 字节。

单元测试：`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/utils/osc.test.ts src/utils/program-status.test.ts src/ui/hooks/use-program-status.test.ts src/ui/hooks/useLaunchEditor.test.ts src/ui/components/shared/text-buffer-external-editor.test.ts`。

### 证据（前后对比）

之前：CLI 中任何地方都没有 OSC 7501 输出。

之后：构建好的 CLI 在 PTY（`@lydell/node-pty`）中运行，对接一个本地模拟的 OpenAI 兼容服务。该服务以 SSE 流式返回，会返回工具调用，对一条提示词返回 HTTP 400，并把一次响应延迟 8 秒。所有 OSC 7501 序列都从 PTY 字节流中捕获，检查项由这些字节计算得出，15 项全部通过（截图见上方英文部分）。

捕获到的序列（会话 A，引号内为解码后的 `msg`）：

```text
idle
working → done                                   （普通提示词）
working → blocked kind=permission "Permission needed: Shell"
working → done                                   （已批准）
working → blocked kind=question "Waiting for your answer"
working → done                                   （已回答）
working → error "Request failed"                 （HTTP 400）
working → done                                   （失败之后的下一轮）
working → idle                                   （Esc 取消）
working → done → /quit：不发送 clear，保留 done
会话 B：idle → /quit：state=clear
-p 文本 / json / stream-json / stdout 为 PTY 的 -p：退出码 0，不含 OSC 7501 字节
```

手动检查：也已在能显示 OSC 7501 record 的终端里手动验证过。

按审查意见修复后，上面五个 program-status 相关测试文件加上 `AppContainer` 全部通过（360 项）。撤回锁存修复后，新增的 `useTurnOutcome` 用例中有四个会失败（空闲时的错误、轮次结束后的压缩、轮次进行中的压缩、被拦下的提示词或 stop hook 循环）。

第一个提交的定向测试套件：1249 项通过，1 项跳过（原本就跳过）。覆盖的文件：`osc`、`program-status`、`use-program-status`、`AppContainer`、`use-llm-stream`、`text-buffer`、`text-buffer-external-editor`、`nonInteractiveCli`。`packages/cli` 的 `tsc --noEmit`，以及改动文件的 ESLint 和 Prettier 检查均通过。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

macOS 26.3.2（arm64）、Node v26.5.0，构建好的 CLI（`packages/cli/dist`）运行在 PTY 中，模拟的 OpenAI 兼容服务监听 127.0.0.1，`HOME` 为隔离目录。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：轮次结果是从已有 UI 状态推断的。如果一轮进行期间有与它无关的错误显示出来（例如并发的 `/btw`），这一轮会被标为 `error`。
- 未验证或范围之外：
  - 两个外部编辑器调用点，以及 `kind=auth`、循环检测、启动审批这几条路径，只有单元测试覆盖，没有端到端验证。
  - `/resume` 和 `/branch` 不会重置已锁存的 `done` 或 `error`，只有 `/clear` 会。
  - 斜杠命令的 `confirm_action` 确认提示，以及后台 agent 挂起的审批，目前还不会上报 `blocked`（审查意见 R1-3，留作后续）。
  - 子 record、`progress`、特性探测、基于焦点的重置和 tmux passthrough 都有意不做。
  - Windows 和 Linux 未测试。
- 破坏性改动或迁移：无。不新增设置项或依赖，`useLlmStream` 只是在返回值中多了一个只读的 `turnCancelledRef`。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/osc-7501-program-status/docs/design/2026-11-06-osc-7501-program-status.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/osc-7501-program-status/docs/design/2026-11-06-osc-7501-program-status.zh-CN.md)。两个版本覆盖相同的映射、结果规则、消息策略、生命周期、tmux 决策、风险、验证与后续工作。

## 关联 Issue

Closes #13870。相关：#13994（针对同一 issue 的更早、更大的尝试）。

</details>
