prs.title: feat(cli): have an Ink TUI turn send the round its tool batch continues with
prs.body:
## What this PR does

With `experimental.unifiedAgentLoop` on, an Ink TUI turn now sends the round its shared tool batch continues with, and the Ink parity suite covers a retry and input queued while a tool runs. This is PR 3c-1 of #15327, after #16385.

Until now the batch's completion step sent the next round itself, from inside the batch the turn awaits. The step still repairs history, splits the results by interaction owner, starts the tool-use summary and checks the stops. It now hands the next round to the turn, which takes the input queued for the tool boundary and sends the round, as the loop's `nextRound` builds a round after its batch:

| The TUI today | With the setting on |
| --- | --- |
| the completion step takes the input queued for the tool boundary, mid-turn messages and then teammate messages, and sends the next round | the turn takes that input after the batch and sends the round |

Nothing the model receives or the session records changes; the parity suite compares both. Until the turn sends the round, the batch keeps the scheduler and keeps the TUI off Idle, so a queued batch or idle work does not start in between. A turn that does not wait for its batch, because another stream is active, leaves the round to the batch, which sends it itself. Batches that wait for the streams still go out in one continuation, which the turn whose stream ends last sends.

A retry with Ctrl+Y already runs on the shared round and, from #16385, awaits its batch. The parity suite now runs a retry after a model error, a retry that fails again, a retried tool-result round whose response calls a tool, and input submitted while a tool runs, which goes out with the tool's result. They pass unchanged, so this PR changes no retry code.

The pieces, in `use-llm-stream.ts`:

- The completion step's tail, from taking the boundary input to the send, is now `sendToolResultRound`. `handleCompletedTools` calls it for the scheduler's own batches, as before, and returns it for a shared batch.
- `runSharedToolBatch` keeps the scheduler hold and its activity while a next round is pending, and resolves with that round. The stream processor hands the turn a handle: the turn awaits `done` and sends the round, or calls `leave()` when another stream is active, and the batch then sends it.

It also takes up #16385's review suggestions: the scheduler hold's comment says how its window differs from the current path's, the replay fixture is one helper, and the await test uses `holdBatches`. The parity suite ignores a shell command's process group and pid, which differ per run.

No shared code in core changes, and with the setting off the TUI is unchanged.

The design doc describes 3c-1 and the new scenarios.

## Why it's needed

In #15327 the Ink TUI moves onto the shared loop in steps. With the turn sending each round after its batch, the TUI's turn has the shape of the loop's, which 3c-2 extends to cron, background-notification, teammate and Goal turns, and 3d makes the default.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Unit tests, `packages/cli` `use-llm-stream.test.tsx`, "shared agent loop round":
  - the input queued for the tool boundary goes after the results in the next round;
  - while the turn takes that input (a Goal command queued mid-turn is still running), the TUI stays responding and the scheduler's callback has not returned;
  - a batch whose turn did not wait sends its next round itself.
- Run `npm run bundle`, then `cd integration-tests && QWEN_E2E_RENDERER=ink npx vitest run interactive/ink-agent-loop-parity.test.ts`. All scenarios must pass, the four new ones included.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A: the change is behind an off-by-default setting.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local results on Linux:

- the Ink parity suite: 18/18, from a fresh `npm run bundle`;
- `use-llm-stream.test.tsx`, `ink-tool-executor.test.ts` and `useToolScheduler.test.ts`: 475 passed;
- root `npm run typecheck` passes; eslint and prettier are clean on the changed files.

Mutation checks:

- When the turn does not send the round it got, the tests for the next round fail, the boundary-input ones included.
- When the batch releases the scheduler, or its activity, before the round is sent, the test that holds both while the input is taken fails.
- When the batch keeps the round for a turn that left, the test for a batch whose turn did not wait times out.
- When the completion step sends the round itself, as before, the tests still pass: the change is to who sends, not to what is sent.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the next round now goes out a few microtasks after the completion step, from the turn. The batch holds the scheduler and the TUI's activity across that gap, which the test above pins.
- Not validated / out of scope: cron, background-notification, teammate and Goal turns (3c-2); removing the queue that merges batches that wait for the streams.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design: [docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.md](docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.md) and [docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.zh-CN.md](docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Part of #15327.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

开启 `experimental.unifiedAgentLoop` 后，Ink TUI 的轮次自己发出共享工具批接着发出的那一轮；Ink 对拍套件也覆盖了重试，以及工具运行期间排队的输入。这是 #15327 的 PR 3c-1，接在 #16385 之后。

此前由工具批的完成步骤自己发出下一轮，而且是在轮次等待的工具批内部发出。完成步骤仍然修复历史、按交互 owner 拆分结果、启动工具使用摘要并检查各项停止条件；现在它把下一轮交给轮次，由轮次取走排队到工具边界的输入并发出这一轮，就像 loop 的 `nextRound` 在工具批之后构建一轮那样：

| TUI 现在 | 开启设置后 |
| --- | --- |
| 完成步骤取走排队到工具边界的输入（先是 mid-turn 消息，然后是 teammate 消息），并发出下一轮 | 轮次在工具批之后取走这些输入并发出这一轮 |

模型收到的内容和会话记录都不变，对拍套件比较了两者。在轮次发出这一轮之前，工具批一直占着 scheduler，并让 TUI 保持非 Idle，因此排队的工具批和空闲时的任务不会在中间开始。如果另一个流还在进行，轮次不等待自己的工具批，就把这一轮留给工具批，由工具批自己发出。等待模型流的各个工具批仍在一次续发中发出，由流最后结束的那个轮次发出。

Ctrl+Y 的重试已经走共享轮次，并从 #16385 起等待自己的工具批。对拍套件现在运行：模型错误后的重试、再次失败的重试、重试的工具结果轮的响应又调用工具，以及工具运行期间提交的输入（它和工具结果一起发出）。这些场景无需改动即通过，因此本 PR 没有改动重试相关的代码。

具体改动（`use-llm-stream.ts`）：

- 完成步骤从取走边界输入到发送的尾段，现在是 `sendToolResultRound`。对 scheduler 自己的工具批，`handleCompletedTools` 照旧调用它；对共享工具批则返回它。
- 有待发的下一轮时，`runSharedToolBatch` 保留 scheduler 的占用和自己的 activity，并以这一轮作为结果。流处理把一个句柄交给轮次：轮次等待 `done` 并发出这一轮；如果另一个流还在进行，就调用 `leave()`，由工具批自己发出。

本 PR 也采纳了 #16385 review 的建议：scheduler 占用的注释说明了它的窗口与现有路径有何不同，重放 fixture 合并为一个辅助函数，等待测试改用 `holdBatches`。对拍套件忽略 shell 命令的进程组和 pid，它们每次运行都不同。

core 的共享代码没有改动；设置关闭时 TUI 不变。

设计文档描述了 3c-1 和新增场景。

## 为什么需要

在 #15327 中，Ink TUI 分步迁到共享 loop。轮次在每个工具批之后自己发出下一轮，TUI 的轮次就有了 loop 的形状；3c-2 把它扩展到 cron、后台通知、teammate 和 Goal 轮次，3d 把它设为默认。

## 验证方法

- 单元测试，`packages/cli` 的 `use-llm-stream.test.tsx`，"shared agent loop round"：
  - 排队到工具边界的输入在下一轮中跟在工具结果之后；
  - 轮次取走这些输入期间（一个 mid-turn 排队的 Goal 命令仍在运行），TUI 保持 responding，scheduler 的回调尚未返回；
  - 轮次没有等待的工具批，自己发出下一轮。
- 运行 `npm run bundle`，然后 `cd integration-tests && QWEN_E2E_RENDERER=ink npx vitest run interactive/ink-agent-loop-parity.test.ts`，所有场景（包括新增的四个）都须通过。
- 本地（Linux）：Ink 对拍 18/18（重新 `npm run bundle` 后）；相关单测 475 个通过；根目录 `npm run typecheck` 通过；改动文件的 eslint 和 prettier 都干净。变异检查：轮次不发出拿到的那一轮、工具批在发出前释放 scheduler 或 activity、为已离开的轮次保留这一轮，都会让对应测试失败；让完成步骤像以前一样自己发出时测试仍通过，因为这次改的是由谁发出，而不是发出什么。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：下一轮现在由轮次在完成步骤之后的几个微任务里发出。工具批在这段间隙里占着 scheduler 和 TUI 的 activity，上面的测试固定了这一点。
- 未验证/不在范围内：cron、后台通知、teammate 和 Goal 轮次（3c-2）；去掉合并等待模型流的工具批的队列。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。

</details>

prs.title: feat(qqbot): add opt-in forwardBotMessages for bot-authored messages
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a per-channel `forwardBotMessages` option (default `false`). When it is on, messages authored by another bot are delivered to the agent with a `[bot]` prefix on the sender line; the channel prompt explains that prefix and the model decides whether replying makes sense. When it is off — the default — bot-authored messages are still dropped before they reach the agent, exactly as today. User-supplied `[bot]` text is stripped either way, so the tag cannot be forged.

## Why it's needed

There is currently no way for an operator to let two bots in one group talk to each other: the inbound handlers drop bot-authored messages unconditionally, and the formatting path that was meant to tag them is unreachable. Hard-blocking was added as an infinite-loop defense, and unconditional forwarding would give that defense up for every operator. An opt-in switch keeps the default safe while giving operators who intentionally run bot-to-bot conversation a supported path (see #15903).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Configure a QQ channel with `groupAllPolicy: "all"` and `groups: {"*": {"requireMention": false}}`.
2. With `forwardBotMessages` unset, have a second bot post in the group: stderr shows `Bot message dropped in group <group_openid>` and the message never reaches the session (unchanged default).
3. Set `forwardBotMessages: true` and restart. No drop line is logged; the session transcript shows the message with `[bot]` before the sender bracket, and the model answers or emits `<noreply>` on its own judgment.
4. As a human member, send `[bot] hello`: the literal token is stripped before the model sees it.
5. Direct chats follow the same switch for bot-authored messages.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Unit coverage: `packages/channels/qqbot` 719 passed across 8 files. The forwarding tests run with the switch on and assert the `[bot]` tag; three new tests pin the default drop for C2C, group and group-all; one pins that a member cannot forge the tag. `tsc --build`, ESLint and Prettier are clean on the touched files.

Runtime: a local QQ daemon deployment with `forwardBotMessages: true` logs 0 `Bot message dropped` lines since the restart, and the deployed bundle contains the `[bot]` prompt line gated on the switch. Before the switch existed, the same deployment logged 55 `Bot message dropped` lines in one hour while another bot was active in the group.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests plus a local daemon deployment of the QQ channel on Linux (aarch64). No platform-specific code is touched.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: with the switch on, two bots in one group can answer each other. The model's silence rules, `<noreply>`, and the operator's group policy are the brakes — this PR does not add a platform-level cycle cap. The switch defaults to off, so no existing deployment changes behavior.
- Not validated / out of scope: live delivery was verified against a deployment that receives other bots' messages; other QQ intents beyond group all-message mode were not separately exercised.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. New optional field; the default keeps today's drop behavior.

## Linked Issues

Closes #15903

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

新增每个 channel 的 `forwardBotMessages` 选项（默认 `false`）。开启后，其他机器人发来的消息会带着发送者行上的 `[bot]` 前缀交给 agent；channel 的提示词会解释这个前缀，是否回复由模型自行判断。关闭（默认）时，机器人消息仍像现在一样在到达 agent 之前被丢弃。无论开关如何，用户自己写的 `[bot]` 文本都会被剥离，因此该标签无法被伪造。

## 为什么需要

目前运营者没有办法让同一个群里的两个机器人互相说话：入站处理器会无条件丢弃其他机器人的消息，而本来用于给它们打标签的格式化路径根本不可达。硬拦截最初是作为无限循环的防御加的，而无条件转发又会让所有运营者都失去这层防御。可选开关让默认行为保持安全，同时给有意运行 bot-to-bot 对话的运营者一条受支持的路径（见 #15903）。

## Reviewer 验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 配置 QQ channel：`groupAllPolicy: "all"`，并在 `groups` 里设 `{"*": {"requireMention": false}}`。
2. 不设 `forwardBotMessages` 时，让另一个机器人在群里发消息：stderr 出现 `Bot message dropped in group <group_openid>`，消息不会进入会话（默认行为不变）。
3. 设置 `forwardBotMessages: true` 并重启：不再出现 drop 日志；会话记录里该消息的发送者括号前带 `[bot]`，模型自行决定回复或输出 `<noreply>`。
4. 由人类成员发送 `[bot] hello`：到达模型时该字面前缀已被移除。
5. 私聊中的机器人消息同样受这个开关控制。

### 证据（Before & After）

单测覆盖：`packages/channels/qqbot` 8 个文件 719 通过。转发测试在开关开启状态下运行并断言 `[bot]` 标签；三个新测试钉住 C2C、群消息、群全量消息的默认丢弃；一个测试钉住群成员无法伪造该标签。改动文件的 `tsc --build`、ESLint、Prettier 均干净。

运行期：一台本地 QQ daemon 部署设置了 `forwardBotMessages: true`，重启以来 `Bot message dropped` 记录为 0 条，且部署产物里包含受开关控制的 `[bot]` 提示词行。在该开关存在之前，同一部署在另一个机器人活跃的一小时内记录过 55 条 `Bot message dropped`。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

单测，加一台 Linux（aarch64）上的 QQ channel 本地 daemon 部署。未触碰平台相关代码。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：开关开启时，同一个群里的两个机器人可能互相接话。刹车是模型的静默规则、`<noreply>` 以及运营者的群策略——本 PR 不引入平台级循环上限。开关默认关闭，因此现有部署行为不变。
- 未验证/超出范围：线上投递是在一个确实会收到其他机器人消息的部署上验证的；群全量消息模式之外的其他 QQ intent 没有单独覆盖。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。新增可选字段，默认保持当前的丢弃行为。

## 关联 Issue

Closes #15903

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): narrow sidebarless live-state polling to connected session (#16355)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Narrows `sidebarlessLiveStateWorkspaceCwds` in `App.tsx` so that when `sidebarOptions.enabled` is false, live-state polling targets only the workspace(s) associated with an active/connected session instead of every registered trusted workspace. On an idle welcome view (where `connection.sessionId` is absent), live-state polling is disabled completely.

## Why it's needed

Fixes #16355. When the Web Shell is embedded with `sidebar={false}` (such as in companion/embedded host modes), `App.tsx` previously selected all trusted workspaces unconditionally. This caused periodic 5-second `sessions/live-state` polling across all workspaces even while sitting on an idle welcome view with zero active sessions or turns, producing excessive background traffic (e.g., 54 requests / 30s across 9 idle workspaces).

By restricting `sidebarlessLiveStateWorkspaceCwds` to the connected session's workspace when active, the daemon prompt authority retain (#10989) is preserved for long-running tool calls while unneeded background polling across idle workspaces is eliminated.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run the targeted unit test suite in `@qwen-code/web-shell`:
   ```bash
   pnpm --filter @qwen-code/web-shell test client/App.test.tsx -t "polls prompt authority|avoids polling workspaces on an idle welcome view|polls the live workspace"
   ```
2. Confirm all 3 test cases pass:
   - When a normal session is connected with `sidebar={false}`, only its trusted workspace is polled.
   - On an idle welcome view (`sessionId: undefined`), `workspaceCwds` is empty and `enabled` is false.
   - When a live session is connected, only the live workspace is polled.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- **Before**: In `App.test.tsx`, rendering with `sidebar: false` passed `workspaceCwds: ['/tmp/project', '/tmp/live']` even when only `/tmp/project` was the connected session workspace. On an idle welcome view, all registered trusted workspaces were polled every 5s.
- **After**: With `sidebar: false` on an idle welcome view, `useWorkspaceSessionLiveState` receives `workspaceCwds: []` and `enabled: false`. When a session is active, only `['/tmp/project']` is queried.

### Tested on

| OS | Status | Notes |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | N/A | |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ | Windows 11, Node.js v22.18.0, pnpm 10.15.1 |
| 🐧 Linux | N/A | |

### Environment (optional)

- Unit tests via `vitest`

## Risk & Scope

- **Risk & Tradeoffs**: Low. The connected session's prompt authority retain introduced in #10989 remains fully active while a session is connected or running.
- **Not validated / out of scope**: Standalone Web Shell sidebar interactions (when `sidebarOptions.enabled` is true) are unchanged and remain governed by `WebShellSidebar`.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16355

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这次 PR 做了什么

收窄了 `App.tsx` 中的 `sidebarlessLiveStateWorkspaceCwds`：当 `sidebarOptions.enabled` 为 false 时，live-state 轮询仅针对当前存在已连接/展示会话的工作区，而不再无条件轮询所有已注册的受信任工作区。在没有会话的空闲欢迎视图（`connection.sessionId` 不存在）下，完全不启动工作区轮询。

## 为什么需要此改动

修复 #16355。当嵌入式 Web Shell 设置 `sidebar={false}`（如在伴生宿主环境中）时，`App.tsx` 原先会无条件选择所有受信任工作区，导致即使在空闲欢迎界面、没有任何会话运行的情况下，也会每 5 秒向所有工作区发起轮询请求（例如在 9 个空闲工作区下 30 秒产生 54 次请求）。

通过将轮询范围限定在当前活跃会话所在的工作区，既保留了 #10989 所需的 daemon prompt 权威状态守护，又彻底消除了空闲欢迎页及不相关工作区上的背景开销。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

运行 `@qwen-code/web-shell` 对应单测：
```bash
pnpm --filter @qwen-code/web-shell test client/App.test.tsx -t "polls prompt authority|avoids polling workspaces on an idle welcome view|polls the live workspace"
```

### 验证证据（改动前 vs 改动后）

- **改动前**：在 `sidebar: false` 且只连接单一会话时，仍会同时轮询 `['/tmp/project', '/tmp/live']`；在空闲欢迎页下同样每 5 秒发起全量轮询。
- **改动后**：空闲欢迎页下传递 `workspaceCwds: []` 且 `enabled: false`，不进行任何轮询；连接会话后仅精准轮询会话所在的工作区。

## 风险与范围

- **风险与权衡**：极低。#10989 在会话连接期间的指示器守护能力完全保留。
- **不在范围内**：当 `sidebarOptions.enabled` 为 true 时的侧边栏自有轮询逻辑保持不变。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #16355

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): honor tool result admission when resuming new recordings
prs.body:
## What this PR does

New recordings keep withheld tool output out of resumed model history. A result and its companion text/images require a confirmed admission receipt before entering model history. Completion remains in the local transcript. Each result keeps its first valid decision, and independent input keeps its own ownership.

Normal sends and terminal retention follow this rule. Cancellation, quota and capacity stops retain confirmed results when no prompt hook applies. An unfinished applicable hook retains synthetic closures. Explicit tool termination keeps its existing permission policy. Ink preserves shared batch ordering and send-time stop/capacity checks, recording finalized results and attachments once, including eligible late replacement.

A sent ACP message releases its old tool ownership before independent steering. OpenTUI settles completed mixed batches when cancellation arrives before steering or during context refresh, checking session and turn ownership before and after acknowledgement. Post-admission setup failures retain tool provenance and the send guard’s actual cut. Separately claimed plan-exit notices remain outside that retained snapshot. Declining every tool stops queued Mod prompts even when receipt persistence fails. History publication still requires receipt confirmation. Retried date reminders remain separate from tool-owned parts.

## Why it's needed

Completion can be recorded before a hook permits it, so recovery previously exposed withheld output. Conversely, retaining a result without its admission decision loses it on recovery. Failed writes cannot establish permission. Stale ownership and asynchronous cancellation windows can break this contract even when the receipt format is correct.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Block, cancel or interrupt a newly recorded tool-result round. Live continuation and fresh-process recovery must omit withheld output and tool-owned companions, close each call once and preserve independent input. Allow the same result as a content/pairing control.
- Delay or fail receipt writes at terminal boundaries. History waits for acknowledgement, honors the first decision and follows the applicable-hook policy. Check complete companions/images, exactly-once completion recording and session isolation.
- Send a tool lap, accept independent steering, then cancel before its history push. Cancellation completes normally and retains the steering. Cancel a completed mixed OpenTUI batch before steering or during context refresh. Verify that only its tool packet settles and queued input is preserved. Change session or turn during acknowledgement. Verify that successor history receives no result from the previous host.
- Queue a Mod prompt, decline all tools, then reject the receipt write. Once the UI becomes idle, the declined Mod chain must not start another model request. Successful writes, withheld results and a Mod's own quiet abort retain their respective policies. On Retry, a restored date reminder and independently queued input remain outside the tool packet, including equal-text input.
- Admit an over-budget tool result, let the actual send guard cut it, then fail compression or pre-push setup. Retained history must match the cut with its provenance and independent input. The next successful request carries a separately restored plan-exit notice once. Compare an ordinary successful send and small uncut output.
- Force setup failure after admission. Retained results keep provenance on the next request. Race late replacement with sending or compression. Eligible replacements confirm recording and admission before publication. Replacements that cross a later model turn are rejected before recording. Ordinary prompts and prepared replay keep their cancellation contract.
- Load old recordings as visibility controls. Old-format withheld output remains exposed.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The candidate `abe0d237290bb4623ec696fbb23c412782c34c0b` directly follows the public bot merge `74a606c59050936f4b9f4ab844541bce17672106`. It includes main `7bd78683e63a50334fbcb124568101868048264c` and keeps the bot's import resolution and upstream title-sidecar changes. [Public merge report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16267#issuecomment-6672037122)

On that exact public baseline, the test-only change reproduced three failures. A failed receipt write allowed a queued Mod prompt to reach the model after all tools were declined. The actual guard cut 20,000 characters to at most 1,024, but compression failure and pre-push setup failure left the original result in live history. Seven controls passed. Moving the existing Mod stop before the write and refreshing the retained snapshot at the guard cut makes all ten pass. The tests also check result provenance, separately owned input with the same text, one-time plan-exit notice restoration and retried date reminders. Five complete affected files pass 3,419 cases. The Mod case uses the React host with controlled model and receipt behavior. The guard cases exercise real core history with controlled receipt, transport and later dependency failures.

The frozen build and bundle, full typecheck, lint and nine-file pre-commit check passed. Fresh recording acceptance passed 31 scenarios, with 21 actual CLI/ACP process scenarios and 10 direct-core scenarios. All 18 commands exited zero. The before/after manifests match 1,154 runtime files and 84 historical fixture inputs.

The first full run checked out the exact candidate. Across 27 unit scopes it observed 85,615 passed, two failed and 44 skipped. The CLI worker-replacement case received OutcomeUnknown/ECONNREFUSED and default bail left 1,409 of 1,443 CLI files and 401 collected cases without final outcomes. Core finished all 1,013 files, with one ENOTEMPTY during cleanup of the upstream explicit-title sidecar test. Both first-run failures and two delayed promise-rejection warnings without captured traces are retained. All 51 integration cases, 746 helper cases, standalone, build, typecheck, six static checks and the serve closure check passed. [First full run](https://github.com/LyleLiu666/qwen-code/actions/runs/42134120133)

The supplement completed all 1,443 CLI files with bail disabled and no retries, yielding 49,136 passed, zero failed and 111 skipped. Replacing only the partial CLI scope for coverage accounting gives 27 scopes and 3,561 files with 123,542 passed, one failure and 153 skipped. The retained Core failure is the original title-sidecar cleanup error. The original run still records both failures. The supplement logs one additional delayed promise-rejection warning without a captured trace. Both runs report zero obsolete snapshot sections and zero Vitest unhandled-error summaries. On a separate single runner, exact public 74a and candidate abe0 each passed three complete runs of the title file (19 cases) and three of the worker file (103 cases), with both original targets executed in every attempt. Neither first-run failure recurred in isolation. The original causes remain unestablished. [CLI supplement and matched controls](https://github.com/LyleLiu666/qwen-code/actions/runs/42141409432)

The earlier `11ce70272` run completed with 123,310 passed, zero failed and 153 skipped, with two delayed promise-rejection warnings without captured traces. The preserved `608c03b08` initial run had a worker connection refusal and a MemoryManager warning assertion failure. Its CLI supplement filled the coverage gap, leaving 123,316 passed, one failure and 153 skipped across 27 scopes. On the same runner, the exact upstream comparison reproduced that MemoryManager assertion once, and the worker failure did not recur in isolation. The original full-run causes remain unestablished. [Earlier 11ce run](https://github.com/LyleLiu666/qwen-code/actions/runs/42062765905) · [Earlier 608c run](https://github.com/LyleLiu666/qwen-code/actions/runs/42082899625) · [Earlier supplement](https://github.com/LyleLiu666/qwen-code/actions/runs/42097034821)

Earlier published `54919c760` had one MemoryManager deadline-warning failure. Intermediate Code Mode, Vite, MemoryManager, ZIP cleanup and worker connection failures and the earlier CLI coverage gap and obsolete snapshots are retained in their original records. The corresponding isolated controls used the earlier exact sources. Their results stay separate from full-run totals. An earlier mistargeted 11ce workflow was cancelled during build before tests started and is excluded.

### Tested on

| OS      | Status                                                                                                                                                        |
| :------ | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| macOS   | Boundary checks and exact-SHA recording acceptance pass.                                                                                                      |
| Windows | Historical targeted and PTY coverage only.                                                                                                      |
| Linux | Complete unit coverage across the original run and CLI supplement. One original Core failure remains in coverage accounting. |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.22.3. Deterministic local endpoints capture complete model requests. Real-provider coverage is limited to the historical cases below.

## Risk & Scope

- Core recording, recovery and host boundaries require maintainer review. Verification ran on a personal fork. The candidate preserves the public bot merge and its exact main parent `7bd78683`. Later upstream changes are tracked separately.
- Protection covers new ordinary completions. Old formats still leak withheld output. Restore re-execution intentionally retains its unmarked completion and authorization policy. Internal Code Mode results remain outside model history. Initial Cron/Notification and explicit tool termination retain their permission policies. Disabled shared-loop quota keeps its existing no-history policy.
- Confirmation establishes a write and process-recovery boundary. Provider receipt, fsync and power-loss durability are outside that guarantee. Eligible late recovery can reorder companions relative to independent input. Ordinary/mixed probes retain raw-history differences while checking input retention and next-request normalization. Raw histories can differ.
- Causes of original full-run failures remain unestablished. Historical injected-clock diagnostics retain their original source identities.
- Windows and real-model coverage remain limited to the historical matrix. The 4B model passed 42 of 43 across configurations. An ACP plan-mode timeout left exit-plan behavior unresolved. A 9B diagnostic made the correct edit but exceeded its 300-second final-answer deadline.

The design is synchronized in both languages. [English](https://github.com/LyleLiu666/qwen-code/blob/abe0d237290bb4623ec696fbb23c412782c34c0b/docs/design/2026-11-03-tool-result-admission.md) · [中文](https://github.com/LyleLiu666/qwen-code/blob/abe0d237290bb4623ec696fbb23c412782c34c0b/docs/design/2026-11-03-tool-result-admission.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Related to #15595. Old-format compatibility remains affected.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的变更

新版记录恢复时不再把扣留的工具输出交给模型。结果及附带文字、图片须在放行凭据确认后进入模型历史，完成记录仍保留在本地。每个结果保留首个有效决定，独立输入单独归属。

正常发送和终止保留遵循同一规则。取消、额度及容量停止时，无适用提示词hook则确认后保留原结果。适用hook尚未完成则只保留合成闭合。显式工具终止沿用既有权限政策。Ink保留共享批顺序及发送时停止/容量检查，完整结果及附件只记录一次，包括符合条件的迟到替换。

ACP成功发送后清除旧工具归属，再准备独立steer。OpenTUI在steer前或刷新上下文期间取消时结算已完成的混合批，凭据确认前后核对会话/轮次。放行后准备失败仍保留工具来源信息及真实发送裁剪结果。单独领取的计划模式通知不混入该快照。用户拒绝全部工具后，即使凭据写入失败也停止排队Mod。历史仍须等待放行凭据确认后发布。Retry补发的日期提醒单独归属。

## 原因

完成记录可能先于hook放行写入，原恢复逻辑因此暴露扣留输出。反之，保留结果却不保存放行决定，会使其恢复后丢失。失败写入不能建立许可。即使凭据格式正确，过期归属和异步取消窗口也可能破坏约束。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 验证方法

- 拦截、取消或中断新版工具结果轮次。实时继续和新进程恢复均须移除扣留输出及工具附带内容，每个调用只闭合一次，并保留独立输入。允许同一结果作为内容/配对对照。
- 在终止边界延迟或拒绝凭据写入。历史等待确认、尊重首个决定，并遵循适用hook政策。检查附带文字/图片完整、完成记录恰好一次和会话隔离。
- 发送工具结果，接受独立steer，再在历史写入前取消：取消正常结束，steer保留。在steer前或刷新上下文时取消已完成OpenTUI混合批：只结算工具片段，保留排队输入。确认期间更换会话/轮次：旧宿主不得向后继历史发布。
- 排队Mod提示，拒绝所有工具，然后拒绝凭据写入。UI空闲后，被拒绝的Mod链不能再启动模型请求。成功写入、扣留结果及Mod自行quiet abort分别保持既有政策。Retry中，重建的日期提醒与独立排队输入不属于工具包，包括与工具同文的输入。
- 放行超预算结果，经过真实发送裁剪后让压缩或历史推送前的准备失败：保留历史须等于裁剪结果，携带来源信息与独立输入。下一成功请求只带一份单独恢复的计划模式通知。以正常成功发送及小输出不裁剪作对照。
- 放行后强制准备失败：下一请求的保留结果仍有来源信息。让迟到替换与发送/压缩竞争：符合条件的替换先确认记录/放行再发布。跨后续模型回合则在记录前拒绝。普通提示及准备请求重放保持原取消约束。
- 加载旧记录作可见性对照。旧格式扣留输出仍会暴露。

### 前后证据

候选 `abe0d237290bb4623ec696fbb23c412782c34c0b` 直接继承公开机器人合并 `74a606c59050936f4b9f4ab844541bce17672106`，包含精确上游 `7bd78683e63a50334fbcb124568101868048264c`，保留机器人解决的导入冲突和上游会话标题旁路文件变更。 [公开合并回执](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16267#issuecomment-6672037122)

在精确公开基线上只加测试，复现三处失败。拒绝全部工具且凭据写入失败后，排队的 Mod 提示仍发给模型。真实发送守卫将 20,000 字符裁到至多 1,024，但压缩失败和推送历史前的准备失败仍把全文留在实时历史。七项对照通过。把既有 Mod 停止操作提前到写入前，并在守卫裁剪后刷新保留快照，十项全部通过。测试同时检查来源、同文独立输入、计划退出通知只恢复一次和重试日期提醒。五个完整相关文件共 3,419 项通过。Mod 反例使用真实 React 宿主及受控的模型和凭据写入。守卫反例使用真实核心历史及受控凭据、传输和后续依赖故障。

冻结构建和打包、完整类型检查、lint 和九文件提交前检查均通过。新录制验收通过 31 项，含 21 项实际 CLI/ACP 进程场景和 10 项直接 Core 场景。18 个命令均 exit 0。前后核对的 1,154 个运行文件和 84 份历史输入哈希一致。

首轮全仓检出精确候选。27 个单元范围观测 85,615 项通过、2 失败、44 跳过。CLI worker 替换用例报 OutcomeUnknown/ECONNREFUSED，默认首错退出使 1,443 个文件中的 1,409 个和 401 个已收集用例没有终局。Core 完成 1,013 个文件，上游显式标题旁路文件用例清理临时目录时发生 ENOTEMPTY。两处原失败及两条无调用栈的延迟处理 Promise 拒绝警告均保留。51 项集成、746 项 helper、standalone、构建、类型、六类静态检查及 serve 闭包均通过。 [首轮全仓](https://github.com/LyleLiu666/qwen-code/actions/runs/42134120133)

CLI 补验关闭首错退出、无重试，1,443 个文件全部有结果，49,136 项通过、0 失败、111 跳过。仅以这次完整 CLI 替换首轮不完整范围做覆盖对账，27 个范围、3,561 个文件共 123,542 项通过、1 失败、153 跳过，保留首轮 Core 标题用例的清理失败。首轮仍保留两处原失败。补验另有一条无调用栈的延迟处理 Promise 拒绝警告。两轮均无废弃快照区段或 Vitest 未处理错误摘要。另一台 runner 在同一 job 内对精确公开 74a 和候选 abe0 分别执行标题整文件三次（每次 19 项）与 worker 整文件三次（每次 103 项）。12 次全部通过，两个原目标每次均实跑，首轮两处失败未在隔离对照复现，原始触发原因仍未证实。 [CLI 补验与同机对照](https://github.com/LyleLiu666/qwen-code/actions/runs/42141409432)

历史 `11ce70272` 完成 123,310 项通过、0 失败、153 跳过，保留两条无调用栈的延迟处理 Promise 拒绝警告。历史 `608c03b08` 首轮保留 worker 连接拒绝和 MemoryManager 警告断言失败。补齐 CLI 覆盖后，27 个范围合计 123,316 通过、1 失败、153 跳过。同一 runner 的精确上游对照重现一次 MemoryManager 断言，worker 失败未在隔离对照重现。原全仓的具体原因仍待确认。 [历史 11ce](https://github.com/LyleLiu666/qwen-code/actions/runs/42062765905) · [历史 608c](https://github.com/LyleLiu666/qwen-code/actions/runs/42082899625) · [历史补验](https://github.com/LyleLiu666/qwen-code/actions/runs/42097034821)

已发布的历史 `54919c760` 保留一处 MemoryManager 期限警告失败。更早的 Code Mode、Vite、MemoryManager、ZIP 清理、worker 连接失败，以及 CLI 缺口和废弃快照记录继续保留。各对照使用各自精确源码，单独统计。11ce 有一次检出错误提交的操作在构建时取消，测试未启动，该次运行排除。

### 测试平台

| 平台    | 状态                                                                  |
| :------ | :-------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| macOS   | 边界检查及精确SHA录制验收通过。                                       |
| Windows | 未重跑，保留历史定向/PTY限制。                                        |

- 核心录制、恢复及宿主边界仍需维护者审查。验证在个人 fork 上执行。候选保留公开机器人合并及其精确上游父提交 `7bd78683`，较晚的上游变更另行跟踪。

prs.title: feat(serve): add atomic user Skill activation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds `PUT /skills/activation` and the TypeScript SDK's `setUserSkillsActivation` to enable or disable 1–100 explicitly named Skills at User scope in one request. Disabled preferences support `hard` (default) and `default` modes. Qwen computes the three-list change under the primary settings lock and persists the batch once, preserving other names, scopes, and settings.

The response reports saved preferences, per-name changes, and asynchronous propagation scheduling. Ordinary user settings events invalidate consumers; existing workspace status endpoints report effective availability. Pending User reloads survive configuration/session failures and lifecycle transitions, and an older refresh cannot acknowledge a newer request.

## Why it's needed

Callers should not need to read current settings, calculate list differences, and race other writers just to toggle Skills. This replacement for #15466 keeps the operation scoped to explicit names: enabling `rust:pdf` preserves a bare `pdf` restriction and other qualified names. Saving a preference does not depend on catalog completeness or imply that System restrictions have been removed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. In isolated User settings, enable and disable one or multiple names, including an uninstalled name. Verify the requested names move into the correct list, unrelated settings survive, and repeating the same request produces no write or event.
2. Configure a bare `pdf` restriction and Skills from two extensions. Enable `rust:pdf`; verify `pdf`, the other extension's restriction, and System policy still apply.
3. Open sessions in two workspaces. Verify settings events and actual Skill availability change in both existing sessions. User writes should also succeed without workspace trust.
4. Submit different-name requests concurrently with another User setting write. Verify the durable configuration retains every change.
5. Corrupt one isolated workspace's settings file, save a User change, and observe the healthy workspace refresh while the other reports a refresh error. Repair the file and ensure that runtime; the existing session should recover without another User write.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Baseline global CLI 0.22.0 returned 404 for the endpoint, omitted the capability, and did not allow PUT in CORS preflight. The new build accepts the operation and advertises its capability. Isolated daemon E2E observed two existing sessions remove and restore Skills, exact-name/System restriction preservation, no-op event suppression, 12 concurrent Skill writes plus a language write, and failure recovery without another settings mutation. A separate E2E report follows this PR description.

Validation passed: build, full typecheck, bundle, focused ESLint/Prettier, 3,293 CLI tests, 562 SDK tests, 186 ACP bridge tests, and the capability integration check. After the integration check exposed a missing bootstrap capability flag, the corrected daemon's full 543-test file and E2E/integration checks passed again. Two self-audit passes and an independent source audit are complete. The native local review command could not start because headless CLI authentication is not configured; no native review verdict is claimed.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Built daemon with isolated home, User/System settings, runtime directories, workspace fixtures, and explicit test authentication. No LLM calls are needed for the Skill availability checks.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: propagation is asynchronous across workspace processes. A saved preference can remain blocked by existing policy or await successful runtime reconciliation.
- Not validated / out of scope: cross-process competing settings writers, new Skill identity rules, and Managed Agent public APIs. Transient draining, pause recovery, request interleaving, and partial session failures have deterministic unit coverage rather than external process fault injection.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: additive API and SDK surface; existing workspace-only refresh semantics remain compatible. No configuration migration is introduced.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/user-skill-activation-v2/docs/design/user-skill-activation.md), [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/user-skill-activation-v2/docs/design/user-skill-activation.zh-CN.md). Both versions describe the same decisions and acceptance criteria.

## Linked Issues

Replacement for #15466.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 功能

新增 `PUT /skills/activation` 和 TypeScript SDK 的 `setUserSkillsActivation`，一次请求在 User 作用域启停 1–100 个明确指定名字的 Skill。禁用支持 `hard`（默认）和 `default` 两种模式。Qwen 在 primary settings 写锁内计算三名单变化，一次保存整批变更，并保留其他名字、作用域及配置。

响应分别表达已保存偏好、逐项变化和异步传播排队状态。普通 User 设置事件使消费者缓存失效；实际可用性由现有工作区状态接口提供。配置或会话刷新失败、生命周期切换时保留待处理 User 重读，旧刷新不能确认后来的请求。

### 动机

调用方不应为了启停 Skill 而先读取配置、计算名单差异并与其他写入方竞争。本 PR 替代 #15466，将操作限定为明确请求的名字：启用 `rust:pdf` 会保留裸名 `pdf` 和其他限定名的限制。保存偏好不依赖目录完整性，也不表示 System 限制已被移除。

### 评审验证

1. 使用隔离 User 配置启停一个或多个名字，包括未安装的名字。确认请求名字进入正确名单、无关配置保留，重复请求不写文件、不发事件。
2. 配置裸名 `pdf` 限制并安装两个扩展的 Skill。启用 `rust:pdf`，确认 `pdf`、另一个扩展的限制以及 System 策略仍生效。
3. 在两个工作区打开会话，确认设置事件及实际 Skill 可用性都在已有会话中变化。未信任工作区也应允许 User 写入。
4. 并发提交不同名字的请求及另一项 User 设置写入，确认磁盘配置保留所有变更。
5. 破坏一个隔离工作区的配置文件后提交 User 变更，确认健康工作区正常刷新，另一个报告刷新错误。修复文件后 ensure 该 runtime，已有会话应恢复，无需再次写入 User 设置。

### 前后证据与环境

全局 CLI 0.22.0 对新接口返回 404、不发布能力，且 CORS 预检不允许 PUT。新构建接受操作并发布能力。隔离 daemon E2E 观察到两个已有会话移除和恢复 Skill、明确名字/System 限制保留、幂等时不发事件、12 个 Skill 与语言设置并发写入，以及无需再次修改配置的失败恢复。完整 E2E 报告将以独立评论提供。

验证已通过：build、全量 typecheck、bundle、定向 ESLint/Prettier、3,293 项 CLI 单测、562 项 SDK 单测、186 项 ACP bridge 单测及能力集成检查。集成检查发现启动阶段漏发能力标记后，修复版 daemon 的完整 543 项测试和 E2E/集成检查再次通过。两轮自审及独立源码审查已完成。原生本地 review 命令因 headless CLI 未配置认证而无法启动，因此不宣称获得该评审结论。

macOS 已测试；Windows、Linux 未在本地测试。使用构建后的 daemon、隔离 home、User/System 配置、runtime 目录、工作区样例和显式测试鉴权。Skill 可用性检查无需 LLM 调用。

### 风险与范围

- 主要风险与取舍：跨工作区进程异步传播。已保存偏好可能仍受现有策略限制，或等待 runtime 成功协调。
- 未验证或范围之外：多个进程竞争写配置、新 Skill 身份规则及 Managed Agent 公开 API。瞬态 draining、暂停恢复、请求交错和部分会话失败由确定性单测覆盖，未做外部进程故障注入。
- 兼容与迁移：新增 API/SDK；现有只刷新 Workspace 的语义保持兼容。不引入配置迁移。

设计文档的中英文版本包含同步的决策与验收标准。本 PR 替代 #15466。

</details>

prs.body:
## What this PR does

Localizes the remaining nine Companion command titles using VS Code's existing English and Simplified Chinese catalogs, and includes both catalogs in the extension package. All twelve resolved English command titles, command IDs, menus, keybindings and settings remain unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Nine command titles remain English under a Chinese VS Code display language. In addition, the packaging whitelist excludes both existing catalogs: the installed vsce 3.9.2 file list contains neither before this change. Adding translations alone would therefore leave the installed extension untranslated.

This is the manifest-command slice invited by the maintainer in #13967. It leaves notifications, configuration descriptions, additional locales, webview language precedence and shared CLI translation sources for follow-up.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

With a Simplified Chinese VS Code display language, command titles such as Open, Focus Chat View and New Conversation should resolve to Chinese. With English, the titles should remain exactly as before. Command execution, keybindings and menu visibility should remain unchanged. Confirm that both translation catalogs are present in the packaged VSIX.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before: nine titles are hardcoded English; neither NLS catalog appears in `vsce ls --no-dependencies`.
- After: all twelve titles resolve in English and Simplified Chinese; both catalogs are listed and included byte-for-byte in a real vsce-generated VSIX.
- Before/after Command Palette screenshots below use an isolated manifest fixture in real VS Code with no-op activation; they do not show full Companion runtime verification.

| Before (zh-CN) | After (zh-CN) |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sumire-no-kai/qwen-code/23e40b10d9ef994a5386a2ac194157a3f4b04319/docs/verification/issue-13967/before-zh.png) | ![After](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sumire-no-kai/qwen-code/23e40b10d9ef994a5386a2ac194157a3f4b04319/docs/verification/issue-13967/after-zh.png) |

- Actual VS Code 1.142.0 isolated extension-host tests confirm the before/after Chinese labels and unchanged English labels. These tests use copied real manifests/catalogs and a no-op activation stub: they exercise VS Code's own NLS loader, not full Companion activation or command execution.
- Five focused manifest/package-selection tests pass. Isolated mutations confirm that removing the catalog inclusion, cross-wiring a command title key, and changing a baseline English label each fail the strengthened checks; all three passed the previous tests. Root build, repository typecheck, bundle, companion build/typecheck/lint, formatting and whitespace checks pass. The complete repository test suite was not run.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| macOS | ✅ build, types, packaging and isolated VS Code NLS loader |
| Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment

macOS arm64, Node 26.8.2, pinned pnpm 11.24.0, vsce 3.9.2, VS Code 1.142.0. The verification VSIX contains the built extension and webview but is not a full release package with the separately prepared bundled CLI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk: missing or mismatched NLS keys; manifest tests, actual VS Code loading and archive inspection cover this path.
- Not validated / out of scope: complete extension activation, command execution, full release installation and other operating systems.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; English fallback titles are preserved.
- Design: [English](https://github.com/Sumire-no-kai/qwen-code/blob/23e40b10d9ef994a5386a2ac194157a3f4b04319/docs/design/2026-10-17-companion-command-localization.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/Sumire-no-kai/qwen-code/blob/23e40b10d9ef994a5386a2ac194157a3f4b04319/docs/design/2026-10-17-companion-command-localization.zh-CN.md). Both versions describe the same scope, constraints and acceptance criteria.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13967. This completes only the manifest command-title slice, not the entire localization request.

使用 VS Code 现有的英文与简体中文语言文件本地化剩余九个 Companion 命令标题，并将两个语言文件包含在扩展安装包中。十二个命令解析后的英文标题、命令 ID、菜单、快捷键和设置均保持不变。

prs.title: fix(ci): report timed-out main CI runs instead of letting cancelled hide them
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the main-CI failure tracker report a run that was **cancelled by a job execution-time timeout**, while still ignoring a plain concurrency cancellation. The trigger now admits `cancelled` conclusions alongside `failure`, and a new discriminator at the top of the `live` step decides which cancellations are real: it reads the cancelled jobs' annotations and reports only when one carries `exceeded the maximum execution time`. The download projections also include cancelled jobs so the timed-out leg is named in the filed issue.

## Why it's needed

`main-ci-failure-issue.yml` only admitted `failure`. A job that hits its `timeout-minutes` cap concludes `cancelled`, not `failure` — so a timed-out main run never filed an issue. That is exactly how #16214 hid: the E2E `sandbox:docker` leg rebuilt the sandbox image past its 60-minute cap on cold mainland hosts, run after run reported `cancelled`, and the tracker stayed silent for weeks. This is the follow-up tracked as #16272.

A `cancelled` conclusion covers two very different things, so the trigger alone cannot decide: a deliberate concurrency supersede (should not file) and a job timeout (a real breakage, should file). The annotation is the discriminator — a timeout carries `The job has exceeded the maximum execution time of …`; a concurrency cancel carries only `The operation was canceled.`.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Read the `live` step's new leading block: for a `cancelled` run it fetches the attempt's jobs, reads each cancelled job's check-run annotations, and sets `superseded=true` (skip) unless a timeout annotation is found. The rest of the pipeline is unchanged; the infra classifier still selects `failure` jobs only, so a pure-timeout run (no failure jobs) files an issue rather than rerunning, and normal failure handling is untouched.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The discriminator exercised against a mocked `gh` (real `live` step bash):

```
cancelled + timeout annotation      -> superseded=false  (report)
cancelled + "operation was canceled" -> superseded=true   (skip, concurrency)
cancelled + annotations unreadable   -> superseded=true   (fail-safe skip)
failure                              -> classifier not engaged (unchanged)
```

`scripts/tests/main-ci-failure-issue-workflow.test.js` + `scripts/tests/ci-platform-lanes.test.js`: 224 passed. Three new live-step tests witness the timeout/concurrency/unreadable paths; the trigger pin, routing matrix, download-selector pins, jobs-fetch count, and the platform-lanes trigger pin are updated. Mutation witness: breaking the timeout-signature match reddens the timeout test. YAML parses; `bash -n` clean on the step; prettier clean.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Local: the two contract suites (which execute the real step bash with a mocked `gh`), the standalone discriminator simulation, and a mutation check. Linux marked not-tested because the workflow was not exercised on a live `workflow_run` event here; the behavior is covered by the bash-level tests.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: admitting `cancelled` lets more runs enter `analyze`, so the discriminator must reliably skip concurrency cancels. It fails safe toward silence — if the jobs or annotations cannot be read, no timeout is proven and the run is skipped (the user-requested tradeoff: prefer missing a report over spamming an issue for every displaced run). A real timeout whose annotations are unreadable is therefore dropped; that is the deliberate cost of the fail-safe direction.
- Not validated / out of scope: a live `workflow_run` cancellation event end-to-end; the unrelated reporter-queueing gap in #15470 (failure runs whose reporter job is itself superseded).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for `failure` runs — their path through the pipeline is unchanged. The only new reports are timeout-backed cancellations that previously produced nothing.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16272

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

让 main CI 失败追踪器上报**因 job 执行超时而被取消**的 run，同时仍然忽略普通的并发取消。触发器现在在 `failure` 之外也接纳 `cancelled` 结论，`live` 步骤顶部新增一个判别器决定哪些取消是真的：它读取被取消 job 的 annotation，只有当某个 job 带有 `exceeded the maximum execution time` 时才上报。download 投影也纳入 cancelled job，以便在提交的 issue 里点名超时的 leg。

## 为什么需要

`main-ci-failure-issue.yml` 以前只接纳 `failure`。撞到 `timeout-minutes` 上限的 job 结论是 `cancelled` 而非 `failure`——所以超时的 main run 从不提交 issue。这正是 #16214 藏起来的方式：E2E `sandbox:docker` leg 在冷的大陆主机上重建 sandbox 镜像超过 60 分钟上限，一个又一个 run 报 `cancelled`，追踪器却沉默了几周。这是记为 #16272 的后续项。

`cancelled` 结论涵盖两种截然不同的情况，所以仅凭触发器无法判断：故意的并发顶替（不该提交）和 job 超时（真实破坏，该提交）。annotation 是判别依据——超时带 `The job has exceeded the maximum execution time of …`；并发取消只带 `The operation was canceled.`。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

读 `live` 步骤新的前置块：对 `cancelled` run，它抓取该 attempt 的 jobs，读取每个 cancelled job 的 check-run annotation，除非找到超时 annotation 否则设 `superseded=true`（跳过）。流水线其余部分不变；infra 分类器仍只选 `failure` job，所以纯超时 run（无 failure job）会提交 issue 而非重跑，正常失败处理不受影响。

### 证据（前后对比）

判别器对着 mock `gh` 演练（真实 `live` 步骤 bash）：

```
cancelled + 超时 annotation        -> superseded=false （上报）
cancelled + "operation was canceled" -> superseded=true  （跳过，并发）
cancelled + annotation 读不到       -> superseded=true  （fail-safe 跳过）
failure                            -> 分类器不介入（不变）
```

`scripts/tests/main-ci-failure-issue-workflow.test.js` + `scripts/tests/ci-platform-lanes.test.js`：224 通过。三条新 live 步骤测试实证超时/并发/读不到三条路径；触发器 pin、路由矩阵、download 选择器 pin、jobs 抓取计数、以及 platform-lanes 触发器 pin 都已更新。变异实证：破坏超时签名匹配会让超时测试变红。YAML 可解析；步骤 `bash -n` 干净；prettier 干净。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

本地：两个契约套件（用 mock `gh` 执行真实步骤 bash）、独立判别器仿真、变异检查。Linux 标记未测试，因为没有在真实 `workflow_run` 事件上跑过该 workflow；行为已由 bash 级测试覆盖。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：接纳 `cancelled` 让更多 run 进入 `analyze`，所以判别器必须可靠地跳过并发取消。它朝沉默方向 fail-safe——若 jobs 或 annotation 读不到，没有证明超时就跳过（用户要求的取舍：宁可漏报，也不为每个被顶替的 run 刷 issue）。因此 annotation 读不到的真实超时会被丢弃；这是 fail-safe 方向的刻意代价。
- 未验证 / 范围之外：真实 `workflow_run` 取消事件的端到端；#15470 里无关的 reporter 排队缺口（reporter job 自身被顶替的 failure run）。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：对 `failure` run 无——它们走流水线的路径不变。唯一新增的上报是以前什么都不产生的超时取消。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #16272

</details>

prs.title: feat(skills): add native ZIP installation with result receipts
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds native Skill ZIP installation from a browser upload or a `zip-file` already on the daemon host. The new sources accept up to 50 MiB compressed, 200 MiB extracted, 4096 ZIP entries and a 32 MiB root manifest. Existing base64, directory and GitHub limits remain unchanged.

The daemon streams to an owned temporary archive, shares the existing install/delete lock, supports cancellation before publication, and completes commit or rollback once publication is admitted. Owner-scoped attempt receipts distinguish committed, not committed and recovery-required outcomes after a lost response. The SDK preserves the attempt ID on errors; Web Shell sends File/Blob directly, checks ambiguous outcomes without retransmitting, and reports activation failures separately from installation success. Older daemons retain the base64 path and show an upgrade hint before sending an oversized archive.

## Why it's needed

A real 20 MiB ZIP exceeds the existing 10 MiB JSON request limit after base64 encoding. Native transport removes that overhead, while a daemon-local file source avoids retransmitting an archive that is already on the host. A bounded receipt contract makes cancellation and timeout outcomes explicit without introducing background jobs or persistent transactions.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Upload a real 20 MiB ZIP through the browser and install the same content from a daemon-local ZIP into a secondary workspace. Both should install byte-identical files in the selected scope, return a matching archive digest, and preserve the caller's original file.
- Cancel while receiving or waiting behind another installation. Check the receipt; cancellation before publication should leave the previous installation intact, and later waiters must retain their order. A cancellation after publication admission may still result in a committed receipt.
- Disconnect after sending an installation and check the result. The UI should query independently, offer a manual check if still running or unknown, and never automatically resend. A runtime activation failure should leave an installed-success notice with a separate warning.
- Verify native size/layout boundaries, duplicate attempt rejection, owner isolation and recovery-backup preservation. Existing base64/folder/GitHub behavior and ordinary workspace file writes should retain their limits and serialization.
- Connect the new UI to an older daemon: a small ZIP should still install through base64, while a 20 MiB ZIP should show upgrade guidance before any install request.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Scenario | Before: unmodified main | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Real 20 MiB ZIP | Base64 JSON returns 413; native routes/sources unavailable | Raw and host-file installation return 200; installed bytes and archive digests match |
| Browser cancellation | No native receipt flow | One install POST; automatic receipt lookup, then manual check; cancellation confirmed without retransmission |
| Two simultaneous 200 MiB expanded packages | Exceed legacy package limits | Both install correctly; a third active archive request returns 429 |
| Older daemon | Small base64 ZIP supported | Support retained; oversized native requirement explained before upload |

Root build, typecheck and bundle passed. Focused CLI, SDK and Web Shell tests cover the new contracts and existing shared consumers. Independent real HTTP and Chromium acceptance used isolated daemons; the detailed E2E report is posted separately.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ macOS 26.6.2 arm64; Chromium 149.0.7827.55 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment

Local bundle on Node.js 26.7.0, isolated homes/workspaces, real HTTP and browser requests. No provider credentials or model calls were needed for installation acceptance.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: cross-package lifecycle and cancellation changes need maintainer review. Borrowed ZIPs are copied once; callers must keep them stable during copying, and can provide an expected SHA-256. Metadata checks are not an atomic snapshot. The ZIP dependency is updated to the repository's existing 3.4 version after reproducing a file-stream hang in 2.10.
- Not validated / out of scope: Linux/Windows execution, cross-process serialization, resumable uploads, automatic retry, persistent receipts and restart recovery. Receipts are process-local and retained for ten minutes after completion. The final short HTTP smoke encountered an ACP-preheat shutdown error during teardown; no test process remained. The local `/review` command could not run because Qwen authentication was not configured; two self-audit passes completed, the repository bot findings are tracked in the follow-up verification report, and maintainer approval remains required.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no change to legacy source limits or the JSON body limit. New file sources are confined to modern config routes. All sources, including legacy sources, preserve leftover backups for recovery; successful installations still clean their own backups. Expiring process-local receipts cannot safely identify disposable backups after a restart.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/skill-install-redesign/docs/design/2026-10-29-skill-archive-installation.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/skill-install-redesign/docs/design/2026-10-29-skill-archive-installation.zh-CN.md). Both versions describe the same decisions, constraints and acceptance criteria.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #15030.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

增加浏览器原生 ZIP 上传和 daemon 主机已有 `zip-file` 两种 Skill 安装入口。新来源支持压缩 50 MiB、展开 200 MiB、4096 个 ZIP 条目和 32 MiB 根 manifest；原有 base64、目录及 GitHub 来源限额保持不变。

daemon 流式生成自有临时归档，复用现有安装/删除锁，支持发布前取消；一旦获准发布，就完成提交或回滚。按所有者隔离的尝试回执可在响应丢失后区分已提交、未提交和需要恢复。SDK 在错误中保留尝试 ID；Web Shell 直接发送 File/Blob，对不确定结果只查询、不自动重传，并将激活失败与安装成功分别展示。旧 daemon 继续走 base64 路径，大文件在发送前提示升级。

## 为什么需要

真实 20 MiB ZIP 经 base64 编码后超过现有 10 MiB JSON 请求限制。原生传输消除编码开销；本地文件来源避免重新传输已位于 daemon 主机的归档。有界回执让取消、超时后的结果可确认，不引入后台任务或持久化事务。

## 审查验证计划

### 如何验证

- 在浏览器上传真实 20 MiB ZIP，并将同样内容通过主机文件来源安装到 secondary workspace。两者都应安装到对应 scope，内容逐字节一致、归档摘要匹配，且保留调用方原文件。
- 在接收中或等待另一个安装释放锁时取消，然后查询回执。发布前取消应保留此前安装；后续等待者顺序不变。发布准入后的取消可能仍返回已提交回执。
- 发出安装后断连并检查结果。UI 应使用独立请求查询，仍在进行或未知时提供手动检查，绝不自动重传。运行时激活失败应保留安装成功提示并显示独立警告。
- 检查新来源大小与布局边界、重复尝试拒绝、所有者隔离和恢复备份保留。旧 base64/目录/GitHub 行为以及普通 workspace 文件写入应保持原有限额及串行语义。
- 用新 UI 连接旧 daemon：小 ZIP 仍通过 base64 安装，20 MiB ZIP 在发起安装请求前提示升级。

### 前后对比证据

| 场景 | 改动前：未修改的 main | 改动后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 真实 20 MiB ZIP | Base64 JSON 返回 413，原生路由/来源不可用 | Raw 和主机文件来源返回 200，安装内容及归档摘要一致 |
| 浏览器取消 | 没有原生回执流程 | 仅一次安装 POST，自动查询后可手动检查，无重传并确认取消 |
| 两个并发的 200 MiB 展开包 | 超过旧包限额 | 两个均正确安装，第三个活跃归档请求返回 429 |
| 旧 daemon | 支持小型 base64 ZIP | 保持兼容，上传前说明大文件所需升级 |

根目录 build、typecheck、bundle 通过。CLI、SDK、Web Shell 的 focused tests 覆盖新契约及已有共享消费者。独立真实 HTTP 和 Chromium 验收使用隔离 daemon，详细 E2E 报告另发评论。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ macOS 26.6.2 arm64；Chromium 149.0.7827.55 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地验证 |

### 环境

Node.js 26.7.0 上的本地 bundle，独立 home/workspace，真实 HTTP 和浏览器请求。安装验收不需要模型服务凭证或模型调用。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：跨包生命周期及取消改动需要维护者审查。借用 ZIP 复制一次；调用方须在复制期间保持来源稳定，并可提供预期 SHA-256。元数据检查不等于原子快照。复现 2.10 的文件流挂起后，将 ZIP 依赖升级到仓库已有的 3.4 版本。
- 未验证或不在范围内：Linux/Windows 执行、跨进程串行化、断点续传、自动重试、持久化回执和重启恢复。回执仅在当前进程内保存，工作结束后保留十分钟。最后一次短 HTTP smoke 在清理时遇到 ACP 预热关闭错误，已确认无测试进程残留。本地 `/review` 因未配置 Qwen 认证而未能运行；已完成两轮自审，仓库机器人的意见已记录在后续验证报告中，仍需维护者审批。
- 兼容与迁移：旧来源限额和 JSON 请求上限保持不变。新文件来源仅支持现代 config 路由。所有来源（包括旧来源）都保留遗留备份以便恢复；成功安装仍清理自己创建的备份。进程内回执会过期，重启后也无法据此安全判断哪些备份可删除。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/skill-install-redesign/docs/design/2026-10-29-skill-archive-installation.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/skill-install-redesign/docs/design/2026-10-29-skill-archive-installation.zh-CN.md)。两份文档包含相同决策、约束及验收标准。

## 关联

基于 #15030 的后续增强。

</details>

prs.title: feat(qqbot): let the agent send a local file to the chat
prs.body:
## What this PR does

It lets the agent hand media back to a QQ chat. A new per-channel switch, off by default, exposes four tools that each take an absolute local path: one sends a file, one an image, one a video, and one a voice message. The channel checks that the file really is a regular file inside the session's workspace or the system temporary directory (symlinks are resolved and refused when they escape, paths with more than one hard link are refused, and the opened descriptor is re-checked), then uploads it through the platform's chunked upload path and sends it as a rich-media message. The image, video, and voice tools also check the file's magic bytes and its per-kind soft limit before any upload, so a file the platform would render as something else — a GIF, a WebP, an over-limit image — is refused with a pointer to the file tool instead of being quietly downgraded to a file card. Every send reuses the turn's reply anchor and message-sequence counter, so media sent mid-turn stays in the same reply chain as that turn's text; when the reply window has closed it falls back to an active message, and when active messages are disabled it reports the refusal instead of dropping the media or silently replacing it with text. Upload failures are reported to the model with the platform's error code classified, so a retryable part failure can be retried and a daily-limit rejection is not.

## Why it's needed

An agent working in a channel could read a conversation and write files, but had no supported way to deliver one to the user: images, videos, and voice messages could come in, and text could go out, but a report, a generated archive, a chart, a short clip, or a voice note produced locally had to be retrieved by hand from the machine. The tools close that gap with the same ownership rule as the other adapter tools — a tool is only offered to sessions of the channel that registered it. The platform renders an image, a video, and a voice message differently from a file card, so the sender picks the form the user should see instead of every artifact arriving as a download.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Enable the new file switch on a QQ channel and, from a session in that chat, ask the agent to send a file it created inside the workspace; a file card should arrive in the chat and the send should belong to the same reply chain as that turn's text. Then confirm the boundary: a path outside the workspace and outside the temporary directory is refused, a symlink pointing outside is refused, a file over the size cap is refused before any upload, and with the switch off the tool is not registered at all. In a chat where active messages are disabled, force the turn's reply window to close and confirm the tool reports the refusal rather than sending text. Then ask the same session for a generated PNG, an MP4, and a WAV (or MP3/SILK/OGG): the chat should receive an image message, a playable video, and a voice bar, each still in that turn's reply chain. Hand the image tool a GIF or a 21 MB PNG and confirm it is refused before any upload with the accepted formats and the file-tool fallback named, instead of arriving as a file card.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — channel-side tools, no TUI change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only; the platform upload and send paths are exercised with a mocked HTTP layer. Local verification at this head: `file-tools.test.ts` + `api.test.ts` 85/85, `send.test.ts` + `events.test.ts` 368/368, `tsc --build packages/channels/qqbot` exit 0.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the tools hand a local file to the platform under the bot's own identity, so they are opt-in per channel and bounded to the session workspace, the temporary directory, and a per-kind size cap (20 MiB for files, 20 MB for images and voice messages, 30 MB for videos); the path and format checks are the security-relevant part.
- Not validated / out of scope: a real end-to-end send against the live QQ platform. The accepted format lists come from the platform's documentation, which disagrees with itself on image and voice formats (the file-type table says `png`/`jpg` and `silk`, the overview text also lists `gif`/`webp`/`bmp` and `mp3`/`wav`/`ogg`); the design follows the table for images and the wider list for voice, and a format the platform rejects comes back as its own error with a fallback to the file tool. The bilingual design document is at `docs/design/2026-10-25-qqbot-outbound-media.md`.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; the switch defaults off and the change adds a new option and tool rather than changing existing behaviour.

## Linked Issues

The adapter-tool pipeline these tools are exposed through landed as #14348 (now in `main`); this branch has `main` merged into it, so the diff contains only the outbound-media increments.

prs.title: fix(github): do not retry error comment publication on ambiguous errors (#16228)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR prevents duplicate public error comments from being posted by the GitHub channel adapter when a comment creation request encounters a transient network failure or ambiguous error. It passes `isDefiniteNoWriteGithubError` to `this.githubApi` in `postErrorComment()`, ensuring that ambiguous errors (such as 502 Bad Gateway, 504 Gateway Timeout, or socket drop where the comment may have already been successfully created on GitHub) are not retried internally, while definite no-write errors (rate-limiting 403/429 with 0 remaining limit) continue to be retried up to 3 times.

## Why it's needed

When `postErrorComment` in `GithubAdapter.ts` called `this.githubApi(fn, label)` with only two arguments, it inherited the default predicate `shouldRetry = () => true`. If GitHub successfully created the comment but the HTTP connection was severed before returning a 200 response (or returned an ambiguous 502/timeout), the adapter retried up to 3 times within the same execution, posting up to 3 identical "⚠️ Failed to process this request. Please re-mention the bot to retry." comments on the affected issue or PR. Aligning `postErrorComment` with `publishFinalResponse` ensures ambiguous failures are treated as single-shot, stopping bot comment spam.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run the test suite for the GitHub channel adapter:
   ```bash
   pnpm --filter @qwen-code/channel-github vitest run src/GithubAdapter.test.ts -t "error handling"
   ```
2. Verify that:
   - On an ambiguous error (`new Error('comment creation outage')`), `createComment` is called exactly once (no intra-call retries), resulting in 2 total calls across two poll cycles (1 failed attempt, then 1 successful retry on the subsequent poll).
   - On a definite no-write error (rate limit 429 with `x-ratelimit-remaining: '0'`), `createComment` is retried 3 times internally.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- **Before:** On an ambiguous error during error comment posting, `githubApi` retried 3 times internally within the first poll cycle. Combined with a second poll retry, `createComment` was invoked 4 times (`3 intra-call attempts + 1 subsequent attempt`).
- **After:** Ambiguous errors are not retried internally (`isDefiniteNoWriteGithubError` returns `false`), invoking `createComment` 1 time per poll cycle (total 2 calls across two polls: 1 failed, 1 success), eliminating duplicate comment creation.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests via `pnpm --filter @qwen-code/channel-github vitest run`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Low risk. Ambiguous error comment failures fail fast without intra-call retries, relying on normal task-level recovery across subsequent poll intervals if the comment was not posted.
- Not validated / out of scope: `sendThreadMessage` in `GithubAdapter.ts` also calls `createIssueComment` without specifying `shouldRetry`, but addressing it is deliberately out of scope for this focused PR to keep changes surgical and avoid expanding the release blast radius.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16228

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does / 本 PR 的作用

本 PR 防止 GitHub 渠道适配器在发表错误评论遭遇网络瞬态故障或模糊错误时重复发送多条公开评论。通过在 `postErrorComment()` 中向 `this.githubApi` 传入 `isDefiniteNoWriteGithubError`，确保模糊错误（例如 502 Bad Gateway、504 Gateway Timeout 或网络断开，此时评论可能已在 GitHub 成功创建）不会在内部盲目重试，而确定未写入的错误（例如剩余配额为 0 的 403/429 限流）仍会重试最多 3 次。

## Why it's needed / 为什么需要

此前 `GithubAdapter.ts` 中的 `postErrorComment` 调用 `this.githubApi(fn, label)` 时仅传入了两个参数，继承了默认谓词 `shouldRetry = () => true`。如果 GitHub 已经成功创建了评论，但 HTTP 连接在返回前中断或返回了模糊的 502/超时，适配器会在同一次执行内盲目重试最多 3 次，导致在相关 Issue 或 PR 上发表多达 3 条相同的“⚠️ Failed to process this request. Please re-mention the bot to retry.”错误评论。将 `postErrorComment` 的重试策略与 `publishFinalResponse` 保持一致，确保模糊失败以单次模式处理，彻底杜绝机器人刷屏。

## Reviewer Test Plan / 评审者测试计划

### How to verify / 如何验证

1. 运行 GitHub 渠道适配器测试套件：
   ```bash
   pnpm --filter @qwen-code/channel-github vitest run src/GithubAdapter.test.ts -t "error handling"
   ```
2. 确认：
   - 遭遇模糊错误（`new Error('comment creation outage')`）时，`createComment` 仅调用一次（内部不再重试），两次轮询周期内共计调用 2 次（第一次失败，下一次轮询重试成功）。
   - 遭遇明确未写入的错误（`x-ratelimit-remaining: '0'` 的 429 限流）时，`createComment` 内部重试 3 次。

### Evidence (Before & After) / 测试证据（改动前后）

- **改动前：** 发表错误评论遭遇模糊错误时，`githubApi` 在首次轮询内内部盲目重试 3 次，加上后续轮询的重试，`createComment` 共被调用 4 次（3 次内部尝试 + 1 次后续尝试）。
- **改动后：** 模糊错误不再在内部重试（`isDefiniteNoWriteGithubError` 返回 `false`），每次轮询仅调用 1 次（两次轮询共计 2 次调用：1 次失败，1 次成功），消除了重复发表评论的风险。

### Tested on / 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional) / 运行环境

仅单元测试（通过 `pnpm --filter @qwen-code/channel-github vitest run` 验证）。

## Risk & Scope / 风险与范围

- 主要风险与权衡：低风险。模糊的错误评论发布失败直接快速失败而不进行内部重试，若评论确实未发出，则依赖常规的任务级重试。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：`GithubAdapter.ts` 中的 `sendThreadMessage` 同样在调用 `createIssueComment` 时未显式传入 `shouldRetry`，但为保持本次修复范围聚焦、避免放大改动影响，本 PR 明确将其列为范围外。
- 破坏性改动 / 迁移说明：无。

## Linked Issues / 关联 Issue

Fixes #16228

</details>

prs.title: feat(channels): add Microsoft Teams extension and host ingress
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a Microsoft Teams channel extension for personal conversations, explicit group mentions, channel-thread isolation and ordered final-text replies. It supports standalone operation and an application host using the same protocol code.

Hosts can call `createTeamsIngress(name, credentials, acceptInbound)` without constructing a bridge, router, channel or listener. It returns only `handleWebhook`; the Microsoft SDK authenticates and normalizes each Activity, and success waits for acceptance. TeamsChannel delegates to the same verification path. Execution and send hooks remain separate from HTTP ingress.

## Why it's needed

Teams users lack a native channel provider. Application hosts need durable acceptance and ownership checks without copying Teams protocol logic or modifying inference core.

## Reviewer Test Plan

- Verify private messages and trusted bot mentions execute; ordinary group text, wrong bot/tenant, bad serviceUrl, and invalid signature/audience/issuer/expiry do not.
- Set another bot's `Connections__*` environment registry: explicit Teams credentials must remain authoritative, including audience and issuer validation.
- Block or reject the acceptance callback. HTTP success must wait, and persistence failure must be retryable. Original actor/thread/target must survive concurrent requests.
- Verify exact-event cancellation and revocation suppress output, including empty/oversized completed results. These results become bounded notices through the ordinary ChannelBase cancellation and send path.
- Base 0.23.0 supports hosted operation only; 0.26.1 supports standalone and hosted operation. One physical host-provided base instance is required.
- Run the actual release script for a new version, pack/install the manifests together, and confirm the current exact base peer follows the release while the tested legacy peer remains supported.

### Evidence

Focused package tests, repository build/typecheck/bundle, release-script tests and independent compiled SDK/Fastify verification are reported in the verification comment for the current source revision. Independent checks cover the new ingress on both supported base versions, existing channel behavior, completed-result/cancellation races, and an actual release consumer installation.

JWT tests use temporary RSA keys and local JWKS lookup through the real SDK verifier. Connector/UserToken clients are controlled recorders. This demonstrates protocol and host behavior, not live tenant delivery.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :--- |
| macOS | Local build, package, SDK/host and release-consumer verification |
| Windows | Local verification not performed |
| Linux | CI results are recorded separately |

Node 22.23.1, Microsoft Agents SDK 1.9.1, Fastify 5.11.3.

## Risk & Scope

- Standalone scheduling/dedup is in memory. Durable acceptance, execution recovery and delivery retry policy belong to the host. The standalone ingress itself neither queues nor deduplicates.
- No changes to inference core, ChannelBase or built-in provider registration. Publication and registry inclusion remain maintainer decisions. Untested base versions are not declared compatible.
- Not validated: real tenant app installation, Microsoft JWKS/Connector network, actual agent tools, and end-to-end CLI extension loading. The global CLI baseline was unavailable; built CLI smoke is tracked separately. National clouds, attachments, Graph history, cards and scheduled delivery are outside this proposal.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/teams-channel/docs/design/teams-channel.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/teams-channel/docs/design/teams-channel.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Refs #15618. This remains a draft proposal; it is not merged or published.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

通用 Teams 扩展支持私聊、群显式 @、帖子隔离和顺序文本回复。新增独立 `createTeamsIngress`，无需临时 Bridge/Router/Channel，也不启动监听器；同一 SDK 验签路径等待宿主接收完成再 ACK。显式认证连接隔离宿主环境配置，空白/超长确定结果沿正常取消与发送保护处理，发版脚本同步当前 base peer 并保留已验证 legacy peer。

持久化、恢复与重试策略归宿主；插件不绑定特定应用或数据库。未改推理核心、ChannelBase 或内置注册表。合成 SDK/Fastify、取消竞态和实际包安装证据与真实 Teams 租户验收分别记录；维护者接受、合并和正式发布仍待完成。

</details>
